items.title: Isofol Teams Up with Lonza to Develop New Formulation of Arfolitixorin Drug Candidate
items.summary: Isofol Medical AB has entered into a partnership with Lonza to develop a new formulation of its drug candidate, arfolitixorin.
items.content: Isofol Medical AB has announced a collaboration with Lonza to leverage Lonza's expertise in drug development and manufacturing to create a new formulation for arfolitixorin. This partnership aims to advance the development of the drug candidate, which is being investigated for potential therapeutic applications. The collaboration underscores Lonza's role as a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) in supporting pharmaceutical companies with complex formulation and production needs.

items.title: Oma Savings Bank Plc Decides Not to Publish CSRD Sustainability Report for 2026
items.summary: The Board of Directors of Oma Savings Bank Plc has determined that the company will not publish a sustainability report in accordance with the Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD) for the 2026 financial year.
items.content: On November 26, 2026, the Board of Directors of Oma Savings Bank Plc announced its decision to forgo the publication of a CSRD-compliant sustainability report for the 2026 financial year. The company stated that it does not fall within the scope of the CSRD requirements starting from the 2026 financial year. Oma Savings Bank Plc continues to operate as a Finnish retail bank serving over 200,000 customers through its branch network and digital channels.

items.title: Enento Group Receives Major Holdings Notification
items.summary: Enento Group has received a notification regarding a change in major shareholdings in accordance with the Securities Markets Act.
items.content: Enento Group has been notified of a change in major shareholdings pursuant to Chapter 9, Section 10 of the Finnish Securities Markets Act. This regulatory disclosure indicates a shift in the ownership structure of the company's shares. Such notifications are standard corporate governance procedures required when a shareholder's stake crosses specific reporting thresholds.

items.title: UBS Reaffirms Commitment to Strategy and Global Footprint
items.summary: UBS Group AG has publicly reaffirmed its full commitment to its current corporate strategy and its global operational presence.
items.content: UBS Group AG issued a statement confirming its unwavering commitment to its existing business strategy and its continued global footprint. This communication serves as a formal reiteration of the bank's strategic direction amid ongoing market discussions. The company maintains its focus on its established operational goals and international presence as it continues its integration efforts.

items.title: Deutsche Bank Releases Capital Market Outlook 2027
items.summary: Deutsche Bank published its Capital Market Outlook 2027, projecting a constructive but risk-heavy environment for the coming year.
items.content: Deutsche Bank released its Capital Market Outlook 2027, anticipating a broadly constructive capital market environment despite ongoing political and economic risks. The bank projects robust global economic growth and further upside potential in equity markets, supported by rising corporate earnings and continued investment in artificial intelligence. Strategists at the bank forecast the DAX to reach 28,800 points and the S&P 500 to reach 9,000 points by the end of 2027. Additionally, the bank expects an economic recovery in Germany, with its research team projecting 1.3 percent GDP growth for the country in 2027.

items.title: DHL to Manage Cross-Border Competition Logistics for Longines EEF Series
items.summary: DHL has been selected to manage the cross-border logistics for the Longines EEF Series, a prominent equestrian competition.
items.content: DHL will oversee the complex cross-border logistics required for the Longines EEF Series, an international equestrian competition. This partnership involves managing the transportation and delivery of equipment and materials across various borders to support the event's operations. The engagement highlights DHL's role in providing specialized logistics solutions for international sporting events.

items.title: Swiss Re Hosts Study Day on Insurance-Linked Securities Market
items.summary: Swiss Re held a study day at its Centre for Global Dialogue to discuss the evolution and maturity of the Insurance-Linked Securities (ILS) market.
items.content: Swiss Re hosted a study day at its Centre for Global Dialogue on Lake Zurich, bringing together experts and representatives from major European institutional investors. The event focused on the evolution of the Insurance-Linked Securities (ILS) market, which is currently experiencing a phase of maturity and record activity. Discussions highlighted the sector's role in meeting the growing demand for natural catastrophe protection and its ability to provide structurally high returns. The event underscored the increasing interest from institutional investors seeking genuine portfolio diversification through these instruments.

items.title: Munich Re Publishes Voting Rights Notification
items.summary: Munich Re has released a formal notification regarding voting rights in accordance with Section 40, Paragraph 1 of the German Securities Trading Act (WpHG).
items.content: Münchener Rückversicherungs-Gesellschaft Aktiengesellschaft in München has published a voting rights notification as required by Section 40, Paragraph 1 of the German Securities Trading Act (WpHG). The disclosure, disseminated via the EQS News service on November 26, 2026, pertains to the company's regulatory obligations regarding transparency and shareholder structure. The filing is part of the company's standard compliance and reporting requirements for publicly listed entities in Germany.

items.title: Subsea 7 Secures Contract Extension from Equinor for Seven Viking
items.summary: Equinor has awarded Subsea 7 a sizeable extension to an existing frame agreement for the Seven Viking vessel, extending the contract through the end of 2028.
items.content: Equinor has extended its frame agreement with Subsea 7 for the Seven Viking vessel, which provides subsea inspection, maintenance, and repair services for oil and gas wells on the Norwegian Continental Shelf. The extension runs through the end of 2028, building on an original agreement signed in 2018. Subsea 7 defines the contract as 'sizeable,' representing a value between USD 50 million and USD 150 million. Project management and engineering for the vessel will continue to be handled from Subsea 7's Stavanger office.

items.title: Airbus Divests Florida Manufacturing Facility
items.summary: Airbus has completed the sale of its manufacturing facility in Florida to Cerberus Advanced Television.
items.content: Airbus has divested its manufacturing facility located in Florida to Cerberus Advanced Television. The transaction was reported on November 26, 2026. This divestiture represents a strategic adjustment to the company's manufacturing footprint.

items.title: TotalEnergies CEO to Co-Chair 10th Paris Conference
items.summary: Patrick Pouyanné, Chairman and CEO of TotalEnergies, will co-chair the 10th edition of the Paris Conference, scheduled for December 16-17, 2026.
items.content: Patrick Pouyanné, the Chairman and CEO of TotalEnergies, has been announced as a co-chair for the 10th edition of the Paris Conference, an annual event for global decision-makers. The conference is scheduled to take place on December 16 and 17, 2026, at the OECD headquarters in Paris. The event will focus on themes including economic transformation, energy, and geopolitics. Pouyanné will co-chair the event alongside Paul Desmarais, Chairman of Power Corporation of Canada.

items.title: FHFA Outlines Timeline for FICO 10T Adoption at Freddie Mac
items.summary: The Federal Housing Finance Agency has established a timeline for Freddie Mac and Fannie Mae to adopt the FICO 10T credit scoring model, replacing the traditional FICO method.
items.content: The Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA) has announced a formal timeline for the transition to the FICO 10T credit scoring model for both Freddie Mac and Fannie Mae. This initiative aims to modernize the mortgage underwriting process by replacing the traditional FICO scoring method. The agency has outlined specific targets for broad eligibility and the eventual retirement of the legacy system. This shift is part of a broader effort to enhance the accuracy and inclusivity of credit assessments in the housing market.

items.title: Celestica Joins Open Silicon Photonics for AI Systems Initiative
items.summary: Celestica has joined 19 other industry players to launch the Open Silicon Photonics for AI Systems initiative under the Open Compute Project.
items.content: Celestica is participating in the newly formed Open Silicon Photonics for AI Systems initiative, a collaborative effort established under the Open Compute Project. The initiative brings together 19 major industry participants to develop a standardized framework for silicon photonics in artificial intelligence systems. By joining this group, Celestica is contributing to the industry-wide effort to establish technical rulebooks for advanced interconnect technologies, moving beyond individual company developments to broader ecosystem standardization.

items.title: FHFA Outlines Timeline for FICO 10T Adoption at Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac
items.summary: The Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA) has established a transition timeline for Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac to adopt the FICO 10T credit scoring model, replacing the traditional FICO method.
items.content: The Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA) has provided a formal timeline for the adoption of the FICO 10T credit scoring model by Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac. This initiative is part of a broader effort to modernize mortgage credit evaluation. The plan includes specific milestones for achieving broad eligibility and the eventual retirement of the legacy Classic FICO scoring method. This transition is intended to update the standards used for assessing borrower creditworthiness in the secondary mortgage market.

items.title: Tempus AI Enters $500 Million Financing Agreement and Extends AstraZeneca Collaboration
items.summary: Tempus AI has secured a $385 million term loan and a $115 million revolving credit facility, while simultaneously announcing a five-year extension of its strategic oncology collaboration with AstraZeneca.
items.content: Tempus AI entered into a new financing arrangement on November 25, 2026, consisting of a $385 million term loan and a $115 million revolving credit facility. In a separate development, the company announced a five-year extension of its strategic oncology collaboration with AstraZeneca. As part of this expanded partnership, AstraZeneca will receive increased access to the Tempus Lens platform and the company's patient data library. The two companies intend to leverage their combined multimodal data to accelerate drug discovery efforts.

items.title: Al Rajhi Bank Discloses Potential Impact of Saudi Arabia's Proposed Top-up Tax Law
items.summary: Al Rajhi Bank has announced that it expects a potential financial impact resulting from the implementation of Saudi Arabia's proposed top-up tax law.
items.content: Al Rajhi Bank has formally acknowledged that it anticipates a potential impact on its financial position due to the introduction of a new top-up tax law in Saudi Arabia. The bank's disclosure follows broader market discussions regarding the implications of this regulatory change for major Saudi corporations. This announcement highlights the bank's proactive communication regarding regulatory shifts that could affect its tax obligations and overall financial performance. The bank continues to monitor the situation as the legislative framework for the tax law is finalized.

items.title: West Pharmaceutical Services Updates Full-Year 2026 Guidance and Increases Dividend
items.summary: West Pharmaceutical Services raised its full-year 2026 organic sales and adjusted diluted EPS guidance while announcing an 18% increase in its quarterly dividend.
items.content: West Pharmaceutical Services has updated its financial outlook for the full year 2026, raising its organic sales growth guidance to a range of 11.3% to 11.6%, up from the previous forecast of 10% to 11%. The company also increased its adjusted diluted EPS guidance to $9.38 to $9.48, compared to the prior range of $8.85 to $9.05. Additionally, West announced an 18% increase in its quarterly dividend to $0.26 per share. Conversely, the company lowered its capital spending outlook for the year to $215 million to $220 million, down from the previous expectation of $250 million to $275 million.

items.title: Altria Group Considers Potential Acquisition of Imperial Brands
items.summary: Altria Group, Inc. has announced it is considering a potential cash-based takeover offer for London-listed peer Imperial Brands.
items.content: Altria Group, Inc. confirmed it is evaluating a potential cash acquisition of Imperial Brands, a London-listed tobacco company. items.title: Stanley 1913 Implements Kinaxis for Supply Chain Orchestration
items.summary: Drinkware brand Stanley 1913 has onboarded the Kinaxis supply chain orchestration platform to enhance its global planning capabilities and manage complex supply chain operations.
items.content: Stanley 1913 has adopted the Kinaxis supply chain orchestration platform to support its global growth and manage increasingly complex planning needs. The implementation, assisted by Infosys Consulting, allows the company to move away from manual processes like Excel sheets toward a data-driven approach for demand, supply, and inventory planning. By integrating real-time visibility and predictive analytics, the platform enables Stanley 1913 to better navigate trade fluctuations and improve decision-making across its supply chain. This deployment is part of a broader effort to streamline order management and enhance product availability as the brand scales its operations.

items.title: TeraWulf Partners with Fluidstack for AI Hosting and Joint Venture
items.summary: TeraWulf has entered into a multi-year AI hosting agreement and a 25-year joint venture with Fluidstack to provide over 510 MW of critical IT load.
items.content: TeraWulf has established a partnership with Fluidstack involving multi-year AI hosting leases and a 25-year joint venture. The collaboration aims to provide over 510 MW of critical IT load across TeraWulf's data center facilities in Lake Mariner, New York, and Abernathy, Texas. Under the agreement, TeraWulf is responsible for the construction and operation of liquid-cooled, zero-carbon data center facilities, while Fluidstack will deploy and manage high-density GPU compute clusters supported by Google lease guarantees.

items.title: DPM Metals Inc. to Host Investor Day on December 8, 2026
items.summary: DPM Metals Inc. announced it will hold a hybrid investor day in Toronto on December 8, 2026, featuring management presentations and a showcase of core samples.
items.content: DPM Metals Inc. will host an investor day on Tuesday, December 8, 2026, at 9:30 a.m. EST in Toronto, Canada. The event will be held in a hybrid format, allowing for both in-person attendance and participation via a live video webcast. The program includes a networking breakfast at 8:45 a.m. EST where attendees can view core samples from key exploration properties, such as the Brevene Porphyry South project. Following the breakfast, the company's senior management team will deliver presentations, which will be followed by a Q&A session. A replay of the event will be made available on the company's website within two hours of its conclusion.

items.title: Disney Unifies AI Strategy Under New CTO Karandeep Anand
items.summary: Disney is centralizing its AI operations under newly appointed CTO Karandeep Anand, aiming for $3 billion in annual run-rate savings by fiscal 2029.
items.content: The Walt Disney Company is consolidating its division-level AI tools into a single, unified system overseen by CTO Karandeep Anand, who joined the company in September 2026. As part of a broader efficiency initiative, managers have been instructed to target 20% annual cost savings. The company expects these measures to generate $3 billion in annual run-rate savings by fiscal 2029, with all proceeds earmarked for reinvestment into content and technology. Additionally, nearly half of Disney's new advertising campaigns are now utilizing agentic AI tools.

items.title: Federal Judge Grants Injunction Against FCC Review of Disney-Owned ABC Stations
items.summary: A US federal judge has suspended the FCC's early review of broadcast licenses for eight Disney-owned ABC stations, ruling in favor of the company's constitutional claims.
items.content: US District Judge Loren AliKhan issued a preliminary injunction halting the Federal Communications Commission's (FCC) early renewal proceedings for eight television stations owned by Disney's ABC subsidiary. The court found that Disney and ABC were likely to succeed in their argument that the regulator initiated the proceedings in retaliation for protected speech, thereby violating their constitutional rights. While the ruling protects the stations from immediate adverse licensing decisions, it does not permanently resolve the underlying constitutional dispute or strip the commission of its broader regulatory authority.

items.title: Mackenzie Investments Announces Special Meeting and Sustainable Investing Policy Change
items.summary: Mackenzie Investments, a subsidiary of IGM Financial, has called a special meeting for investors of the Mackenzie Corporate Bond Fund to vote on proposed changes to the fund's investment objectives and announced an update to its Sustainable Investing Policy.
items.content: Mackenzie Investments, a subsidiary of IGM Financial Inc., announced that a special meeting of investors for the Mackenzie Corporate Bond Fund will be held to consider and approve changes to the fund's investment objectives. The proposed changes aim to broaden the fund's mandate from higher-yielding Canadian corporate securities to a wider range of global corporate fixed-income securities. Additionally, the company announced an update to its Sustainable Investing Policy. These developments reflect the firm's ongoing management of its investment product offerings and sustainability framework.

items.summary: Goldman Sachs analyst Bonnie Herzog has maintained a 'Hold' rating on Keurig Dr Pepper while raising the price target from $29 to $36.
items.content: Goldman Sachs analyst Bonnie Herzog has updated her outlook on Keurig Dr Pepper, maintaining a 'Hold' rating on the stock. Alongside this rating, the analyst increased the price target for the company from $29 to $36. This adjustment reflects the analyst's current assessment of the company's market position and valuation.

items.title: Zebra Technologies RFID Solution Deployed at JD Sports
items.summary: Zebra Technologies has successfully implemented its RFID technology across 414 JD Sports stores in the UK and Ireland to enhance inventory accuracy.
items.content: JD Sports has deployed Zebra Technologies' RFID solutions across 414 locations in the UK and Ireland to improve omnichannel stock accuracy to 98%. The rollout, which was completed in three months following a five-store pilot, utilizes Zebra's TC2 Series mobile computers and RFD40 UHF RFID sleds. According to JD Sports, the technology provides the necessary operational visibility to support services like one-hour click-and-collect and 30-minute delivery. The implementation is intended to help the retailer scale operations with greater confidence in its inventory data.

items.title: Ensign InfoSecurity and HPE Partner for AI-Powered Sovereign Security
items.summary: Ensign InfoSecurity and Hewlett Packard Enterprise have announced a collaboration to provide AI-powered security operations for organizations operating in sovereign or isolated environments.
items.content: Announced on November 26, 2026, the collaboration between Ensign InfoSecurity and Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) is governed by a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding. The partnership focuses on delivering AI-powered cybersecurity, sovereign AI, and security assessment services. HPE will provide its Private Cloud AI, part of the NVIDIA AI Factory by HPE portfolio, to serve as the underlying infrastructure platform for deploying Ensign's Agentic Security Operations Centre (SOC). This initiative is specifically designed to meet the security requirements of organizations that operate within isolated or sovereign cloud environments.

items.title: Fortinet Joins BT's Cyber Prepared UK Coalition
items.summary: Fortinet has partnered with BT and other industry leaders to support the new "Cyber Prepared UK" program, which provides cyber-attack simulations for small businesses.
items.content: Fortinet is participating in a new coalition led by BT to launch the "Cyber Prepared UK" training program. This initiative aims to strengthen the resilience of small businesses across the UK by delivering immersive cyber-attack simulations. The program is supported by a group of partners, including the National Cyber Security Centre, Microsoft, and CrowdStrike, to help businesses protect against rising cyber threats.

items.title: Analyst Maintains Buy Rating and Price Target for Royal Bank of Canada
items.summary: Analyst Ebrahim Poonawala has maintained a Buy rating on Royal Bank of Canada with a price target of $225.12.
items.content: Analyst Ebrahim Poonawala has reaffirmed a Buy rating for Royal Bank of Canada (RY.US), maintaining a price target of $225.12. This action reflects the analyst's continued positive outlook on the bank's performance. The rating is supported by the analyst's historical performance data, which indicates a 70.3% success rate and an average return of 16.0% over the past year.

items.title: Kimberly-Clark Participates in COMEUP 2026 Open Innovation Program
items.summary: Kimberly-Clark is among the corporations participating in the expanded open innovation program at the COMEUP 2026 startup festival.
items.content: Kimberly-Clark has been identified as a corporate participant in the open innovation program at the upcoming COMEUP 2026 festival. The program, which facilitates business matching and partnerships between established corporations and startups, has seen its corporate participation grow from 35 to 65 entities. This initiative is part of a broader effort to foster global startup innovation and investment, with the festival featuring AI-powered recommendation systems for business matching and various tracks for founders.

items.title: Mackenzie Investments Announces Sustainable Investing Policy Change
items.summary: Mackenzie Investments, a member of the Power Corporation group, has announced an upcoming special meeting of investors and a change to its Sustainable Investing Policy.
items.content: Mackenzie Investments, a subsidiary of IGM Financial Inc. which is part of the Power Corporation of Canada group, has announced an upcoming special meeting for investors. The announcement also includes a formal change to the firm's Sustainable Investing Policy. Mackenzie is a major asset management organization with approximately $267 billion in assets under management as of October 31, 2026.

items.title: Dell Technologies Suspends Server Shipments to Select Southeast Asian Markets
items.summary: Dell Technologies has halted the delivery of servers equipped with advanced NVIDIA AI processors to customers in Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore, and Indonesia following new US export control regulations.
items.content: Dell Technologies has suspended the fulfillment of orders for servers containing advanced NVIDIA artificial intelligence chips in Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore, and Indonesia. This action follows the implementation of new United States Commerce Department export-control regulations on November 19, 2026, which require federal licenses for the shipment of advanced chips to prevent unauthorized access by restricted entities. The company is currently establishing compliance protocols under the new Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) rules while order fulfillment remains frozen for an undetermined period. This move reflects heightened regulatory scrutiny regarding the potential diversion of high-performance computing technology in the region.

items.title: Wells Fargo Maintains Bullish Rating on Medtronic
items.summary: Wells Fargo analyst Larry Biegelsen has reiterated a bullish rating on Medtronic, maintaining a price target of $110.
items.content: Wells Fargo analyst Larry Biegelsen has maintained a bullish rating on Medtronic (MDT) and kept the price target at $110. The update reflects the analyst's ongoing outlook for the company within the medical technology sector. This action is part of standard equity research coverage and does not represent a change in the company's fundamental business operations or strategic direction.

items.title: Coupang Implements Electronic Signature Technology for Cross-Border Customs Clearance
items.summary: Coupang has integrated electronic signature technology into its 'Rocket Overseas' customs declaration process in Taiwan to digitize and streamline the mandatory NCC self-use declaration.
items.content: Coupang has become the first online retail company in Taiwan to implement electronic signature technology within its 'Rocket Overseas' customs clearance workflow. By partnering with the real-name authentication platform EZ Way, the company has digitized the previously paper-based mandatory declaration process for second-level telecommunications radio frequency equipment, such as Bluetooth devices. This initiative, which aligns with the Ministry of Digital Affairs' digital trust verification program, allows customers to complete the required self-use declaration via mobile device in as little as three minutes. The transition aims to reduce paper usage, minimize errors associated with manual filing, and improve overall customs efficiency and the cross-border shopping experience.

items.title: Legal Complaint Filed Against Uber Regarding Driver Screening and Safety
items.summary: A new legal complaint alleges that Uber failed to implement adequate driver screening and safety monitoring protocols.
items.content: A legal complaint has been filed alleging that Uber did not conduct sufficient driver screening or properly assess a driver's ability to operate a vehicle safely. The suit claims the company failed to exercise reasonable care in the monitoring, training, and retention of its drivers. Legal representatives for the plaintiffs argue that the company bears responsibility for the safety of passengers who rely on its platform. The case raises questions regarding the company's internal processes for determining driver qualifications.

items.title: Ford Announces 2027 Product Launch Strategy for Brazil
items.summary: Ford has confirmed a series of upcoming vehicle launches in Brazil for 2027, including the F-150 Raptor and new hybrid and electric models.
items.content: Ford has outlined a product offensive for the Brazilian market, planning to introduce 20 new products, versions, and updates between 2026 and 2027. Key announcements include the pre-sale of the F-150 Raptor, equipped with a 3.5L V6 EcoBoost engine and Fox Racing suspension, scheduled for April 2027. The company also plans to launch a new Platinum combustion-engine version in early 2027, followed by a Territory plug-in hybrid (PHEV) in the second quarter. Additionally, Ford confirmed the arrival of an SUV featuring extended-range electric vehicle (EREV) technology for the final quarter of 2027, which is expected to offer significant power and range.

items.title: India Approves $1.2 Billion Incentive Plan for Construction Equipment Manufacturers
items.summary: The Indian government has approved an eight-year, $1.2 billion incentive program to boost domestic production of advanced construction equipment, with Caterpillar named as a beneficiary.
items.content: On November 26, 2026, the Indian government announced an eight-year incentive plan valued at $1.2 billion aimed at increasing the domestic manufacturing of advanced construction and infrastructure equipment. The program is designed to reduce reliance on imports and provides sales-linked incentives to original equipment manufacturers, including Caterpillar, JCB, and Hitachi. The initiative covers seven equipment categories and five component segments, such as engines, transmissions, and tunnel boring machines. This policy move is intended to strengthen the local industrial ecosystem and support the country's infrastructure development goals.

items.title: Zurich City Council Prepares Counter-Proposal to Airbnb Regulation Initiative
items.summary: The Zurich city council is developing a counter-proposal to a local initiative that seeks to cap short-term rental stays at 90 days per year.
items.content: The Zurich city council is working on a counter-proposal to the "Airbnb initiative," which aims to restrict short-term rentals to a maximum of 90 days per year. The council intends to present this counter-proposal to the municipal council by January 4, 2027, as part of an effort to align the initiative with existing local regulations. This development follows a reported 50% increase in the number of apartments rented via platforms like Airbnb in Zurich over the past five years.

items.title: Visa Releases 2026 Holiday Spending Shift Survey for Canada
items.summary: Visa Canada published new research findings regarding Canadian consumer spending habits and financial management strategies heading into the 2026 holiday season.
items.content: The 'Visa Holiday Spending Shift 2026' survey, conducted by Morning Consult, indicates that 83% of Canadian adults have taken steps to manage rising costs over the past year, such as seeking discounts, reducing discretionary spending, or switching to lower-cost brands. Despite these financial pressures, the research highlights a continued consumer interest in experiential gifts, particularly among younger generations, with travel and live-event tickets ranking highly on wish lists. The survey also notes that the 2026 FIFA World Cup has influenced interest in sports-related gifts for a significant portion of the population. The data was collected from a national sample of 1,040 Canadian adults between late September and early October 2026.

items.title: IC Group Holdings Inc. Reports Q3 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: IC Group Holdings Inc. announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter of 2026, reporting an 11% year-over-year revenue increase and a 64% rise in Adjusted EBITDA.
items.content: IC Group Holdings Inc. reported its unaudited financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. The company achieved its third consecutive quarter of Adjusted EBITDA at $0.67 million, representing a 64% increase from the prior year, alongside an 11% year-over-year revenue growth that was approximately 98% organic. Management highlighted performance across its business units, noting that IC Engage expanded its gross margin to 74% and IC Insurance grew revenue by 34%. While IC Mobile saw 15% revenue growth, its gross margin remains under pressure due to carrier cost increases and the operation of two messaging platforms in parallel. The company expects to complete its messaging platform migration in the fourth quarter and anticipates that a leadership realignment implemented in October will help position the firm for margin expansion in 2027.

items.title: Criterium Energy Ltd. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial and Operational Results
items.summary: Criterium Energy reported its Q3 2026 financial results, highlighting a revenue of CA$7.2 million and a narrowing net loss, alongside updates on its SE-MGH field production.
items.content: Criterium Energy Ltd. announced its financial and operational results for the third quarter of 2026, reporting revenue of CA$7.2 million and a narrowing net loss. The company achieved first gas sales from its 21 Bcf SE-MGH field on November 10, 2026, with production averaging 7.4 MMcf/d during the first two weeks. Total company production exceeded 1,850 boe/d, with oil production averaging 573 bbl/d in Q3. Criterium realized an oil price of US$120/bbl for October 2026 and continues to receive a fixed price of US$7.00/MMBtu for gas under its Gas Sales Agreement. Management anticipates that overall production will exit 2026 at levels materially higher than the start of the year, with future growth funded primarily through operating cash flow.

items.title: Devonian Health Group Reports Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Devonian Health Group announced its financial results for the fourth quarter and fiscal year ended July 31, 2026, reporting a net loss of $6.4 million for the year.
items.content: Devonian Health Group reported a net loss of $625,925 for the fourth quarter and $6.4 million for the fiscal year ended July 31, 2026. The company highlighted the implementation of operational efficiency and cost-containment measures designed to reduce cash burn and extend its financial runway. Management emphasized a continued strategic focus on the development of Thykamine™ and noted that the company is actively pursuing financing alternatives, including potential private placements and a U.S. stock exchange listing, to support its growth objectives. The increased annual net loss was primarily attributed to lower gross margins from its Altius Healthcare subsidiary following the expiration of a distribution agreement for pantoprazole magnesium.

items.title: Lake Street Downgrades Research Solutions to Hold Rating
items.summary: Lake Street analyst Jacob Stephan downgraded Research Solutions, Inc. (RSSS) to a hold rating and lowered the price target to $3.25 following the acquisition announcement.
items.content: Following the announcement that Research Solutions, Inc. entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by KnowledgeWorks Global Ltd., Lake Street analyst Jacob Stephan downgraded the company's stock from a buy to a hold rating. The analyst also adjusted the price target for RSSS shares from $4.00 to $3.25. This rating change reflects the market's reaction to the acquisition terms, which offer a cash buyout price of $3.25 per share.

items.title: Almadex Minerals Reports Quarterly Financial Results
items.summary: Almadex Minerals Ltd. released its financial results for the quarter ending September 30, 2026, showing significant year-over-year revenue growth and an increase in earnings per share.
items.content: Almadex Minerals Ltd. reported its financial results for the quarter ending September 30, 2026, during a financial conference held on November 24, 2026. The company recorded earnings per share of 0.09 CAD, compared to 0.020 CAD in the same quarter of the previous year. Revenue for the quarter reached 3.5 million CAD, representing a substantial increase from the 0.1 million CAD reported in the prior-year period.

items.title: Charbone Corporation Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial and Operational Results
items.summary: Charbone Corporation announced its financial and operational results for the third quarter of 2026, highlighting growth in gas income, customer base, and fleet size.
items.content: Charbone Corporation reported its financial and operational results for the third quarter and nine-month period ended September 30, 2026. Gas income for the third quarter rose 21% to $0.55 million compared to $0.46 million in the second quarter of 2026, with gas income margins improving to approximately 26% from 7%. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, total gas income reached $1.2 million, compared to nil in the same period of 2025. The company expanded its active customer base from 3 to 28 and increased its delivery fleet from 2 to 11 units. As of September 30, 2026, the company held $1.5 million in cash and had drawn $4.5 million from its $10 million secured convertible loan facility, while reporting a net loss of $3.09 million for the nine-month period.

items.title: Momentus Insider Purchases Shares Worth Over $1.2 Million
items.summary: A recent SEC filing reveals that a company insider acquired 635,583 shares of Momentus Inc. for approximately $1.24 million.
items.content: According to an SEC Form 4 filing, Ronald W. Burkle, an insider with a 10% ownership stake, purchased 635,583 shares of Momentus Inc. (MNTS) on November 20, 2026. The transaction was valued at approximately $1,237,153. Following this acquisition, Burkle maintains beneficial ownership of a total of 2,547,094 shares of the company's Class A common stock.

items.title: Aspen Neuroscience to Present at the Piper Sandler 38th Annual Healthcare Conference
items.summary: Aspen Neuroscience, Inc. announced that its President and CEO, Damien McDevitt, Ph.D., will participate in a fireside chat at the upcoming Piper Sandler 38th Annual Healthcare Conference.
items.content: Aspen Neuroscience, Inc. (Nasdaq: ASPE) announced that President and Chief Executive Officer Damien McDevitt, Ph.D., is scheduled to participate in a fireside chat at the Piper Sandler 38th Annual Healthcare Conference. The conference is set to take place in New York City from December 1 to December 3, 2026, with the fireside chat occurring on Wednesday, December 2, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. ET. The company, which focuses on developing personalized autologous cell therapies for Parkinson's disease, noted that a webcast of the session will be available for registration through the Investors section of its website. A replay of the presentation will be accessible for 30 days following the event.

items.title: BioStem Technologies CEO Reports Insider Share Sale
items.summary: BioStem Technologies, Inc. CEO Jason Matuszewski sold 175,700 shares of company stock, reducing his direct ownership stake.
items.content: BioStem Technologies, Inc. (NASDAQ: BSEM) CEO Jason Matuszewski executed a sale of 175,700 shares of the company's common stock at a price of $0.65 per share. The transaction, valued at approximately $113,988, resulted in an 11% decrease in his direct ownership, bringing his total holdings to 1,363,551 units. This insider activity was disclosed in a recent SEC Form 4 filing.

items.title: Alzai Health Corp. Terminates Euro Digital Media Agreement and Engages MCS for Investor Relations
items.summary: Alzai Health Corp. has cancelled its planned digital marketing campaign with Euro Digital Media Ltd. and instead engaged MCS Market Communication Service GmbH for investor relations services.
items.content: Alzai Health Corp. announced it will not proceed with a previously planned digital marketing campaign with Euro Digital Media Ltd., which was originally established under a marketing services agreement from August 2026. In its place, the company has engaged MCS Market Communication Service GmbH to provide investor relations services. The engagement with MCS is expected to last up to four months at a total cost of EUR 350,000, which is payable in a single upfront payment. The services provided by MCS will include the creation of marketing and advertising content.

items.title: Aspire-Lakewood Holdings, Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Aspire-Lakewood Holdings, Inc. reported its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, marking its first quarter incorporating the newly acquired driver control systems business.
items.content: Aspire-Lakewood Holdings, Inc. reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $29.3 million, a significant increase from $2,000 in the same period of 2025, driven by the inclusion of the driver control systems business acquired on August 6, 2026. The company achieved a net income of $4.0 million, or $1.12 per diluted share, compared to a net loss of $1.9 million in the third quarter of 2025. This quarter's results included a provisional non-cash bargain purchase gain of $8.5 million related to the acquisition of Dura Control Systems Corp. Adjusted EBITDA was $1.6 million, compared to a loss of $1.1 million in the prior-year period. The company ended the quarter with $10.8 million in cash and cash equivalents.

items.title: Local Bounti Receives NYSE Continued Listing Standard Notice
items.summary: Local Bounti Corporation announced it received a notice from the New York Stock Exchange indicating non-compliance with listing standards due to its stock price falling below $1.00.
items.content: On November 25, 2026, Local Bounti Corporation announced that it received a notice from the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) on November 19, 2026. The notice states that the company is not in compliance with the NYSE's continued listing standards, specifically the Price Criteria set forth in Section 802.01C of the NYSE Listed Company Manual. This determination was made because the average closing price of the company's common stock was less than $1.00 over a consecutive 30 trading-day period.

items.title: RBC Capital Highlights Growth Drivers for Brookfield Infrastructure
items.summary: RBC Capital Markets analysts identified asset sales and a simplified corporate structure as key factors supporting future growth for Brookfield Infrastructure.
items.content: Analysts at RBC Capital Markets reported that Brookfield Infrastructure is well-positioned for faster cash flow growth. The report highlights the company's ongoing asset sales and the benefits of its recently simplified corporate structure as primary drivers for this outlook. Additionally, the firm noted that the company's access to capital provides a competitive advantage in the current market environment. RBC Capital maintained an 'Outperform' rating and a $47 price target for the company.

items.title: Nanalysis Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results
items.summary: Nanalysis Scientific Corp. reported its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, highlighting a return to net income and revenue growth.
items.content: Nanalysis Scientific Corp. reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $10.6 million, representing a 14% increase compared to the same period in 2025. The company achieved an adjusted EBITDA of $1.8 million, a significant improvement from the $2,000 loss reported in the third quarter of 2025. Net income for the quarter was $0.4 million, compared to a net loss of $1.5 million in the prior year period. Management attributed the improved results to revenue growth, higher gross margins in both the product and security services segments, and continued expense discipline. Product sales revenue grew 43% year-over-year to $3.9 million, while security services revenue increased 1% to $6.0 million.

items.title: Loop Industries Announces CEO Transition and $5.9 Million Capital Raise
items.summary: Loop Industries, Inc. appointed Adel Essaddam as Interim CEO following the resignation of Daniel Solomita and successfully raised $5.9 million through an at-the-market offering to support strategic objectives, including its India joint venture.
items.content: Loop Industries, Inc. announced that Daniel Solomita has stepped down as Chief Executive Officer and resigned from the Board of Directors, effective immediately. The company has appointed Adel Essaddam, previously the Chief Operating Officer, as Interim CEO and a member of the Board. Concurrently, Loop raised approximately $5.9 million in gross proceeds through an at-the-market (ATM) offering program. The company intends to use these funds to support its strategic objectives, including its share of the land purchase for the Infinite Loop India joint venture in Gujarat. The India project, a partnership with Ester Industries, is planned as a 45 kiloton-per-annum facility to produce virgin-quality PET from recycled feedstock, with construction targeted to begin in the first quarter of 2027.

As part of this update, the analyst lowered the price target for LifeVantage from $9 to $8. This adjustment reflects the firm's current outlook on the company's valuation and market performance.

items.title: Bighorn Metals Corp. Announces Grant of Restricted Share Units
items.summary: Bighorn Metals Corp. has granted 250,000 restricted share units (RSUs) to certain directors and officers, effective November 23, 2026.
items.content: Bighorn Metals Corp. announced the grant of 250,000 restricted share units (RSUs) to specific directors and officers of the company. The grant was made effective November 23, 2026, under the company's shareholder-approved Omnibus Long-Term Incentive Plan. These RSUs are scheduled to vest on March 24, 2027, contingent upon the recipients remaining eligible participants under the plan. Upon vesting, each RSU entitles the holder to receive one common share of the company, subject to a four-month hold period from the date of issuance.

items.title: Revolve Renewable Power Corp. Obtains Final Court Approval for Arrangement with Whitfield Power Solutions
items.summary: The Supreme Court of British Columbia has granted a final order approving the statutory plan of arrangement between Revolve Renewable Power Corp. and Whitfield Power Solutions, LLC.
items.content: Revolve Renewable Power Corp. announced that the Supreme Court of British Columbia has issued a final order approving its previously announced statutory plan of arrangement with Whitfield Power Solutions, LLC. Under the terms of the arrangement, shareholders are entitled to receive either cash consideration of $0.23 per share or, subject to specific conditions, one Class B unit in the purchaser for every 10,000 shares held. This court approval represents the final substantive requirement for the transaction. The company expects the arrangement to be completed on November 30, 2026, provided that all remaining conditions are satisfied or waived.

items.title: India's Largest Bank Upgrades Pelican AI Financial Crime Compliance Platform
items.summary: Pelican AI Corp. announced that India's largest bank has successfully upgraded its financial crime compliance platform to a newer Red Hat Enterprise Linux release.
items.content: Pelican AI Corp. reported that a Fortune Global 500 institution, identified as India's largest bank, successfully upgraded its financial crime compliance platform on November 22, 2026. The upgrade involved migrating the platform's operating environment to a newer Red Hat Enterprise Linux release. Pelican AI CEO Nino Di Teodoro noted that the system has remained stable since the go-live and emphasized the importance of maintaining long-standing customer relationships. The bank has utilized Pelican's technology for nearly a decade across 29 geographies.

items.title: Avalon Advanced Materials Announces Closing of Additional C$1.0 Million Flow-Through Financing
items.summary: Avalon Advanced Materials Inc. has closed a second tranche of its non-brokered private placement, raising an additional C$1.0 million in flow-through financing.
items.content: Avalon Advanced Materials Inc. announced the closing of a second tranche of its previously announced non-brokered private placement. The company issued 154,000 flow-through common shares, raising C$1.0 million in additional proceeds. This latest closing brings the total proceeds from the offering to C$5.0 million. The funds are intended to support the company's ongoing mineral exploration and development activities.

items.title: Blink Charging Co. Announces 1-for-30 Reverse Stock Split
items.summary: Blink Charging Co. has announced plans to implement a 1-for-30 reverse stock split of its common stock.
items.content: Blink Charging Co. (BLNK) has disclosed plans to effect a 1-for-30 reverse stock split of its common stock. This corporate action involves consolidating every thirty existing shares of common stock into one new share. The move is a structural change to the company's equity, typically intended to adjust the per-share trading price. The announcement was reported on November 25, 2026, via an SEC filing.

items.title: Celularity Receives Nasdaq Notification Regarding Delayed Form 10-Q Filing
items.summary: Celularity Inc. announced it received a notification from Nasdaq regarding non-compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) due to a delayed quarterly financial report.
items.content: On November 24, 2026, Celularity Inc. received a notification letter from The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC stating that the company is not in compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) because it failed to timely file its Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the period ended September 30, 2026. Nasdaq has granted the company until January 25, 2027, to submit a plan to regain compliance. If the plan is accepted, the company may be granted an extension of up to 180 calendar days, potentially moving the deadline to May 24, 2027. The company stated that it expects to file the report and regain compliance in the coming days. The notification does not have an immediate effect on the listing or trading of the company's common stock on the Nasdaq Capital Market.

items.title: MineHub Technologies Inc. Closes First Tranche of Private Placement Financing
items.summary: MineHub Technologies Inc. has successfully closed the first tranche of its private placement, raising CAD $1,370,000 through the issuance of 3,914,285 units.
items.content: MineHub Technologies Inc. announced the closing of the first tranche of its private placement, which was initially disclosed on November 11, 2026. The company raised CAD $1,370,000 by issuing 3,914,285 units at a price of $0.35 per unit. The securities issued are subject to a four-month and one-day hold period. MineHub intends to utilize the net proceeds for working capital and to evaluate ongoing strategic, corporate, and financial opportunities. The offering has received conditional approval from the TSX Venture Exchange, with final closing subject to standard filing requirements.

items.title: Maxus Mining Completes Resource-Focused Technical Study at Quarry Antimony Project
items.summary: Maxus Mining Inc. has completed a technical study at its Quarry Antimony Project in British Columbia, establishing preliminary drill-spacing benchmarks and identifying eleven geological targets.
items.content: Maxus Mining Inc. announced the completion of a resource-focused technical study conducted by Understood Mineral Resources Ltd. (UMR) for its Quarry Antimony Project. The study established preliminary drill-spacing benchmarks based on an analysis of twelve international polymetallic deposits to guide future exploration. Additionally, UMR identified eleven geological target wireframes at the historic Bullseye Zone to support resource delineation drilling. The company intends to use these findings to refine geological interpretations and address data gaps identified during the historical data review. This study serves as a technical foundation for the company's long-term objective of advancing the project toward a potential NI 43-101-compliant Mineral Resource Estimate.

items.title: Inventus Mining Resumes Pardo Bulk Sampling Program Following Approval
items.summary: Inventus Mining Corp. has received provincial approval to process 30,000 tonnes of material from its Pardo gold project, allowing the company to resume its bulk sampling program.
items.content: Inventus Mining Corp. announced that it is resuming its bulk sampling program at the 100%-owned Pardo “River of Gold” Project in Ontario after receiving provincial approval to process 30,000 tonnes of material. The company has already delivered 2,437 tonnes of the 10,000-tonne Trench 1 North bulk sample to McEwen Inc.'s Stock Mill and is currently hauling the remaining approximately 7,500 tonnes. Processing had been previously paused pending regulatory approval for tailings deposition. Management views this as a major milestone that will help fund ongoing work at the project and provide data to compare head grades with drill estimates as the company works toward a potential direct ship ore operation in 2027.

items.title: ONGold Resources Reports Quarterly Financial Results
items.summary: ONGold Resources Ltd. held a financial conference on November 24, 2026, to report its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
items.content: ONGold Resources Ltd. hosted a financial conference on November 24, 2026, to disclose its financial performance for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. The company reported a loss per share of 0.01 CAD for the period. This result compares to a loss per share of 0.070 CAD reported in the same quarter of the previous year.

items.title: VenHub Global Serves as Sponsor for 2026 RTIH AI in Retail Awards
items.summary: VenHub Global, Inc. was identified as a sponsor for the 2026 RTIH AI in Retail Awards, which recognized various companies for their contributions to retail technology.
items.content: VenHub Global, Inc. participated as a sponsor for the 2026 RTIH AI in Retail Awards. The event, hosted by Retail Technology Innovation Hub, recognized several companies for their advancements in AI-driven retail solutions. The sponsorship aligns with VenHub's position as a provider of autonomous retail technology and AI-powered smart store solutions.

items.title: BeyondSpring to Participate in A.G.P.-Hosted KOL Fireside Chat
items.summary: BeyondSpring Inc. announced it will participate in a key opinion leader (KOL) fireside chat hosted by A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners on December 1, 2026.
items.content: BeyondSpring Inc. will participate in a key opinion leader (KOL) fireside chat hosted by A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners on Tuesday, December 1, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. ET. The discussion will focus on the potential of the company's lead asset, Plinabulin, to resensitize cancer patients to PD-1/L1 inhibitors and provide updates on the DUBLIN-4 study in post-immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). The company is currently advancing Plinabulin in the global Phase 3 DUBLIN-4 trial, targeting a patient population estimated at approximately 135,000 across the U.S. and five major European markets by 2037.

items.title: Conduent Achieves HITRUST Cybersecurity Certification
items.summary: Conduent has received HITRUST certification for its State Medicaid Enterprise Data Warehouse, validating its commitment to high-level data security and privacy standards.
items.content: Conduent announced that its State Medicaid Enterprise Data Warehouse has achieved HITRUST certification, a globally recognized standard for information security. This certification confirms that the company's data management systems meet rigorous security and privacy requirements necessary for handling sensitive healthcare information. By obtaining this credential, Conduent demonstrates its ongoing commitment to protecting state-level Medicaid data against evolving cybersecurity threats. The certification serves as a validation of the company's operational security controls and risk management practices within its government healthcare solutions portfolio.

items.title: Grey Wolf Health Corp. Reports Financial Results for the Third Quarter Ended September 30, 2026
items.summary: Grey Wolf Health Corp. announced its financial results for the third quarter of 2026, reporting a 9.6% year-over-year increase in quarterly revenue to $10.2 million.
items.content: Grey Wolf Health Corp. (TSXV: WOLF) reported its financial results for the three- and nine-month periods ended September 30, 2026. For the third quarter, the company achieved revenue of $10.2 million, representing a 9.6% increase compared to the same period in 2025. Gross profit for the quarter rose 14.8% to $5.6 million, while Adjusted EBITDA grew 24.6% to $2.4 million. CEO Angela Cechetto attributed the performance to organic growth in the Pharmacy business, which saw a 9.4% increase in sales of compounded products, and a 10.1% revenue increase in the Animal Health business driven by demand for established and new products in the gastrointestinal, behavior, and end-of-life portfolios.

items.title: Excellon Resources Announces Filing of Management Information Circular and Proposed Name Change
items.summary: Excellon Resources Inc. has filed and mailed its management information circular for an upcoming annual and special meeting and is proposing a name change to Excellon Silver & Gold Inc.
items.content: Excellon Resources Inc. announced the filing and mailing of its management information circular for an annual and special meeting of shareholders scheduled for December 16, 2026. As part of the meeting agenda, the company is proposing a name change to Excellon Silver & Gold Inc., which remains subject to shareholder and regulatory approval. Shareholders will also be asked to vote on a special resolution to approve a statutory plan of arrangement with Saxony Silver Corp., a majority-owned subsidiary, pursuant to an agreement dated November 10, 2026.

items.title: South Pacific Metals Reports Quarterly Financial Results
items.summary: South Pacific Metals Corp. released its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, reporting a loss per share of 0.02 CAD.
items.content: South Pacific Metals Corp. disclosed its financial performance for the fiscal quarter ending September 30, 2026, during a quarterly financial conference. The company reported a loss per share of 0.02 CAD, consistent with the loss per share of 0.020 CAD recorded in the same quarter of the previous year. The results were formally presented on November 24, 2026.

items.title: Realbotix Corp. Announces Expansion into AI-Powered Hospitality and Event Automation
items.summary: Realbotix Corp. is launching an initiative in AI-powered hospitality and event automation, beginning with a pilot program featuring two Series 1 humanoid robots in collaboration with a Swedish telecommunications provider.
items.content: Realbotix Corp. has announced its expansion into the AI-powered hospitality and event automation sector. The company is initiating this move with a pilot program scheduled for late November 2026, which will utilize two Series 1 tabletop humanoid robots. The pilot is being conducted in collaboration with a leading Swedish telecommunications provider to demonstrate the robots' capabilities in guest check-in and automated service workflows. This development was reported by Onconetix, Inc., which has a pending agreement to acquire Realbotix LLC, a subsidiary of Realbotix Corp.

items.title: Focus Graphite Commences Pilot-Scale Graphite Processing Program with COREM
items.summary: Focus Graphite has launched a metallurgical and pilot-scale processing program with COREM to produce graphite concentrate from its Lac Knife and Lac Tetepisca projects.
items.content: Focus Graphite Inc. has initiated a comprehensive metallurgical and pilot-scale processing program in collaboration with COREM, a Quebec-based mineral processing innovation centre. The program aims to produce approximately 6 tonnes of representative graphite concentrate sourced from the company's 100%-owned Lac Knife and Lac Tetepisca projects. This material will be utilized for downstream thermal purification, characterization, and product qualification with prospective customers and strategic partners. The initiative is intended to support the development of advanced graphite materials for battery, defense, and industrial applications.

items.title: Datavault AI CEO Removal Challenge Moves to Discovery
items.summary: The Delaware Court of Chancery has ordered an expedited schedule for the leadership dispute involving Datavault AI Inc. and its former CEO, Nathaniel Bradley.
items.content: The legal challenge brought by Nathaniel Bradley regarding his removal as CEO of Datavault AI Inc. is proceeding following a hearing in the Delaware Court of Chancery. The Court has directed the parties to establish an expedited case management schedule, aiming to resolve the leadership dispute within 60 to 90 days. Additionally, Mr. Bradley has announced his intention to file a proxy statement opposing a reverse stock split proposal scheduled for a December 29, 2026, special meeting, as well as a consent solicitation to change the company's board composition and bylaws. The court filing also highlighted allegations regarding undisclosed director-affiliated financing involving a July 2026 bridge loan to NYIAX, Inc.

items.title: Uniserve Announces Grant of Incentive Stock Options
items.summary: Uniserve Communications Corporation has granted 610,000 incentive stock options to certain directors and employees, exercisable at $0.70 per share.
items.content: Uniserve Communications Corporation announced the grant of 610,000 incentive stock options to specific directors and employees under its Rolling Stock Option Plan. Each option is exercisable into one common share at a price of $0.70, based on the closing price of the shares on the TSX Venture Exchange on November 24, 2026. The options have a three-year term expiring on November 25, 2029, and vest immediately for directors, subject to a four-month hold period. Additionally, the company reported that 250,000 options previously granted to consultants on February 26, 2026, have been cancelled by mutual agreement.

items.title: Vesicor Therapeutics Holdings Announces Clinical Development Plans for VES991
items.summary: Vesicor Therapeutics Holdings, Inc., formerly Black Hawk Acquisition Corporation, announced plans to initiate human clinical trials for its lead candidate, VES991, in late 2027.
items.content: Vesicor Therapeutics Holdings, Inc. has outlined a development timeline for VES991, a potential first-in-class oral RNA therapeutic for glioblastoma. The company anticipates submitting an Investigational New Drug (IND) application to the FDA in the second half of 2027, following a series of IND-enabling preclinical safety and toxicology studies. Pending regulatory approval and operational readiness, the company aims to initiate a first-in-human clinical trial in the fourth quarter of 2027. The development program is designed to evaluate the safety, tolerability, and preliminary biological activity of the therapeutic, which is engineered to restore p53 tumor suppressor function in cancer cells.

items.title: Sportsman's Warehouse Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call
items.summary: Sportsman's Warehouse Holdings, Inc. has announced it will host a conference call on December 9, 2026, to discuss its financial results for the third quarter of 2026.
items.content: Sportsman's Warehouse Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: SPWH) announced that it will hold a quarterly conference call to discuss its third quarter 2026 financial results on Wednesday, December 9, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time. A live audio webcast of the conference call will be accessible through the company's investor relations website. A replay of the webcast will be available on the same website within two hours of the call's conclusion and will remain accessible through December 16, 2026.

items.title: Greenland Resources Provides Update and Invites for Live Investor Webinar
items.summary: Greenland Resources Inc. has announced a corporate update and invited stakeholders to participate in a live investor webinar.
items.content: Greenland Resources Inc. has issued an update regarding its operations and has extended an invitation to investors for a live webinar. The event is intended to provide stakeholders with the latest information on the company's activities and strategic progress. This communication serves as a direct engagement effort with the investment community to discuss the company's current status and future outlook.

items.title: HPQ Silicon Secures Second Conditional Purchase Reservation for ENDURA+ MiniMax Systems
items.summary: HPQ Silicon has obtained a second conditional purchase reservation for 500 ENDURA+ MiniMax portable power systems, bringing total potential sales to US$750,000.
items.content: HPQ Silicon Inc. announced a second conditional purchase reservation agreement for 500 units of its ENDURA+ MiniMax portable power system, valued at US$625,000. This follows an initial reservation for 100 units announced on November 23, 2026, bringing the company's total conditional reservations to 600 units and US$750,000 in potential sales within nine days of the product's unveiling. The ENDURA+ MiniMax is a 1.95 kWh portable power system designed for Starlink Mini terminals. These reservations remain conditional upon the product meeting agreed technical specifications and certification requirements. The company is targeting initial deliveries for late Q1 or early Q2 2027.

items.title: Citizens Analyst Lowers Price Target on Acrivon Therapeutics to $6.00
items.summary: Citizens analyst Silvan Tuerkcan reduced the price target for Acrivon Therapeutics, Inc. from $13.00 to $6.00 while maintaining a Market Outperform rating following a clinical data update.
items.content: Citizens analyst Silvan Tuerkcan lowered the price target on Acrivon Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ: ACRV) to $6.00 from $13.00, while maintaining a Market Outperform rating. The adjustment follows the company's presentation of updated Phase 1 dose-escalation data for its ACR-2316 candidate at the EORTC-NCI-AACR Triple Meeting. While the analyst noted that the data supports a potentially optimized dose and schedule with encouraging early activity, they expressed that the current results are not yet sufficient to differentiate ACR-2316 from other WEE1-targeting precision medicines. The firm maintains its positive rating as it awaits upcoming registrational-intent data for the company's lead candidate, ACR-368.

items.title: UBS Group AG Discloses Reduction in Renalytix plc Holding
items.summary: UBS Group AG reported that its trading book holdings in Renalytix plc fell below the 5% disclosure threshold as of November 24, 2026.
items.content: UBS Group AG notified that its trading book position in Renalytix plc dropped below the 5% reporting threshold as of November 24, 2026. Consequently, the firm's reported voting rights in the company have been reduced to 0.000000%, rendering the holding exempt from further major-holding disclosure requirements. This filing follows a previous disclosure from November 23, 2026, which had indicated a 5.112424% stake.

items.title: Mene Inc. Reports Q3 2026 Financial Results and Announces CEO Transition
items.summary: Mene Inc. reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of CA$6.1 million and announced that President and CEO Vincent Gladu will transition out of his role.
items.content: Mene Inc. announced its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, reporting IFRS revenue of CA$6.1 million. Concurrently, the company announced that Vincent Gladu, its President and Chief Executive Officer, will transition out of his role. Gladu will remain with the company until April 2, 2027, to facilitate a smooth leadership transition.

items.title: XTI Aerospace Eliminates Class B Units and Enters into Warrant Exchange Agreement
items.summary: XTI Aerospace, Inc. has simplified its capital structure by eliminating Class B Units and entering into a warrant exchange agreement.
items.content: XTI Aerospace, Inc. announced the elimination of all outstanding Class B Units of its subsidiary, XTI Drones Holdings, LLC, which were converted into 6,524,576 shares of XTI Aerospace common stock on a one-to-one basis. Following this transaction, the company reported having approximately 47.8 million shares of common stock outstanding as of November 25, 2026. Interim CEO Jeremy Schneiderman stated that the move marks a significant step in simplifying the company's capital structure and provides a solid foundation for executing strategic growth initiatives. The company also entered into a warrant exchange agreement as part of this effort to enhance shareholder value.

items.title: LaFleur Minerals Secures Strategic Investment of up to C$4.3 Million via Non-Brokered Private Placement
items.summary: LaFleur Minerals Inc. has secured a strategic investment of up to C$4.3 million through a non-brokered private placement to support the commissioning of its Beacon Gold Mill.
items.content: LaFleur Minerals Inc. announced a strategic investment agreement where an arm's-length investor will subscribe for up to 12,870,102 common shares at a price of C$0.335 per share. The total proceeds of approximately C$4.3 million are intended to support the commissioning and ramp-up of the company's 100%-owned, fully permitted Beacon Gold Mill. The company's CEO, Andrew Elinesky, noted that the investment, which represents a premium to the 30-day VWAP, serves as an endorsement of the company's mine-to-mill strategy in the Abitibi Gold Belt. The funding will also support ongoing drilling activities aimed at expanding the Swanson Gold Deposit.

items.title: GFG Resources Awarded C$200,000 Funding from Ontario Junior Exploration Program
items.summary: GFG Resources Inc. has received C$200,000 in matching funds from the Ontario Junior Exploration Program (OJEP) to support its 2026 exploration activities at the Goldarm Property.
items.content: GFG Resources Inc. announced it has been awarded C$200,000 in matching funds through the Ontario Junior Exploration Program. The funding is designated to offset eligible exploration expenditures for the company's 2026 programs at its Goldarm Property, located in the Timmins Gold District of Ontario, Canada. Eligible activities supported by the grant include drilling and base-of-till sampling. Company management stated that the funding strengthens their ability to advance exploration and pursue new mineral discoveries in the region.

items.title: Rocket Doctor AI Inc. Announces Network Expansion and Pharmacy Pilot
items.summary: Rocket Doctor AI Inc. reported that its affiliated physicians have joined the Altais network in California and that it has initiated a 90-day pharmacy pilot program in Canada.
items.content: Rocket Doctor AI Inc. announced that its affiliated professional corporation, Rocket Doctor Practice Group, P.C., joined the Altais network as of November 11, 2026, to provide primary care and specialist services to eligible patients in California. Additionally, the company launched a 90-day pilot program on November 18, 2026, through its subsidiary, Rocket Doctor Inc., in partnership with a Canadian pharmacy chain. This pilot aims to provide physician-led virtual care across 25 pharmacy locations in Alberta, British Columbia, and Ontario. These developments are part of the company's ongoing efforts to expand its digital health platform and marketplace.

items.title: Impact Silver Announces Q3 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Impact Silver Corp. reported a 73% increase in consolidated revenue for the third quarter of 2026, driven by higher silver prices and increased production grades.
items.content: Impact Silver Corp. announced its financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue for the third quarter rose to $18.5 million, up 73% from $10.7 million in the same period of 2025. For the first nine months of 2026, revenue reached $71.6 million, more than doubling from $31.2 million in the prior year. The company reported a net loss of $3.3 million for the third quarter, which included a $4.3 million non-cash impairment loss, while year-to-date net income stood at $10.9 million. Operational performance was bolstered by a 49% increase in realized silver prices and a 25% increase in average mill head grades at the Zacualpan operation.

items.title: DSV Enters Long-Term Sustainable Aviation Fuel Partnership with Cathay Cargo
items.summary: DSV has signed a long-term agreement with Cathay Cargo to scale the use of sustainable aviation fuel (SAF), marking the company's first such partnership in Asia.
