items.content: Manulife Investments announced the estimated cash distributions for December 2026 for its Manulife Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs) and the ETF series of its mutual funds, including alternative mutual funds. These estimates are based on information as of November 2, 2026, and are subject to change. Unitholders of record at the close of business on December 30, 2026, will be eligible to receive the distributions, which are scheduled to be paid on January 15, 2027. The announcement covers a range of funds, including various bond and dividend-focused ETFs.

items.title: Barclays Capital Adjusts Hannover Re Price Target
items.summary: Barclays Capital has raised its price target for Hannover Re shares from 271 to 279 Euro while maintaining an "Underweight" rating.
items.content: Barclays Capital analyst Ivan Bokhmat has updated the firm's outlook on Hannover Re, increasing the price target for the company's shares to 279 Euro from 271 Euro. Despite the higher target, the analyst maintained an "Underweight" rating on the stock. The adjustment follows an assessment of the reinsurer's strategic goals for 2027, which the analyst noted are closely aligned with current market consensus.

items.title: Banca Akros raises Lottomatica target price to 35 euros
items.summary: Banca Akros has increased its target price for Lottomatica Group S.p.A. from 32 euros to 35 euros, while maintaining a 'buy' recommendation.
items.content: Banca Akros has updated its valuation of Lottomatica Group S.p.A., raising the target price to 35 euros from the previous 32 euros. The firm continues to maintain a 'buy' recommendation on the stock. This adjustment follows an update to the analysts' estimates for the company.

items.title: Medicover Completes Divestment of Medicover Hospitals India
items.summary: Medicover has finalized the divestment of its Indian hospital operations to sharpen its strategic focus on its core European markets.
items.content: Medicover has officially completed the divestment of Medicover Hospitals India. This strategic move is intended to allow the company to concentrate its resources and management focus on its primary healthcare and diagnostic markets in Europe. The transaction marks a shift in the company's geographic footprint as it streamlines its portfolio.

items.title: NTT UD REIT Investment Determines Interest Rate on 1.5 Billion Yen Loan
items.summary: NTT UD REIT Investment Corporation has finalized the interest rate for a 1.5 billion yen loan.
items.content: NTT UD REIT Investment Corporation, a real estate investment trust associated with the NTT Group, has officially determined the interest rate for a 1.5 billion yen loan. This financial update follows the company's ongoing debt management activities, which have included previous debt financing rounds earlier in the year. The announcement provides specific details regarding the cost of this particular borrowing arrangement.

items.title: National Bank of Canada Launches No-Fee Everyday Account
items.summary: National Bank of Canada has introduced a new 'No-Fee Everyday Account' tailored for clients who manage their banking digitally.
items.content: National Bank of Canada announced the launch of its No-Fee Everyday Account on November 26, 2026. This new banking product is specifically designed to meet the needs of clients who prefer to manage their everyday financial activities through digital channels. The offering represents a strategic move by the bank to enhance its digital service suite for its customer base.

items.title: Ericsson and BT Deploy AI-Native Scheduler for Link Adaptation
items.summary: Ericsson and BT have launched a commercial AI-native Scheduler for Link Adaptation on the EE network in London, improving download speeds and spectral efficiency.
items.content: Ericsson and BT have transitioned the AI-native Scheduler for Link Adaptation from trial to full commercial use on the EE network in London. This software-driven solution adjusts transmission settings like modulation and coding in real-time to optimize network performance without requiring new hardware. The deployment has resulted in a 26% increase in average download speeds and a 13% improvement in spectral efficiency. This initiative builds upon the companies' previous deployment of Advanced RAN Coordination (ARC) and represents a continued effort to enhance mobile network intelligence through software optimization.

items.title: Eni-backed GreenIT Begins Construction of 131-MW Solar Plant in Sicily
items.summary: GreenIT, a joint venture backed by Eni, has commenced construction on a 131-megawatt photovoltaic solar plant located in Assoro, Sicily.
items.content: GreenIT, the renewable energy joint venture supported by Eni, has officially started construction on a new 131-megawatt solar power facility in Assoro, Sicily. This project represents a significant step in the company's ongoing efforts to expand its renewable energy capacity. The development is part of the broader strategy of Eni and its partners to increase their footprint in the Italian green energy market. The facility is expected to contribute to the regional energy transition by providing sustainable power generation.

items.title: Northrop Grumman Wins $1.13B Contract Modification for Navy E-130J Program
items.summary: Northrop Grumman has been awarded a $1.13 billion contract modification to support the U.S. Navy's E-130J program.
items.content: Northrop Grumman Corporation secured a $1.13 billion contract modification related to the U.S. Navy's E-130J program. This award represents a significant commitment to the program's ongoing development and operational requirements. The contract modification was reported on November 26, 2026.

items.title: Uber Appoints Rakesh Ranjan as President of India and South Asia
items.summary: Uber has named former Zomato CEO Rakesh Ranjan as the new president for its India and South Asia operations, effective January 4, 2027.
items.content: Uber has appointed Rakesh Ranjan to lead its business in India and South Asia, a region that serves as the company's third-largest market by trip volume. Ranjan, who previously served as CEO of the edtech firm Allen Online and spent eight years at Zomato, will report to Dom Taylor, Uber's regional general manager for Asia Pacific. The appointment follows a three-month search process. In his new role, Ranjan will focus on driving growth and innovation, with a stated emphasis on improving the everyday experience for riders and enhancing earning opportunities for drivers. India remains a critical hub for the company, hosting its largest technology centers outside of the United States.

items.title: Stellantis Hosts Maserati Day Presentation
items.summary: Stellantis is holding a dedicated 'Maserati Day' presentation on November 26, 2026, to provide updates on the brand.
items.content: Stellantis has scheduled a 'Maserati Day' presentation for November 26, 2026, at 2:00 p.m. CET. The event is designed to provide strategic updates and insights regarding the Maserati brand. Investors and interested parties can access the presentation through a live webcast and review event materials via the Investors section of the Stellantis corporate website.

items.title: Barclays Downgrades Jungheinrich to Equal Weight
items.summary: Investment bank Barclays has downgraded Jungheinrich AG from 'Overweight' to 'Equal Weight' and reduced its price target for the company's shares.
items.content: Barclays has lowered its rating on Jungheinrich AG shares to 'Equal Weight' from 'Overweight.' Concurrently, the bank reduced its price target for the stock from 33 euros to 24 euros. This analyst action reflects a change in the bank's outlook for the company.

items.title: Analyst Updates for Jenoptik Following German Equity Forum
items.summary: Financial analysts from Deutsche Bank Research and Jefferies have maintained their 'Buy' ratings on Jenoptik shares following the company's participation in the German Equity Forum.
items.content: Following the German Equity Forum in Frankfurt, analysts have provided updated outlooks for Jenoptik. Deutsche Bank Research maintained its 'Buy' rating with a price target of 52 euros, noting that the company's order momentum has consistently surprised positively throughout the year. Jefferies also maintained a 'Buy' rating with a price target of 49 euros, highlighting that strong order intake and backlog in the semiconductor, data center, and defense sectors support the company's growth and margin prospects.

items.title: Philipp Mankowski to Step Down as Head of Tamedia Advertising
items.summary: Philipp Mankowski, the head of Tamedia Advertising, will leave the company at the end of 2026, with Martin Lütgenau and Sarah Rothberger appointed as interim successors.
items.content: Philipp Mankowski, who has led Tamedia Advertising as an independent marketing unit since 2025 and joined the company in 2016, is stepping down from his position at the end of the year. Following his departure, Martin Lütgenau and Sarah Rothberger will take over the management of the advertising marketing department on an interim basis, with Lütgenau overseeing sales and Rothberger managing operations. Mankowski will continue to support the company in an advisory capacity until the end of March 2027.

items.title: UBS Adjusts Price Target for Hugo Boss
items.summary: UBS AG has lowered its price target for Hugo Boss shares while maintaining a 'Neutral' rating.
items.content: Analyst Robert Krankowski of UBS AG has revised the price target for Hugo Boss, reducing it from 38.90 Euro to 38.60 Euro. The firm has maintained its 'Neutral' rating on the stock. In its outlook for 2027, the bank noted that the fashion group faces another challenging year ahead.

items.title: GEA Group AG: Voting Rights Announcement Regarding DWS Investment GmbH
items.summary: GEA Group AG reported a change in voting rights held by DWS Investment GmbH, which fell to 2.999% as of November 23, 2026.
items.content: GEA Group AG released a voting rights announcement in accordance with the German Securities Trading Act (WpHG). The notification indicates that DWS Investment GmbH, based in Frankfurt am Main, Germany, crossed a reporting threshold. As of November 23, 2026, DWS Investment GmbH held 2.999318237927% of the voting rights in GEA Group AG, down from a previous level of 3.24%. The change was attributed to the acquisition or disposal of shares and instruments, as well as the return of equity collateral.

items.title: CA Immo Reports Nine-Month 2026 Results and Raises Annual Guidance
items.summary: CA Immo reported its financial results for the first nine months of 2026, raising its annual FFO I guidance while noting a decline in net income due to property devaluations and portfolio sales.
items.content: CA Immo has raised its annual guidance for sustainable earnings (FFO I) to over 95 million euros, up from the previous target of over 90 million euros, citing operational efficiency. For the first nine months of 2026, the company reported a net income of 36.8 million euros, down from 149.6 million euros in the same period last year, primarily due to property devaluations and asset sales. Rental income for the period fell by 10% to 143.7 million euros, reflecting an 11% reduction in leasable space following strategic divestments. Additionally, the company has convened an extraordinary general meeting for December 16, 2026, to seek approval for a special dividend of 1.50 euros per share.

items.title: Moody's Affirms A3 Credit Rating for Amplius
items.summary: Moody's has published an updated credit opinion for the housing association Amplius, affirming its A3 stable credit rating.
items.content: Moody's has affirmed the A3 stable credit rating of Amplius, a 40,000-home housing association. The rating agency's updated credit opinion leaves the credit outlook unchanged. This affirmation was announced in the context of a non-deal investor update scheduled by the association for December 8, 2026.

items.title: Vienna Insurance Group Reports Strong Nine-Month Results and Raises 2026 Profit Outlook
items.summary: Vienna Insurance Group (VIG) announced a 15.4% increase in pre-tax profit to 1.01 billion euros for the first nine months of 2026 and raised its full-year profit forecast.
items.content: Vienna Insurance Group (VIG) reported a strong performance for the first three quarters of 2026, with written premiums rising 5.3% to 13.1 billion euros and pre-tax profit growing 15.4% to 1.01 billion euros. The company attributed this growth primarily to its 'Extended CEE' segment, with significant contributions from Bulgaria, Romania, Slovakia, and Hungary. Following these results, VIG raised its full-year 2026 profit outlook to a range between 1.35 and 1.4 billion euros, up from its previous guidance of 1.25 to 1.30 billion euros. The group also noted an improvement in its combined ratio to 92.0% compared to 92.1% in the prior-year period.

items.title: Notification of Major Holdings in Bilfinger SE by Morgan Stanley
items.summary: Bilfinger SE published a regulatory announcement regarding a change in voting rights held by Morgan Stanley.
items.content: Bilfinger SE issued a formal notification of major holdings, disclosing that Morgan Stanley crossed a voting rights threshold on November 17, 2026. The announcement was disseminated via the EQS News service on November 26, 2026, in compliance with regulatory disclosure requirements. The filing provides details on the total positions and the nature of the holdings held by the financial institution.

items.title: Almirall Enters Exclusive Licensing Agreement with Hyphens Pharma for Seysara® in ASEAN
items.summary: Almirall, S.A. has granted Hyphens Pharma International Limited exclusive rights to register and commercialize the acne treatment Seysara® (sarecycline) across ASEAN countries.
items.content: Almirall, LLC, a subsidiary of Almirall, S.A., has entered into an exclusive license and supply agreement with Hyphens Pharma Pte. Ltd., a subsidiary of Hyphens Pharma International Limited. Under the terms of the agreement, Hyphens Pharma gains the exclusive rights to register and commercialize Seysara® (sarecycline) for the treatment of moderate to severe acne vulgaris in ASEAN countries. Seysara® is a narrow-spectrum oral antibiotic specifically developed for dermatology, previously approved by the FDA in 2018 and the NMPA in China in 2026. This partnership aims to expand Hyphens Pharma's acne portfolio and strengthen its dermatology presence in the region, providing a new treatment option amidst growing concerns regarding antimicrobial resistance.

items.title: SMG Swiss Marketplace Group Appoints New Managing Director for Automotive Division
items.summary: SMG Swiss Marketplace Group has appointed Maurice Acker as the new Managing Director of its Automotive division, effective January 1, 2027.
items.content: SMG Swiss Marketplace Group announced that Maurice Acker will take over as Managing Director of the Automotive division starting January 1, 2027. Acker, who has over 20 years of experience in the automotive and marketplace sectors, succeeds Alberto Sanz de Lama, who is transitioning to the role of Group CEO on the same date. Additionally, Matthias Bischof, the current Director of Business Customers for the Automotive division, will depart the company at the end of January 2027 to become the CEO of Quality1. Acker will oversee the transition and determine the successor for the business customers role after assuming his new position.

items.title: PUMA SE Establishes New 'Emerging Markets' Business Region
items.summary: PUMA SE has created a new 'Emerging Markets' business region, headquartered in Singapore, to strengthen its presence in Southeast Asia, Oceania, the GCC, South Africa, and Turkey.
items.content: PUMA SE announced the formation of a new business region, 'Emerging Markets,' to bolster its growth in key international territories including Southeast Asia, Oceania, the GCC, South Africa, and Turkey. The company will establish a regional hub in Singapore to support these operations. Effective December 1, 2026, Will Newton, formerly of Lego and Adidas, will serve as the Managing Director for this new region. Newton will report directly to PUMA's Chief Commercial Officer, Arne Arens.

items.title: UBS Adjusts PUMA SE Price Target
items.summary: UBS has lowered its price target for PUMA SE from 24.80 EUR to 24.30 EUR while maintaining a 'Neutral' rating.
items.content: The Swiss bank UBS has updated its outlook on PUMA SE, reducing the price target for the company's shares from 24.80 EUR to 24.30 EUR. Despite the adjustment, the bank has maintained its 'Neutral' rating on the stock. Analyst Robert Krankowski noted that while the company faces lower expectations, the path forward remains challenging.

items.title: Berenberg lowers price target for RENK Group AG
items.summary: Private bank Berenberg has reduced its price target for RENK Group AG from 72 EUR to 40 EUR while maintaining a "Buy" rating.
items.content: Analyst George McWhirter of Berenberg adjusted the price target for RENK Group AG, citing the company's recent acquisition of David Brown Defence and the divestment of its slide bearing business. Despite the reduction in the price target, the bank maintained its "Buy" rating on the stock. The analyst noted that RENK's shares currently trade at a significant valuation discount of approximately 30 percent compared to the broader industry.

items.title: DWS Investment GmbH Reports Change in Voting Rights in GEA Group AG
items.summary: DWS Investment GmbH, a subsidiary of DWS Group, has disclosed a change in its voting rights holdings in GEA Group Aktiengesellschaft.
items.content: DWS Investment GmbH, a subsidiary of the DWS Group, filed a notification regarding its holdings in GEA Group Aktiengesellschaft. The announcement, transmitted via EQS News, indicates that the threshold for voting rights was crossed or reached on November 23, 2026. This regulatory disclosure is a standard requirement for institutional investors managing assets on behalf of clients. The filing identifies DWS Investment GmbH as the legal entity subject to the notification obligation.

items.title: Goldman Sachs Prime Broking Insights on Hedge Fund Positioning
items.summary: Goldman Sachs' co-head of prime broking insights and analytics, Vincent Lin, reported that hedge funds are shifting toward capital preservation and increasing short positions amid recent market volatility.
items.content: In a recent podcast interview, Vincent Lin, co-head of prime broking insights and analytics at Goldman Sachs, discussed current hedge fund strategies in response to market volatility observed in October and November 2026. Lin noted that hedge funds are prioritizing capital preservation over aggressive market participation, leading to reduced net and gross equity exposure. Additionally, these funds have been actively adding new short positions to their portfolios. Lin expressed skepticism regarding a potential year-end market rally, citing the current risk-averse stance of institutional investors.

items.title: Hensoldt and Argus Interception Expand Drone Defense Partnership
items.summary: Hensoldt and Argus Interception GmbH are deepening their collaboration in counter-unmanned aircraft systems (C-UAS) by integrating new interception technology into Hensoldt's Elysion product.
items.content: Hensoldt and the German-based Argus Interception GmbH have announced an expansion of their partnership focused on drone defense (C-UAS). The collaboration centers on integrating Argus Interception's network-based, non-kinetic drone interception technology into Hensoldt's existing C-UAS product, Elysion. This initiative aims to enhance protection capabilities for critical infrastructure, civilian facilities, and military sites both domestically and internationally. The companies have confirmed that initial joint demonstrations and customer projects are currently in preparation.

items.title: Higgsfield AI Partners with Nebius on NVIDIA Blackwell Infrastructure
items.summary: Higgsfield AI collaborated with Nebius to utilize NVIDIA Blackwell infrastructure for its large-scale diffusion model training pipeline.
items.content: Higgsfield AI partnered with Nebius as a co-engineering collaborator to leverage NVIDIA Blackwell infrastructure. This collaboration enabled Higgsfield to build a stable training pipeline, supporting the company's rapid scale-up to a $200 million annualized revenue run rate. The partnership highlights Nebius's role in providing high-performance cloud infrastructure for AI model training.

items.title: Vonovia Announces Over €2 Billion Investment Plan for Bavaria
items.summary: Vonovia SE has committed to investing more than two billion euros in Bavaria by 2031 to support new housing construction, energy-efficient modernization, and neighborhood development.
items.content: Vonovia SE plans to invest over two billion euros in the German state of Bavaria between now and 2031. The investment program, announced in Munich, focuses on the construction of up to 3,800 new residential units, energy-efficient modernization of existing properties, and the further development of residential quarters. According to the company, approximately 1.1 billion euros will be allocated to new construction on company-owned land, with an additional 460 million euros earmarked for potential project acquisitions. The remaining funds are designated for maintenance and modernization efforts. Vonovia CEO Luka Mucic emphasized the importance of political reliability for long-term investments in new construction and modernization.

items.title: Schaeffler AG Successfully Places 6.5% Stake in Schaeffler India Limited
items.summary: Schaeffler AG has sold a 6.5% stake in its Indian subsidiary to institutional investors, generating net proceeds of approximately EUR 314 million to reduce net debt.
items.content: Schaeffler AG successfully placed 10,159,738 equity shares in its subsidiary, Schaeffler India Limited, representing 6.5% of the subsidiary's outstanding share capital. The shares were sold to institutional investors at a price of INR 3,493 per share, resulting in net proceeds of approximately EUR 314 million. The company intends to use these funds to reduce its net debt and strengthen its balance sheet and equity ratio. Following the transaction, the Schaeffler Promoter Group's shareholding in the Indian subsidiary decreased from 74.13% to approximately 67.63%. Schaeffler reiterated its long-term intention to remain a significant majority shareholder, maintaining at least two-thirds of the subsidiary's outstanding shares.

items.title: Bayer to Invest Up to €500 Million in China Manufacturing Expansion
items.summary: Bayer plans to invest up to 500 million euros to expand its pharmaceutical production site in Beijing, China.
items.content: Bayer announced a plan to invest up to 500 million euros ($548.8 million) to expand its drug-manufacturing facility in Beijing. This project represents the company's largest pharmaceutical investment in China to date and aims to increase production capacity for cardiovascular and oncology medicines primarily for the local market. The expanded site is expected to accommodate up to 300 additional employees, with production slated to commence as early as 2032.

items.title: Ahold Delhaize Subsidiary AB Vassilopoulos Pilots New Discount Model
items.summary: Ahold Delhaize's Greek subsidiary, AB Vassilopoulos, is testing a new discount retail model leveraging the Profi chain.
items.content: AB Vassilopoulos, a subsidiary of Ahold Delhaize, has initiated a pilot program for a new discount retail model. The strategy utilizes the Profi chain, which was previously acquired by Ahold Delhaize for 1.3 billion euros. This initiative aims to adapt the company's competitive positioning in the Greek market by integrating discount-focused operational efficiencies.

items.title: Accor Completes Second Tranche of Share Buyback Program
items.summary: Accor has finalized the second tranche of its share repurchase program, totaling 225 million euros.
items.content: The hotel group Accor announced that it has completed the second tranche of its share buyback program, amounting to 225 million euros. This tranche was part of a broader 450 million euro share repurchase program that was originally announced on February 19, 2026. The company, led by CEO Sébastien Bazin, confirmed the completion of this phase in a recent statement.

items.title: Uzbekistan and Bureau Veritas Sign Two Cooperation Deals
items.summary: Bureau Veritas has signed two cooperation agreements with Uzbekistan's Technical Regulation Agency to enhance product conformity assessment and certification systems.
items.content: Bureau Veritas and the Institute of Standards, operating under Uzbekistan's Technical Regulation Agency, have entered into two cooperation agreements focused on product conformity assessment and certification. The agreements cover a range of sectors, including consumer goods, low-voltage electrical equipment, textile products, and personal protective equipment. The partnership aims to align local certification systems with international requirements, thereby increasing the export potential of Uzbek manufacturers to markets in the European Union and the United States. The signing followed a meeting in Tashkent involving agency officials, the French Ambassador to Uzbekistan, and Bureau Veritas executives to discuss technical regulation and product safety standards.

items.title: JPMorgan Maintains Neutral Rating on Alstom
items.summary: JPMorgan has maintained its 'Neutral' rating on Alstom with a price target of 14 euros following an analyst event in London.
items.content: Following an analyst event held in London, the US bank JPMorgan has maintained its 'Neutral' rating on Alstom, setting a price target of 14 euros. During the event, the rail vehicle manufacturer provided further details regarding its recent profit and cash flow warning, as well as its financial results for the first half of the fiscal year.

items.title: Goldman Sachs Raises Price Target for Sartorius Stedim Biotech
items.summary: Goldman Sachs has increased its price target for Sartorius Stedim Biotech from 235 EUR to 265 EUR while maintaining a "Buy" rating.
items.content: US investment bank Goldman Sachs updated its outlook on Sartorius Stedim Biotech, raising the price target for the company's shares from 235 EUR to 265 EUR. The firm maintained its "Buy" rating on the stock. Analyst James Quigley noted that while earnings estimates for the biotech company remained unchanged, the valuation was adjusted to reflect recent market trends.

items.title: Extension of Agreement Deadline with Veolia Energia Łódź S.A.
items.summary: An issuer has signed an annex to an agreement with Veolia Energia Łódź S.A., extending the deadline for concluding a final contract to December 11, 2026.
items.content: On November 26, 2026, an issuer announced the signing of Annex No. 1 to an existing agreement with Veolia Energia Łódź S.A., a subsidiary of the Veolia group. The annex extends the deadline for the parties to finalize a formal contract until December 11, 2026. The issuer noted that the event is considered significant due to its value and importance to the company's operations. Further details regarding the contract are expected to be disclosed in a separate report once the agreement is signed.

items.title: Barclays Downgrades KION Group to 'Equal Weight' and Lowers Price Target
items.summary: Barclays has downgraded KION Group shares from 'Overweight' to 'Equal Weight' and reduced the price target from 46 to 32 euros, citing concerns over industry competition and margin pressure.
items.content: The British investment bank Barclays has downgraded KION Group from 'Overweight' to 'Equal Weight' and lowered its price target for the company's shares from 46 euros to 32 euros. Analyst Timothy Lee indicated that the warehouse logistics sector faces a challenging environment in 2027, driven by intensifying competition from Chinese rivals. Furthermore, the analyst highlighted potential margin headwinds resulting from rising costs and a possible slowdown in order growth. Lee noted that KION appears particularly vulnerable to these risks compared to peers, citing high downside risks in the current consensus.

items.title: Oberbank Reports Nine-Month 2026 Financial Results and Impending ECB Supervision
items.summary: Oberbank AG reported a 9.8% increase in profit after tax for the first nine months of 2026 and announced it will fall under direct European Central Bank supervision in 2027 due to its total assets exceeding 30 billion euros.
items.content: Oberbank AG announced its financial results for the first three quarters of 2026, reporting a profit after tax of 312 million euros, a 9.8% increase compared to the same period in 2025. Net interest income grew by 3.3% to 479 million euros, while commission income rose by 11% to 191.3 million euros. The bank's equity result from associated companies, driven significantly by its stake in voestalpine, increased by 58.8% to 69.9 million euros. Additionally, the bank's total assets have surpassed 30 billion euros, triggering a transition to direct supervision by the European Central Bank, which is expected to take effect in 2027. Loan volume grew by 4.5% to 22.7 billion euros, with 60% of the growth attributed to international markets including Germany, the Czech Republic, Hungary, and Slovakia.

items.title: UBS Maintains Buy Rating for LVMH
items.summary: UBS AG has reaffirmed its "Buy" rating for LVMH Moët Hennessy - Louis Vuitton SE, maintaining a price target of 510 Euro.
items.content: UBS analyst Zuzanna Pusz maintained a "Buy" rating on LVMH shares with a price target of 510 Euro. The analyst highlighted LVMH's strong portfolio of brands, talent, and prime locations within the luxury sector as key drivers for future recovery. Pusz expressed optimism for 2027, projecting an organic revenue growth of 2 percent for the group.

items.title: Mediobanca Research Department Publishes Annual Telecommunications Sector Survey
items.summary: Mediobanca's research division released its annual report analyzing the global and Italian telecommunications sector, covering performance data from the first half of 2026 and the 2021-2025 period.
items.content: Mediobanca's Area Studi has published its annual survey on the global and Italian telecommunications industry. The report analyzes data from 36 major international operators with 2025 revenues exceeding nine billion euros, examining performance trends from the first half of 2026 and the preceding five-year period. The study highlights sector-wide challenges, including competitive pressures, the need for business model transformation, and the economic sustainability of infrastructure investments in the Italian market. The findings provide a comprehensive overview of revenue dynamics, profitability margins, and market consolidation trends across different geographic regions.

items.title: Supermicro Halts Server Shipments to Certain Southeast Asian Markets Following New US Export Controls
items.summary: Supermicro has reportedly informed customers in Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia that orders for servers containing Nvidia chips will not be shipped due to new US export control regulations.
items.content: Supermicro and other manufacturing partners have notified affected customers that shipments of servers equipped with Nvidia chips to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia are being halted. This action follows the implementation of new US export controls affecting the distribution of high-end computing hardware. The move represents a significant disruption to the company's supply chain and regional operations in Southeast Asia. It remains unclear whether the shipment halt is temporary as the company and its partners navigate the new regulatory requirements. Supermicro did not immediately provide a comment on the situation outside of regular business hours.

items.title: Harley-Davidson Announces Strategic Expansion in India with Hero MotoCorp
items.summary: Harley-Davidson and Hero MotoCorp have launched 'Mission: The Big RIDE' to mark 17 years of the brand in India, including plans to open two new dealerships.
items.content: Harley-Davidson and its partner Hero MotoCorp have announced a strategic initiative titled 'Mission: The Big RIDE' to celebrate 17 years of the brand's presence in the Indian market. The initiative aims to enhance customer experience, expand the product portfolio, and deepen engagement with the local rider community. As part of this growth strategy, the companies will open two new full-line dealerships in Raipur and Indore, bringing the total network to 23 locations across India. The partnership has been a significant driver for the brand, with the co-developed Harley-Davidson X range contributing over 50,000 units since its 2023 launch.

items.title: Lionsgate's 'The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping' Sets New Franchise Tuesday Record
items.summary: Lionsgate's latest Hunger Games installment, 'Sunrise on the Reaping,' achieved a record-breaking Tuesday box office performance and is projected to be a top performer over the Thanksgiving holiday.
items.content: The film 'The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping' set a new Tuesday record for both Lionsgate and the Hunger Games franchise, earning $15.98 million. This figure narrowly surpassed the previous record of $15.96 million held by 2013's 'The Hunger Games: Catching Fire.' Projections indicate the film is on track to earn at least $85 million over the five-day Thanksgiving holiday period. If these estimates hold, the release will rank as the franchise's second-highest-grossing Thanksgiving opening, trailing only 'Catching Fire.'

items.title: Canadian Utilities Responds to Puerto Rico Supreme Court Decision on LUMA Energy
items.summary: Canadian Utilities Limited has issued a formal response regarding a recent ruling by the Supreme Court of Puerto Rico concerning its related entity, LUMA Energy.
items.content: Canadian Utilities Limited has publicly addressed a decision handed down by the Supreme Court of Puerto Rico involving LUMA Energy, a company in which it holds a significant interest. The response follows the court's ruling, which carries implications for the operations and regulatory environment of the utility provider in Puerto Rico. Canadian Utilities is monitoring the situation closely to assess the impact on its investment and the ongoing management of the energy infrastructure project. The company's statement reflects its commitment to navigating the legal and operational complexities associated with its international utility holdings.

items.title: VantageScore 4.0 Mortgage Securitization Market Share Exceeds 20% at Freddie Mac and Fannie Mae
items.summary: VantageScore 4.0 mortgage securitization market share for Freddie Mac and Fannie Mae rose to over 20% in October 2026, totaling $9.56 billion in loan volume.
items.content: In October 2026, the market share of mortgages backed by VantageScore 4.0 and securitized by Freddie Mac and Fannie Mae increased significantly, surpassing 20% of total securitized loans. This represents a rise from 5% ($3.5 billion) in September 2026 to over $9.56 billion in Government-Sponsored Enterprise (GSE) loan volume. The growth reflects a rapid adoption of the VantageScore 4.0 model by lenders for mortgage applications. This shift occurred despite a 29% decline in total mortgage volumes during the same month.

items.title: Vita Coco Community Foundation Joins Partnership to Support Philippine Coconut Farmers
items.summary: The Vita Coco Community Foundation participated in a memorandum of understanding signing at Malacañan Palace to support sustainable coconut farming in the Philippines.
items.content: The Vita Coco Community Foundation, alongside the Philippine Coconut Authority, Metro Pacific Agro Ventures Inc., Century Pacific Food Inc., and the organization HOPE, signed a memorandum of understanding to enhance the coconut industry in the Philippines. The initiative focuses on providing farmers with quality coconut seedlings, training in sustainable farming practices, and assistance in connecting with buyers. The project aims to increase the country's annual coconut supply by approximately 400 million coconuts once the trees become productive. The effort is expected to provide participating farmers with significant annual income increases for decades, supporting their livelihoods and financial security.

items.title: Amdocs Joins Consortium to Deliver Czech European Digital Identity Wallet
items.summary: Amdocs is participating as a subcontractor in a consortium led by Wultra that has been awarded the contract to implement and operate the Czech Republic's version of the European Digital Identity Wallet (EUDI-W).
items.content: A consortium led by Wultra has won the tender to develop and operate the Czech implementation of the European Digital Identity Wallet (EUDI-W), a project aligned with the EU-wide rollout under the revised eIDAS regulation. Amdocs is serving as a subcontractor within this consortium, which also includes iProov, Signicat, youniqx Identity AG, and Partners Bank. The project is structured as a concession contract and involves building secure digital identity and authentication infrastructure. Wultra, as the consortium leader, will coordinate the delivery of the solution, which is intended to facilitate secure digital interactions for citizens and businesses across the European Union.

items.title: Netflix Announces Limited-Time 'Stranger Things' 10th Anniversary Cafe
items.summary: Netflix is launching a limited-time cafe to commemorate the 10th anniversary of its original series 'Stranger Things'.
items.content: Netflix has announced the opening of a limited-time cafe to celebrate the 10th anniversary of its popular original series, 'Stranger Things'. The event is part of the company's promotional efforts surrounding the milestone of the show. The cafe is designed to offer fans an immersive experience related to the series.

items.title: Netflix Identified as Most Impersonated Brand in Black Friday Phishing Scams
items.summary: A security report by Redbelt Security identifies Netflix as the most frequently used brand in suspicious websites targeting consumers ahead of Black Friday.
items.content: According to a survey by Redbelt Security conducted between November 10 and 19, 2026, Netflix is the brand most commonly impersonated in suspicious websites created for the Black Friday shopping period. The security firm analyzed over 7,000 internet addresses and identified 211 as potentially malicious, often using the Netflix brand to simulate payment update notifications to deceive users. This finding highlights the ongoing risk of brand impersonation in digital fraud campaigns during major retail events.

items.title: Ivanhoe Mines Partners with GeoIntelX and IGEO to Apply AI to Angolan Geological Data
items.summary: Ivanhoe Mines has entered into a collaboration with GeoIntelX and the Instituto Geológico de Angola (IGEO) to utilize artificial intelligence for analyzing over a century of historical geological data in Angola.
items.content: At the Angola International Mining Conference, Ivanhoe Mines announced a strategic collaboration with GeoIntelX and the Instituto Geológico de Angola (IGEO). The initiative aims to apply artificial intelligence to digitize and analyze more than 100 years of historical geological maps, reports, and physical records held in Angola's national archives. Ivanhoe Mines is funding the implementation of the GeoIntelX platform as part of its ongoing, large-scale copper exploration program in the country. The company currently conducts exploration across more than 22,000 square kilometres in Angola's Moxico and Cuando provinces through its wholly owned subsidiary, Cuando-Recursos.

items.title: BOYLE Casino Launches Playzia Games via Light & Wonder Aggregation Platform
items.summary: BOYLE Casino has integrated Playzia's gaming content into its platform using Light & Wonder's aggregation technology.
items.content: UK operator BOYLE Casino has launched games from developer Playzia through Light & Wonder's aggregation platform. The integration was supported by Hölle Games' remote gaming server technology. This partnership expands the availability of Playzia's portfolio, including branded IP content, to BOYLE Casino's players.

items.title: Director Adriana Cisneros Purchases Over $1 Million in AST SpaceMobile Stock
items.summary: AST SpaceMobile director Adriana Cisneros and her associated entities acquired over $1 million worth of company shares.
items.content: AST SpaceMobile director Adriana Cisneros purchased 21,250 shares of the company's stock, while a trust held by her acquired an additional 21,250 shares. Her spouse also purchased 1,064 shares, bringing the total acquisition to 43,564 shares valued at approximately $1.03 million. The transactions were disclosed in a filing published on November 24, 2026, and reported on November 26, 2026.

items.title: Owens Corning Expands Laminate Shingle Manufacturing Capacity
items.summary: Owens Corning has announced an expansion of its laminate shingle manufacturing capacity in the southeastern United States, with the new facility expected to be operational by 2027.
items.content: Owens Corning is increasing its manufacturing capacity for laminate shingles in the southeastern United States. The company expects the new facility to become operational by 2027. This expansion is part of a broader industry trend where manufacturers are responding to increased demand for advanced roofing products that offer enhanced functionality beyond basic weather protection.

items.title: Madrigal Pharmaceuticals Executive VP & Chief Commercial Officer Sells Shares
items.summary: Carole Huntsman, Executive VP & Chief Commercial Officer of Madrigal Pharmaceuticals, Inc., recently sold a significant portion of her stock holdings.
items.content: Carole Huntsman, the Executive VP & Chief Commercial Officer of Madrigal Pharmaceuticals, Inc., executed a sale of approximately US$1.4 million worth of company stock. The transaction was conducted at a price of US$1,388 per share and represented 70% of her total holdings in the company. This event is noted as part of the company's recent insider trading activity, which has seen various executives sell shares over the past twelve months, including a notable sale by CEO William Sibold.

items.title: Pershing Square Holdings, Ltd. Announces Share Buyback Transactions
items.summary: Pershing Square Holdings, Ltd. reported the repurchase of 14,360 of its own public shares on November 25, 2026.
items.content: Pershing Square Holdings, Ltd. announced that it repurchased 14,360 of its public shares on November 25, 2026, at an average price of $49.06 per share. The buyback included 11,640 shares of PSH and 2,720 shares of PSHD, all of which will be held in treasury. As of November 24, 2026, the net asset value per public share was $78.13, indicating the repurchase was executed at approximately a 37% discount to NAV. Following this transaction, the company has 172,022,159 public shares outstanding, excluding those held in treasury.

items.title: United Airlines to Launch Nonstop Service to Ljubljana in 2027
items.summary: United Airlines has scheduled a new nonstop flight route connecting Newark Liberty International Airport to Ljubljana, Slovenia, beginning in May 2027.
items.content: United Airlines is set to expand its international route network with the launch of a new nonstop service between Newark Liberty International Airport and Ljubljana, Slovenia. The service is scheduled to commence on May 12, 2027. This development was highlighted by the Slovenian Tourist Board as part of its 2027 travel initiatives to improve accessibility to the destination. The new route aims to connect the New York metropolitan area directly with the Slovenian capital.

items.title: CoStar Group Releases Market Data on Noho Office Leasing and Canadian Retail Forecast
items.summary: CoStar Group published new market data indicating a nine-year high in Noho office leasing and a positive rent growth forecast for the Canadian retail sector.
items.content: CoStar Group released proprietary data showing that office demand in the Noho submarket reached a nine-year high, with nearly 900,000 square feet leased in the 12 months ending September 2026. Additionally, the company issued a forecast for the Canadian retail sector, projecting it to lead commercial real estate rent growth among major asset classes through 2028. These reports highlight CoStar's ongoing role in providing analytics and market intelligence for the global real estate industry.

items.title: Hexaware Receives Guidewire 2026 Consulting Partner Outstanding Market Growth Award—EMEA
items.summary: Guidewire Software, Inc. recognized Hexaware Technologies with its 2026 Consulting Partner Outstanding Market Growth Award for the EMEA region during the Guidewire Connections 2026 event.
items.content: Guidewire Software, Inc. presented Hexaware Technologies with the 2026 Consulting Partner Outstanding Market Growth Award for the EMEA region. The award was announced at the Guidewire Connections 2026 conference in Las Vegas. This recognition highlights Hexaware's contributions to helping property and casualty insurers in the EMEA region accelerate their digital transformation and modernize core operations, including policy, billing, and claims management. Guidewire leadership noted Hexaware's momentum in expanding its Guidewire practice and strengthening customer relationships as key factors in the selection.

items.title: Report highlights environmental and safety concerns regarding Adani Green Energy's proposed Warasgaon-Warangi pumped-storage project
items.summary: A recent report discusses potential geological and safety risks associated with Adani Green Energy's proposed 1,500 MW Warasgaon-Warangi pumped-storage project in the Western Ghats.
items.content: The report identifies the proposed Warasgaon-Warangi pumped-storage project by Adani Green Energy as being located in a landslide-prone region of the Western Ghats. Experts cited in the article express concerns that construction activities, including blasting and tunneling, could destabilize slopes and increase geological risks for local communities and workers. The article highlights broader criticisms regarding the regulatory framework for pumped-storage projects, noting that current environmental oversight may be insufficient to address cumulative and climate-related risks in fragile mountain ecosystems.

items.title: Ford Announces Expansion of SUV Portfolio with Hybrid Territory
items.summary: Ford has announced plans to expand its SUV lineup with the introduction of a hybrid flex-fuel Territory model in 2027.
items.content: Ford is set to expand its SUV offerings with the launch of a new hybrid flex-fuel version of the Territory model, scheduled for 2027. This initiative is part of the company's ongoing efforts to diversify its vehicle portfolio with hybrid and flexible-fuel technologies. The announcement highlights Ford's strategy to meet evolving consumer demand for more sustainable and versatile vehicle options in the SUV segment.

items.title: Workday Expands Native Payroll Capabilities with AI-Driven Process
items.summary: Workday has introduced an AI-enhanced process for its native payroll solution, aiming to accelerate country-specific rollouts and improve efficiency.
items.content: Workday has implemented a new AI-assisted process to streamline the development and deployment of its native payroll software across international markets. By utilizing AI to handle initial tasks such as researching local requirements, building pay calculations, and generating documentation, the company aims to reduce the complexity and time required for country-specific payroll builds. Human experts in payroll and engineering are integrated into the workflow to verify AI-generated outputs and conduct automated testing. This initiative is intended to increase competitive pressure on standalone payroll vendors and support the company's expansion into new global markets.

items.title: DPC Dash Expands Domino's Pizza China Supply Chain Network
items.summary: DPC Dash, the master franchisee for Domino's Pizza in China, has scaled its supply chain infrastructure with a new facility in Wuhan to support ongoing store expansion.
items.content: DPC Dash, the exclusive master franchisee for Domino's Pizza in China, Hong Kong, and Macau, announced the opening of its fourth supply chain center in Wuhan, which became operational on August 21, 2026. The new facility integrates production, warehousing, and distribution to serve stores across Hubei, Hunan, Jiangxi, and Henan provinces, utilizing AI-based route optimization and 24/7 cold-chain monitoring. The company has also secured sites for two additional supply chain centers in Chengdu and Nanjing, targeted for 2027. As of September 30, 2026, DPC Dash operated 1,634 stores across 87 cities in the Chinese Mainland, representing a 24% increase from the end of 2025, and has secured its full-year target of approximately 350 net new store openings.

items.title: Lenovo and Formula 1 Expand Technology Partnership
items.summary: Lenovo provides Formula 1 with end-to-end technology solutions, including AI servers and high-performance computing, to support race operations and global broadcasting.
items.content: Formula 1 and Lenovo have deepened their partnership, with Lenovo supplying critical infrastructure to power the sport's high-speed race operations and global media delivery. The technology suite includes AI servers, Neptune liquid cooling systems, ThinkPad AI PCs, and mobile devices. These tools enable the processing of massive volumes of real-time telemetry data, facilitating improved race insights and reliable broadcast quality for fans worldwide. Beyond technical infrastructure, Lenovo also serves as a title sponsor for select events, integrating its brand into the sport's global commercial footprint.

items.title: Vale Enters Strategic Cooperation Agreement with XCMG
items.summary: Vale has entered into a strategic cooperation agreement with XCMG, a global construction machinery manufacturer, as part of a broader partnership initiative announced at bauma CHINA 2026.
items.content: Vale has entered into a strategic cooperation agreement with XCMG, a major global construction machinery manufacturer, as announced during the bauma CHINA 2026 exhibition. The partnership is part of a broader initiative involving multiple global partners to strengthen collaboration across the industrial chain. The agreement covers various international projects and applications, including those in Southeast Asia, Saudi Arabia, Uzbekistan, Spain, and East Africa. This collaboration aligns with XCMG's focus on intelligent and green construction solutions, including open-pit mining equipment.

items.title: Medtronic Hellas CEO Addresses Hospital Payment Delays in Greece
items.summary: Dimitris Nikas, CEO of Medtronic Hellas, highlighted significant operational challenges in the Greek healthcare sector, specifically citing payment delays and liquidity issues.
items.content: During a recent conference, Dimitris Nikas, CEO of Medtronic Hellas and President of the Association of Medical and Biotechnological Products (SEIB), addressed critical issues affecting the Greek hospital system. He reported that payment delays for medical supplies have reached approximately 250 days, leading to significant liquidity problems for companies in the sector. Additionally, Nikas noted that hospitals face challenges with unbilled supplies totaling 150 million euros and often lack visibility into their own material inventories. These comments underscore the operational and financial hurdles Medtronic and other medical technology firms currently navigate within the Greek market.

items.title: California American Water Announces 'Operation Gobble 2026' Thanksgiving Initiative
items.summary: California American Water, a subsidiary of American Water, partnered with the California Water Association to provide over $32,000 in funding to non-profits across the state to support families during the Thanksgiving holiday.
items.content: California American Water has launched its 'Operation Gobble 2026' program, a charitable initiative aimed at providing Thanksgiving support to families throughout California. In collaboration with the California Water Association, the company contributed more than $32,000 in funding to various non-profit organizations. This effort is part of the company's ongoing community engagement and corporate social responsibility activities.

items.title: TPG to Invest $100 Million in Student Mobility Company Zum
items.summary: TPG has committed a $100 million investment into Zum, a student transportation and mobility platform, to support its continued growth.
items.content: TPG is investing $100 million in Zum, a company specializing in modern student mobility and transportation solutions. This investment is intended to support Zum's ongoing expansion and operational scaling within the student transportation market. Zum has recently reported significant growth, including reaching adjusted EBITDA breakeven and achieving record revenue for the 2025 fiscal year. The company also noted a total contract value exceeding $2 billion, reflecting its increasing footprint in the sector.

items.title: Yum! Brands and Taco Bell Named in Negligence Lawsuit Over Foreign Object Incident
items.summary: A New Jersey resident has filed a lawsuit against Taco Bell and its parent company, Yum! Brands, alleging negligence after she reportedly choked on a rubber glove found in a burrito.
items.content: The plaintiff, Jurvany Damas, alleges that she suffered a physical injury requiring potential future surgery after consuming a burrito containing pieces of a rubber glove at a Taco Bell location in Union Township, New Jersey, in August 2024. The lawsuit accuses both the restaurant chain and its parent company, Yum! Brands, Inc., of negligence for serving food deemed unfit for human consumption. The plaintiff is seeking compensation for medical expenses, lost wages, and legal fees. The case highlights a specific liability claim against the company's operating practices.

items.title: CrowdStrike Joins Coalition for BT's 'Cyber Prepared UK' Initiative
items.summary: CrowdStrike is partnering with BT and other industry leaders to support a new nationwide cyber resilience training program for small businesses in the UK.
items.content: CrowdStrike has joined a coalition of partners, including the National Cyber Security Centre, Microsoft, and Google, to support BT's newly launched 'Cyber Prepared UK' program. The initiative is designed to provide immersive cyber-attack simulations and upskilling to help small businesses across the UK strengthen their digital resilience. BT has committed to delivering 100,000 hours of cyber resilience training by the end of 2028. The program will feature initial events in London, Newcastle, and Birmingham, with further sessions planned for 2027.

items.title: BlackRock Discloses Increased Voting Rights in ADTRAN Holdings
items.summary: BlackRock, Inc. reported an increase in its voting interest in ADTRAN Holdings, Inc. to 11.08%.
items.content: BlackRock, Inc. submitted a regulatory filing regarding its holdings in ADTRAN Holdings, Inc. The notification states that BlackRock's total voting rights in the company reached 11.08% as of November 23, 2026, compared to a previous notification of 10.16%. The current position is comprised of 8.93% in voting rights attached to shares and 2.15% through financial instruments. The filing was submitted as a voluntary group notification under the German Securities Trading Act.

items.title: Coca-Cola India Relaunches Gold Spot Beverage
items.summary: Coca-Cola India has reintroduced its iconic orange beverage, Gold Spot, in a new can format.
items.content: Coca-Cola India is bringing back the orange-flavored soft drink Gold Spot, historically known as 'The Zing Thing.' The product is being relaunched in a contemporary can format as a low-sugar beverage. The company is utilizing a quick-commerce-first distribution strategy, making the drink available through platforms such as Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart, Zepto, Flipkart Minutes, and Amazon Now. Gold Spot, which was originally introduced in India in 1952, became part of The Coca-Cola Company's portfolio in 1993.

items.title: U.S. Court Grants Janssen Preliminary Injunction Against Alvotech's Biosimilar AVT05
items.summary: The U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia has issued a preliminary injunction in favor of Johnson & Johnson's subsidiary, Janssen, regarding Alvotech's proposed biosimilar to Simponi and Simponi Aria.
items.content: On November 26, 2026, the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia granted a request by Janssen, a subsidiary of Johnson & Johnson, for a preliminary injunction against Alvotech. The injunction concerns AVT05, Alvotech's proposed biosimilar to Janssen's Simponi and Simponi Aria (golimumab). The court's decision relates to a manufacturing-process patent involving a filtration process. As part of the ruling, the court directed Janssen to post a bond to cover potential losses for Alvotech should the injunction be found wrongful. Alvotech has stated its intention to appeal the decision to the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit.

items.title: Afya Limited Shareholders Approve Merger with YDUQS Participações S.A.
items.summary: Afya Limited shareholders voted to approve a merger with YDUQS Participações S.A. during an Extraordinary General Meeting held on November 25, 2026.
items.content: At an Extraordinary General Meeting held on November 25, 2026, Afya Limited shareholders approved the company's merger with YDUQS Participações S.A. The resolution passed with approximately 91% of total shares in attendance and 99% of votes cast in favor. Under the terms of the merger, Afya will cease to exist as a separate entity, with all assets and liabilities transferring to YDUQS, which will serve as the surviving company. Shareholders also ratified the appointment of Apsis Consultoria e Avaliações Ltda. as the specialized appraiser for the company's net equity as of June 30, 2026. The transaction remains subject to customary closing conditions, including regulatory approval from Brazilian antitrust authorities.

items.title: METKA Lists on Euronext Athens with Metlen as Selling Shareholder
items.summary: Metlen Energy & Metals PLC's infrastructure subsidiary, METKA, has officially returned to the Athens Stock Exchange, with Metlen divesting 5 million existing shares as part of the offering.
items.content: METKA, the infrastructure and construction subsidiary of Metlen Energy & Metals PLC, has completed its return to the Euronext Athens exchange after a ten-year absence. The listing follows a public offering and private placement that generated total gross proceeds of 300 million euros. Of this total, 250 million euros resulted from a capital increase through the issuance of 25 million new shares by METKA. Additionally, Metlen acted as a selling shareholder, divesting 5 million existing shares to generate 50 million euros in proceeds. The company began trading under the ticker 'METK' with an initial valuation of approximately 1.25 billion euros.

items.title: Wells Fargo Releases 'Relief at the Grocery Store' Report
items.summary: Wells Fargo published a research report noting that major U.S. grocers have priced Thanksgiving meal kits at or below previous year levels despite rising wholesale costs.
items.content: Wells Fargo released a market research report titled 'Relief at the Grocery Store,' which analyzes current pricing trends for Thanksgiving meal kits. The report highlights that major U.S. grocers, including Walmart, have managed to keep prices for these kits at or below last year's levels. This pricing strategy persists even as wholesale costs for key ingredients like turkeys and potatoes have increased. The findings serve as an observation on retail pricing dynamics during the holiday season.

items.summary: Apple has removed the Talkie AI chatbot app from its App Store globally, citing concerns regarding child safety.

This action follows reports that data from the Chinese AI firm had been accessed by unidentified parties. The removal reflects Apple's ongoing enforcement of its App Store safety policies.

items.title: Apple to Open New Retail Store in Hyderabad, India
items.summary: Apple is set to expand its retail footprint in India with the opening of a new store in Hyderabad on December 10, 2026.
items.content: Apple announced plans to open its seventh retail store in India, located in the city of Hyderabad, on December 10, 2026. This expansion follows the company's recent growth in the Indian market, where it has already established a presence in cities including Delhi, Noida, Pune, Bangalore, and Mumbai. The company maintains existing research and development and customer care operations in Hyderabad. During its fourth-quarter earnings call, Apple reported record-breaking growth in India, highlighting the country as a key market for its hardware and services.

items.title: Morgan Stanley Releases Research on AI and Humanoid Robotics Commercialization
items.summary: Morgan Stanley published a research note detailing the outlook for humanoid robot commercialization and the integration of frontier AI models into robotics.
items.content: In a research note published on November 26, 2026, Morgan Stanley analysts projected that the commercialization of humanoid robots will likely occur on a smaller scale by 2027. The firm emphasized that adoption will depend on performance metrics such as productive hours, efficiency, and repeat purchases rather than aggregate shipment volumes. Additionally, the bank highlighted that recent advancements in frontier AI models, such as OpenAI's Astra 6.2, show significant improvements in task success rates and latency, supporting a layered architecture approach to robot control. Morgan Stanley identified several robotics companies, including UBTech Robotics, Geekplus, and Onerobotics, as potential contributors to next year's shipments.

items.title: DEKRA Expands Digital Trust Capabilities Through Strategic Collaboration with IBM
items.summary: DEKRA is expanding its cybersecurity and post-quantum cryptography capabilities through a strategic collaboration with IBM to help companies deploy new technologies securely.
items.content: As part of its 2026 performance review, global expert organization DEKRA highlighted its focus on 'Digital Trust' amid the rising adoption of artificial intelligence and connectivity. To support the safe deployment of new technologies, DEKRA is expanding its capabilities in cybersecurity and post-quantum cryptography. A key component of this initiative is a strategic collaboration with IBM. The partnership aims to provide companies with the confidence and security necessary to implement emerging technologies in a landscape of increasing digital risk.

items.title: Fresenius Kabi Launches Denosumab Biosimilars in Canada
items.summary: Fresenius Kabi Canada has launched its denosumab biosimilars, Conexxence and Bomyntra, which serve as alternatives to Amgen's reference products Prolia and Xgeva.
items.content: Fresenius Kabi Canada announced the launch of its denosumab biosimilars, Conexxence and Bomyntra, in the Canadian market. These products are biosimilar to Amgen's reference drugs, Prolia and Xgeva, which are used for treating osteoporosis and preventing bone complications in cancer patients. The biosimilars were approved by Health Canada in April 2026 for all indications of the reference products. This launch is part of Fresenius Kabi's broader strategy to expand its biosimilars portfolio and improve access to biologic treatments.

items.title: NVIDIA Orders Partners to Stop Server Shipments to ASEAN States
items.summary: NVIDIA has directed its partners to halt server shipments to countries within the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN).
items.content: NVIDIA has issued a directive to its partners to cease server shipments to ASEAN member states. The move follows ongoing scrutiny regarding export compliance and international trade restrictions. This action impacts the company's supply chain and distribution channels in the region.

items.title: S&P Global Ratings Places NVIDIA on CreditWatch Negative
items.summary: S&P Global Ratings has warned of a potential credit rating downgrade for NVIDIA, citing governance and management concerns.
items.content: S&P Global Ratings has placed NVIDIA on 'CreditWatch with negative implications,' signaling a potential downgrade from its current AA rating to AA-minus. The agency cited concerns regarding the company's board structure, executive oversight, and succession planning following the recent departure and subsequent return of CEO Jensen Huang. Additionally, S&P highlighted risks related to geopolitical exposure and potential export control violations. A downgrade could increase the company's borrowing costs, as it currently holds $32.5 billion in bonds within the U.S. high-grade corporate bond index.

items.title: Adobe Acrobat Recognized as Top AI Document Assistant for Business Teams
items.summary: Adobe Acrobat has been highlighted by Expert Consumers for its capabilities in PDF editing, summarization, and document productivity.
items.content: Expert Consumers has recognized Adobe Acrobat as a leading AI document assistant for business teams in 2027. The recognition focuses on the software's integrated artificial intelligence features, which facilitate PDF editing, document summarization, and overall productivity. This acknowledgment reflects the ongoing integration of AI tools into standard business document management workflows.

items.title: Goldman Sachs Releases Economic Outlook for Southern Europe
items.summary: Goldman Sachs published a research report titled 'Strong dynamics, new tests' analyzing the economic resilience and future growth prospects of Greece, Spain, and Portugal for 2027.
items.content: In its annual analysis of Southern Europe, Goldman Sachs economists highlight that economic activity in Greece, Spain, and Portugal remains more resilient than in the broader Eurozone. The report, titled 'Strong dynamics, new tests,' notes that while growth rates are expected to decelerate, they will likely remain above the regional average. The firm maintains an 'overweight' stance on Greek equities, projecting mid-teen percentage growth for 2027, supported by a favorable macroeconomic environment and strong credit expansion in the banking sector. Goldman Sachs also addresses potential risks, including the expiration of European fiscal support from the Recovery Fund, structural challenges, and political uncertainty surrounding upcoming elections in Spain and Greece.

items.title: Visa Launches New Version of Experimental AI Agent Wallet
items.summary: Visa has released an updated version of its Visa CLI experimental wallet, enabling AI agents to earn stablecoins for completing verified tasks.
items.content: Visa's crypto division has introduced an updated version of its Visa CLI, an experimental wallet designed for AI agents. The tool allows approved U.S. users with eligible Visa cards to register their AI agents in Visa's Agent Directory. Once verified, these agents can perform paid tasks such as market research, surveys, and gaming, earning stablecoins in the process. The initiative aims to integrate AI-driven automation into the digital payments ecosystem.

The filing, dated November 26, 2026, reports that BlackRock's total voting rights in the company reached 10.66% as of November 23, 2026. This notification is a standard regulatory requirement for institutional investors disclosing changes in their shareholding positions.

The agreement establishes a framework for cooperation between the technology company and the government agency. items.title: PepsiCo Romania Signs 10-Year Virtual Power Purchase Agreement with Rezolv Energy
items.summary: PepsiCo Romania has entered into a 10-year virtual Power Purchase Agreement (vPPA) with Rezolv Energy to source wind power for its local operations.
items.content: PepsiCo Romania has finalized a 10-year virtual Power Purchase Agreement (vPPA) with Rezolv Energy, securing approximately 13 GWh of wind power annually. The agreement supports the operations of two PepsiCo Romania entities: Quadrant-Amroq Beverages and Star Foods E.M. The energy will be sourced from Phase 1 of Rezolv's VIFOR wind farm located in Buzău County, Romania, which commenced operations in October 2026. This initiative aligns with PepsiCo's broader 'pep+' transformation strategy, which targets 100% renewable electricity by 2030 and net-zero value chain emissions by 2050.

items.title: AWS and Amazon CloudFront Support Global Launch of GTA VI
items.summary: Amazon Web Services (AWS) and its Amazon CloudFront content delivery network provided the infrastructure to support the massive global traffic demand for the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI.
items.content: Amazon Web Services (AWS) and its Amazon CloudFront content delivery network were utilized to manage the high-volume traffic associated with the global release of the video game Grand Theft Auto VI. During the game's pre-download and 18-hour staggered global launch, Amazon CloudFront handled significant traffic spikes, with peak game-related traffic reaching 122 Tbps. AWS reported that its embedded points of presence (POPs) achieved a 99.5% cache hit rate for game downloads, providing a more efficient distribution experience for players worldwide.

items.title: Amazon Responds to FTC Allegations Regarding 'Project Nessie' Pricing Tool
items.summary: Amazon has publicly addressed FTC allegations concerning its 'Project Nessie' pricing tool, stating the agency's claims mischaracterize the tool's purpose and function.
items.content: Amazon stated that the FTC's allegations regarding its 'Project Nessie' pricing tool are a gross mischaracterization of the technology. The company explained that the tool was designed to prevent retail price-matching practices from resulting in unsustainably low prices. Amazon further clarified that it tested the tool for several years but determined it did not function as intended, leading the company to scrap the project before the federal agency filed its lawsuit.

items.summary: GSK has received regulatory approval in China for Hibsago, a treatment for chronic hepatitis B.

items.title: Yinhawangka People and Rio Tinto celebrate landmark modernised agreement
items.summary: Rio Tinto and the Yinhawangka People have entered into a landmark modernised agreement to strengthen their partnership and land management collaboration.
items.content: Rio Tinto and the Yinhawangka People have officially celebrated the finalisation of a landmark modernised agreement. This agreement represents a significant update to the relationship between the mining company and the Traditional Owners, focusing on enhanced collaboration regarding land management and shared interests. The partnership is designed to foster a more sustainable and mutually beneficial framework for operations on Yinhawangka country. This development underscores the company's ongoing commitment to its social license to operate and its engagement with Indigenous communities.

items.title: Sony Joins UKRI-Funded Creative Industries Cluster in Eastern England
items.summary: Sony is participating as a technology partner in a £6.75 million UK Research and Innovation (UKRI) project designed to foster regional creative growth in Eastern England.
items.content: Sony has been named as a technology partner in a new £6.75 million creative industries cluster project funded by UK Research and Innovation (UKRI). The initiative aims to support regional creative growth in Eastern England by connecting universities with industry leaders to develop new capabilities, including a virtual production studio. The project is expected to create up to 500 skilled jobs in the region. Sony's involvement highlights its ongoing commitment to advancing virtual production technologies and collaborative research within the creative sector.

items.title: VDA President Open to BYD Membership
items.summary: The President of the German Association of the Automotive Industry (VDA), Hildegard Müller, has expressed openness to admitting BYD as a member of the association.
items.content: Hildegard Müller, President of the German Association of the Automotive Industry (VDA), stated that she is open to the possibility of the Chinese automaker BYD joining the industry association. The VDA represents the interests of the German automotive industry, and this openness signals a potential shift in the integration of Chinese manufacturers into established European industry bodies. No formal application or membership timeline has been announced.

items.title: Alibaba Updates Qwen-Audio-3.1 Model Suite
items.summary: Alibaba's Qwen team released a capability update for its Qwen-Audio-3.1 model family, significantly expanding multilingual support for speech recognition and generation.
items.content: On November 26, 2026, Alibaba's Qwen team deployed an update across its hosted Qwen-Audio-3.1 voice models, broadening language support for speech recognition and text-to-speech services. Hosted speech recognition (ASR) expanded from 30 to 59 languages, while text-to-speech (TTS) and duplex Realtime capabilities were also extended to 65 and 53 languages, respectively. While international language coverage increased, technical documentation indicated a reduction in documented Chinese dialect support from 16 to 8. The update was implemented without changes to standard hosted API rates.

items.title: Deutsche Bank Adjusts Bilibili Price Targets Amid Advertising Headwinds
items.summary: Deutsche Bank analyst Leo Chiang lowered price targets for Bilibili's U.S. and Hong Kong shares, citing slower advertising growth and economic uncertainty while noting potential upside from the company's games pipeline.
items.content: Deutsche Bank has revised its price targets for Bilibili, reducing the target for U.S.-listed shares to US$20 from US$32 and for Hong Kong-listed shares to HK$160 from HK$250. Analyst Leo Chiang indicated that while advertising headwinds are largely priced in, the adjustments reflect concerns regarding slower ad growth and broader economic uncertainty. Despite these challenges, the firm suggests that Bilibili's games pipeline offers potential earnings upside. Additionally, the analyst noted that market concerns regarding the impact of short-form dramas on user retention appear to be overstated.

items.title: Maybank Analysts Assess Impact of New U.S. Tariff Proposals on Asian Economies
items.summary: Maybank analysts provided an assessment of the potential economic impact of new U.S. tariff proposals on various Asian markets, noting potential risks and areas for negotiation.
items.content: Analysts at Maybank have released a note evaluating the implications of recent U.S. tariff proposals targeting 14 economies, including China, India, and Singapore. The bank highlighted that Vietnam faces the highest proposed duty, followed by India, China, and Singapore. The analysts noted that potential exemptions for sectors such as semiconductors and pharmaceuticals could mitigate the impact on countries like Taiwan, South Korea, Singapore, and Malaysia. Furthermore, the firm indicated that there remains scope for negotiations to lower overall tariff rates, though uncertainty is expected to persist into the first quarter of 2027 as USTR hearings are scheduled to begin in late January.

items.title: UniCredit Requests Extraordinary General Meeting to Overhaul Commerzbank Supervisory Board
items.summary: Following final regulatory approval for its takeover of Commerzbank, UniCredit has requested an extraordinary general meeting to replace nine of ten shareholder representatives on the German bank's supervisory board and proposes CEO Andrea Orcel as chairman.
items.content: UniCredit has officially requested that Commerzbank convene an extraordinary general meeting to facilitate a significant overhaul of its supervisory board. This move follows UniCredit's receipt of the final regulatory approval required to take control of its German rival, with the Italian bank set to hold approximately 47.6% of voting rights. UniCredit intends to replace nine of the ten current shareholder representatives on the supervisory board. Furthermore, the bank has proposed its CEO, Andrea Orcel, as a candidate for the position of chairman of the supervisory board, subject to election. Commerzbank has stated it will review the request in accordance with its legal obligations.

items.title: BNP Paribas Issues Post-Stabilisation Notice for IMA Industria Macchine Automatiche SpA Securities
items.summary: BNP Paribas announced that no stabilisation activities were undertaken in relation to the offer of securities by IMA Industria Macchine Automatiche SpA.
items.content: BNP Paribas, acting as a stabilisation manager, issued a formal notice confirming that no stabilisation activities were carried out regarding the offer of EUR 650,000,000 in securities issued by IMA Industria Macchine Automatiche SpA. This announcement follows a previous pre-stabilisation period notice dated November 17, 2026. The notice clarifies that the action was taken in accordance with the Market Abuse Regulation (EU/596/2014). The disclosure is for informational purposes and does not constitute an offer of securities for sale.

items.title: Tokio Marine Collaborates on Unified Service Platform for Commercial eVTOL Operations
items.summary: Tokio Marine & Nichido Fire Insurance is partnering with SkyDrive, Tobu Top Tours, Tobu Railway, and GMO Internet Group to explore a unified service platform for commercial eVTOL operations.
items.content: Tokio Marine & Nichido Fire Insurance Co., Ltd., a subsidiary of Tokio Marine Holdings, has joined a collaborative effort with SkyDrive Inc., Tobu Top Tours Co., Ltd., Tobu Railway Co., Ltd., and GMO Internet Group, Inc. The partners are exploring the development of a unified service platform designed to address operational challenges associated with the launch of commercial electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft services. This initiative aims to facilitate the commercial deployment of eVTOLs by integrating necessary support services. The collaboration leverages the expertise of the participating companies to create a comprehensive operational framework for the emerging eVTOL industry.

items.title: Brau Union Cartel Proceedings Update
items.summary: A request for the suspension of cartel proceedings involving Brau Union, a subsidiary of Heineken, has been rejected.
items.content: The Austrian authorities have rejected a request by Brau Union, a subsidiary of the Heineken Group, to suspend ongoing cartel proceedings. This legal development marks a continuation of the regulatory scrutiny facing the company's operations in the region. The proceedings remain active following the court's decision to deny the suspension motion.
