The announcement was followed by a significant positive market reaction for Kioxia shares.

items.title: Xiaomi Internet Launches Global Commercial Brand UMIADS
items.summary: Xiaomi's Internet Business Department introduced UMIADS, a new global commercial brand designed to assist partners with international advertising campaigns and growth.
items.content: At the 2026 Xiaomi Internet Business Partner Conference in Changsha, Xiaomi unveiled UMIADS, a global commercial brand aimed at helping partners plan and execute advertising campaigns. The brand leverages Xiaomi's device ecosystem, international market experience, and AI expertise to provide services across more than 100 markets. UMIADS offers system-level entry points and AI-driven tools to help partners reach audiences and make data-informed business decisions. The brand name signifies universal reach, marketing, intelligence, and innovation.

items.title: Hill & Smith Announces Changes to Remuneration Committee
items.summary: Hill & Smith PLC announced that Nick Anderson has stepped down from the Remuneration Committee, with Tony Quinlan appointed as the new Chair.
items.content: Hill & Smith PLC has announced a change to its board committee composition, effective November 26, 2026. Nick Anderson has stepped down as a member of the Remuneration Committee but will continue to serve as Chair of the Board and Chair of the Nomination Committee. Tony Quinlan has been appointed as the new Chair of the Remuneration Committee. The committee will now consist of Tony Quinlan, Carol Chesney, Pete Raby, Farrokh Batliwala, Gillian Tomlinson, and Sue Clark.

items.title: ITV plc Dividend Reinvestment Plan Transaction
items.summary: MUFG Registrars purchased ITV plc ordinary shares on behalf of a Person Discharging Managerial Responsibilities (PDMR) following the payment of an interim dividend.
items.content: Following the payment of an interim dividend on 24 November 2026, MUFG Registrars executed a purchase of ITV plc ordinary 10p shares on behalf of a PDMR. The shares were acquired at a price of 62.0145 pence per share under the company's Dividend Reinvestment Plan. This notification was issued in compliance with the EU Market Abuse Regulation.

items.title: Mitchells & Butlers Reports Fiscal 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Mitchells & Butlers reported its fiscal 2026 financial results, showing an increase in adjusted earnings and revenue alongside a decline in statutory profit before tax.
items.content: Mitchells & Butlers reported total revenue of £2.746 billion for fiscal 2026, a 1.3% increase from the previous year, with like-for-like sales growth of 2.1%. Adjusted operating profit rose to £332 million from £330 million, while adjusted earnings per share increased to 32.5 pence from 30.6 pence. Statutory profit before tax fell to £229 million from £238 million, impacted by £30 million in separately disclosed items, primarily related to a property valuation charge. The company attributed its resilient performance to disciplined cost control, Ignite efficiencies, and returns from its capital programme. Additionally, the firm reported that like-for-like sales in the most recent eight weeks grew by 1.1%.

items.title: Taobao Korea Monthly Active Users Surpass One Million
items.summary: Alibaba's Taobao platform in South Korea reached a significant milestone, with monthly active users exceeding one million for the first time, marking a 93.9% year-on-year increase.
items.content: Taobao's operations in South Korea have achieved a new growth milestone, with monthly active users (MAU) surpassing the one-million mark. This performance represents a significant year-on-year growth of 93.9%. The data highlights the platform's expanding reach and user engagement within the South Korean market.

items.title: NetEase LingDong Partners with LiuGong for AI-Powered Unmanned Excavator
items.summary: NetEase LingDong has entered a strategic partnership with LiuGong to launch the 922FE, an unmanned electric excavator integrated with AI technology.
items.content: NetEase LingDong and LiuGong have collaborated to introduce the 922FE, an unmanned electric excavator equipped with the Lingjue 2.0 World-Action-Modell (WAM) AI. This technology enables the machine to process natural language commands, perceive its environment, and autonomously plan excavation paths, avoid obstacles, and load trucks. The partnership was showcased through a live demonstration featuring coordinated operations between the 922FE and other autonomous machinery, including the 856TE wheel loader and the DT700CE electric dump truck. The initiative aims to demonstrate intelligent and environmentally friendly construction site solutions.

items.title: Norse Atlantic Airways Faces Potential Bankruptcy and Flight Suspension
items.summary: Norse Atlantic Airways has announced the suspension of all flights and is seeking short-term financing to avoid bankruptcy, with AerCap Holdings identified as one of the lessors of its Boeing 787-9 fleet.
items.content: Norse Atlantic Airways reported that it is suspending all flight operations as of November 26, 2026, and intends to file for bankruptcy if it cannot secure necessary short-term financing. The airline's fleet consists of 11 Boeing 787-9 aircraft, with AerCap Holdings and BOC Aviation identified as primary lessors. This development highlights AerCap's exposure as a lessor to the carrier's current financial distress.

items.title: Amigo Resources Appoints Vinay Sheoran as Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: Amigo Resources PLC has appointed Vinay Sheoran as its new Chief Financial Officer, effective December 1, 2026.
items.content: Amigo Resources PLC announced the appointment of Vinay Sheoran as Chief Financial Officer, effective December 1, 2026. Mr. Sheoran will join the executive leadership team and report directly to the CEO, focusing on leading the group's financial reporting, controls, and treasury functions. He will not serve on the Board of Directors. Mr. Sheoran brings over 20 years of experience to the role, including 15 years at EY, and will support the company's transition into commercial gold production in Tanzania.

items.title: Amigo Resources Announces GBP 2 Million Retail Capital Raise
items.summary: Amigo Resources PLC plans to raise GBP 2 million through a retail offer to support its operations.
items.content: Amigo Resources PLC has announced plans to raise GBP 2 million via a retail offer. The capital raise is intended to support the company's ongoing mining finance and exploration activities as it pivots toward commercial gold production in Africa. This financing initiative follows the company's recent strategic shift from its former lending operations.

items.title: James Latham plc Reports First Half Financial Results
items.summary: James Latham plc announced its financial performance for the first half of the 2026 fiscal year, reporting revenue of 219.3 million GBP.
items.content: James Latham plc has reported revenue of 219.3 million GBP for the first half of its fiscal year. The announcement provides a snapshot of the company's financial standing during this period. As a distributor of timber, panels, and decorative surfaces, these results reflect the group's operational performance in the UK and Ireland markets.

items.title: RentGuarantor Signs Partnership Agreements with Three Major UK Rental Operators
items.summary: RentGuarantor Holdings PLC has entered into new partnership agreements with Moda Living, Apache Capital, and Zenith Land Asset Management to provide rent guarantee services.
items.content: RentGuarantor Holdings PLC has announced the signing of partnership agreements with three significant UK rental operators: Moda Living, Apache Capital, and Zenith Land Asset Management. Through these agreements, the company will provide its rent guarantee services, which include property protection for landlords and housing access facilitation for tenants, to the operators' portfolios. These partnerships represent a strategic expansion of the company's service reach within the UK private rental sector.

items.title: NatWest Group Announces Strategic Goal to Quadruple Retail and Affluent Clients by 2030
items.summary: NatWest Group has set a new strategic target to significantly expand its retail and affluent customer base by 2030, aiming to increase its wealth management business's returns.
items.content: NatWest Group has announced a strategic objective to quadruple the number of its retail and affluent banking clients by 2030. The bank intends to focus on growing its wealth management arm, positioning it as its top-returning business segment. This initiative is part of a broader effort to enhance the bank's market position and profitability in the retail and wealth sectors.

items.title: Safestore Reports Higher Group Revenue for Fiscal Year 2026
items.summary: Safestore Holdings plc announced an increase in its group revenue for the 2026 fiscal year.
items.content: Safestore Holdings plc has reported higher group revenue for the 2026 fiscal year. The announcement, published on November 26, 2026, reflects the company's financial performance for the period. This disclosure provides insight into the company's operational results as a leading provider of self-storage solutions.

items.title: Cake Box Holdings plc Announces Interim Results for the Twenty-Six Weeks Ended 27 September 2026
items.summary: Cake Box Holdings plc reported its unaudited half-year results, highlighting a positive start to the second half of the year and a 5.6% increase in the interim dividend.
items.content: Cake Box Holdings plc announced its unaudited interim results for the twenty-six weeks ended 27 September 2026. The company reported a positive start to the second half of the year following challenging conditions in the first half. Management confirmed that full-year expectations remain unchanged. The results include a 5.6% increase to the interim dividend. Additionally, the company noted continued expansion of its store estate and strong growth in online sales.

items.title: First Property Group Reports Interim Results
items.summary: First Property Group plc announced its interim financial results for the first half of the fiscal year, reporting revenue of £3.6 million.
items.content: First Property Group plc has released its interim financial results for the first half of the fiscal year. The company reported revenue of £3.6 million for the period. These results provide an update on the group's financial performance and operational status for the first half of the year.

items.content: RBC Capital has updated its valuation for Shawbrook Group plc, raising the price target to GBP5.50. This adjustment was reported on November 25, 2026. The action reflects the firm's latest analyst assessment of the company.

items.title: SulNOx Granted US Patent for Fuel Oil Reclamation Technology
items.summary: SulNOx has received a patent in the United States for its fuel oil reclamation technology, marking its second intellectual property milestone in North America this month.
items.content: SulNOx announced that it has been granted a patent in the United States for its fuel oil reclamation technology. This development follows a recent announcement regarding a Canadian patent for the company's fuel-conditioning and emulsification technologies. The company stated that these grants strengthen its intellectual property protection across two of the world's largest energy markets. The technology is part of the company's broader portfolio of organic fuel conditioners and emulsifiers designed to improve combustion efficiency and reduce emissions.

items.title: Playtech CEO Mor Weizer Exercises Share Options
items.summary: Playtech CEO Mor Weizer acquired 21,820 ordinary shares on November 25, 2026, through the exercise of nil-cost options.
items.content: Playtech plc announced that CEO Mor Weizer exercised nil-cost options on November 25, 2026, to acquire 21,820 ordinary shares. These options were originally granted in 2016 under the company's Long Term Incentive Plan 2012. The transaction was conducted outside of a trading venue. Mr. Weizer intends to settle any resulting tax liabilities using personal funds rather than selling the acquired shares.

items.title: PDMR Wayne Hill Disposes of 154,414 Luceco Shares
items.summary: Managing Director Wayne Hill sold 154,414 ordinary shares in Luceco PLC between November 18 and November 24, 2026.
items.content: Managing Director Wayne Hill disposed of 154,414 ordinary shares in Luceco PLC through five trades on the London Stock Exchange. The transactions occurred between November 18 and November 24, 2026, at prices ranging from approximately £1.84 to £1.93 per share. The aggregate proceeds from the sale amounted to £289,266.48. This disclosure was made in accordance with the UK Market Abuse Regulation regarding director shareholdings.

items.title: Foresight Group Holdings Limited Announces Half-Year Results for Period Ended 30 September 2026
items.summary: Foresight Group reported a 10% year-over-year increase in total revenue to £84.6 million and an 11% increase in its interim dividend for the first half of fiscal year 2027.
items.content: Foresight Group Holdings Limited announced its financial results for the six months ended 30 September 2026 (H1 FY27). The company reported total revenue of £84.6 million, representing a 10% increase year-over-year, with recurring revenue reaching £72.0 million. Core EBITDA pre-SBP was £34.0 million, up 7% from the previous year, with a 40.2% margin. Adjusted basic EPS rose by 5% to 22.3p, and the board increased the interim dividend by 11% to 9.0p. During the period, the group raised £224 million into retail vehicles, secured A$75 million for ARIF and A$660 million in a continuation vehicle, and completed the sale of its public markets division. The company also continued its £50 million share buyback program, having executed £23.5 million to date.

items.title: Sintana Energy Completes Acquisition of Interest in Corcel's Block KON-16
items.summary: Sintana Energy has finalized its acquisition of an indirect 5% participating interest in the KON-16 block in Angola's Kwanza Basin from Corcel Plc.
items.content: Sintana Energy has completed the acquisition of an indirect 5% participating interest in Block KON-16, an asset held by Corcel Plc in Angola's onshore Kwanza Basin. The transaction, originally announced on September 10, 2026, involved a total consideration of US$2.5 million, consisting of a US$500,000 initial payment made in May 2025 and a US$2.0 million cash balance paid upon completion. In addition to the participating interest, Sintana will receive a net profit interest of 2.5% of Corcel's net proceeds from the block after first oil, which will reduce to 1.5% after aggregate payments reach US$50 million. Corcel continues to advance its operational plans for the block, including a 2027 exploration drilling campaign supported by recent 2D seismic data.

items.title: Lithium Africa Corp. Announces Acceptance of Mining Right Application for Springbok Project
items.summary: Lithium Africa Corp. has received formal acceptance from the Department of Mineral Resources for its Mining Right application covering 1,416 square kilometers at the Springbok Project in South Africa.
items.content: The company announced that its application for a Mining Right over 1,416 square kilometers of the Springbok Project has been accepted by the Department of Mineral Resources under section 22(2) of the MPRDA. The application, lodged on October 8, 2026, by the company's 70%-owned subsidiary Namli, covers a corridor containing at least 43 spodumene-bearing pegmatites. This area is a refined portion of the company's previously held Prospecting Right, designed to focus on the pegmatite corridor and streamline rehabilitation obligations. The company remains on track for targeted first production in the second half of 2027.

items.title: Dowgate Group Limited Increases Stake in Croma Security Solutions Group PLC
items.summary: Dowgate Group Limited has increased its voting interest in Croma Security Solutions Group PLC to 18.14% as of November 25, 2026.
items.content: Dowgate Group Limited, through Dowgate Wealth Limited, has filed a TR-1 notification disclosing an increase in its voting rights in Croma Security Solutions Group PLC. The firm's interest rose to 18.14%, representing 2,510,000 voting rights, up from the previously reported 17.96%. This change reflects an increase of 0.18 percentage points in the company's voting share. The notification confirms that the holding consists entirely of voting rights, with no financial instruments reported.

items.title: SkinBioTherapeutics plc Announces Posting of Annual Report and Notice of AGM
items.summary: SkinBioTherapeutics confirmed that its Annual Report and Accounts for the year ended 30 June 2026, along with the Notice of Annual General Meeting and form of proxy, were posted to shareholders on 24 November 2026.
items.content: SkinBioTherapeutics plc has officially distributed its Annual Report and Accounts for the fiscal year ending 30 June 2026 to its shareholders. Alongside these documents, the company provided the Notice of its Annual General Meeting (AGM) and the associated form of proxy. The AGM is scheduled to take place on 18 December 2026 at 10:00 GMT at the offices of Singer Capital Markets in London. Electronic versions of these materials have been made available on the company's investor relations website. This announcement serves as a procedural update regarding the company's annual governance and reporting cycle.

items.title: Genedrive plc Announces £1.23 Million Direct Subscription
items.summary: Genedrive plc has secured £1.23 million in new capital through a direct subscription of shares from existing and new investors.
items.content: Genedrive plc announced a direct subscription raising £1.23 million in aggregate from a mix of existing and new investors. The shares were issued at a price of 1.3 pence per share, representing a 72.4% premium to the company's closing share price on November 24, 2026. The company intends to use the proceeds to provide additional working capital and to accelerate the commercial adoption of its diagnostic tests in the UK and international markets.

items.title: Genedrive plc Publishes 2026 Annual Report and Notice of AGM
items.summary: Genedrive plc has made its 2026 Annual Report and Accounts available and announced the date for its upcoming Annual General Meeting.
items.content: Genedrive plc has released its 2026 Annual Report and Accounts on its corporate website. The company also confirmed that the notice for its 2026 Annual General Meeting (AGM) and hard copies of the report are being distributed to shareholders. The AGM is scheduled to take place on December 18, 2026, at the company's headquarters in Manchester.

items.title: Sintana Energy Files Interim Financial Results for Q3 2026
items.summary: Sintana Energy has released its interim financial statements and Management's Discussion and Analysis for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026.
items.content: Sintana Energy Inc. has filed its interim financial statements and the accompanying Management's Discussion and Analysis (MD&A) for the three and nine-month periods ending September 30, 2026. The filing provides the company's latest financial disclosures and operational context for investors. As a Canadian-based exploration company, Sintana continues to focus on the acquisition and development of high-impact hydrocarbon assets in emerging frontiers. The report includes standard forward-looking statements regarding the company's assumptions, potential risks, and operational outlook.

items.title: Sintana Energy Completes Acquisition of Indirect Interest in Block KON-16, Angola
items.summary: Sintana Energy has finalized its acquisition of a 5% indirect participating interest in the onshore Block KON-16 in Angola's Kwanza Basin.
items.content: Sintana Energy has completed the acquisition of an indirect 5% participating interest in Block KON-16, located in the onshore Kwanza Basin of Angola. The transaction, which follows definitive agreements announced on September 10, 2026, involved a total consideration of US$2.5 million, consisting of a US$500,000 initial payment and a US$2.0 million cash balance paid at completion. In addition to the participating interest, Sintana will receive a 2.5% net profit interest from Corcel's proceeds after first oil, which will reduce to 1.5% after aggregate payments reach US$50 million. Management characterized the acquisition as a strategic step in expanding the company's portfolio of high-impact frontier exploration assets. The block has recently undergone a 326 line-km 2D seismic program, which has confirmed prospectivity at both pre-salt and post-salt levels as the project moves toward a 2027 drilling campaign.

items.title: Tullow Oil Provides Operational Update
items.summary: Tullow Oil has released an operational update, including financial guidance for 2026 capital expenditure and free cash flow.
items.content: Tullow Oil issued an operational update on November 26, 2026, providing key financial and production targets. The company announced a 2026 capital expenditure guidance of $200 million and projected free cash flow for the year to be between $160 million and $210 million. Additionally, the company expects 2026 production to reach the upper end of its previously stated range of 34,000 to 42,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day. Management expressed confidence in the company's position to build on recent progress and create further value.

items.title: Altitude Group plc Announces Director Share Purchase
items.summary: Altitude Group plc reported that Chief Strategy Officer Martin Varley purchased 127,698 ordinary shares in the company.
items.content: Altitude Group plc, a provider of solutions for the branded merchandise industry, announced that its Chief Strategy Officer, Martin Varley, acquired 127,698 ordinary shares. The shares were purchased at a weighted average price of approximately 19.57 pence per share. Following this transaction, Mr. Varley's beneficial holding in the company increased to 10,222,979 shares, representing approximately 13.9% of the company's issued share capital.

items.title: Abingdon Health Provides Trading Update at Annual General Meeting
items.summary: Abingdon Health reported October 2026 revenues exceeding £1.0 million and expects improved second-quarter performance as customer programs resume.
items.content: During its Annual General Meeting on 25 November 2026, Abingdon Health plc announced that its second quarter for fiscal year 2027 has started positively, with revenues for October surpassing £1.0 million. The company anticipates that revenue for the second quarter (October–December 2026) will be significantly higher than in the first quarter, driven by the restart of several customer programs that had previously faced short-term delays due to reagent availability and specification updates. Management confirmed that the company's trading remains in line with expectations for the full financial year ending 30 June 2027.

items.title: Cavendish Capital Markets Appointed as Corporate Adviser and Broker to Time To ACT plc
items.summary: Time To ACT plc has appointed Cavendish Capital Markets Limited as its Corporate Adviser and Broker, effective immediately.
items.content: Time To ACT plc, an Aquis-listed specialist engineering group, has announced the appointment of Cavendish Capital Markets Limited as its Corporate Adviser and Broker. The appointment, which is effective immediately, formalizes external advisory and broking support for the company. The firm expects this partnership to enhance market liquidity, improve investor engagement, and support readiness for future corporate actions or capital raises. This engagement represents a new advisory mandate for Cavendish's capital markets division.

items.title: Oberon Capital Appointed as Joint Corporate Broker for Pathos Communications
items.summary: Oberon Investments Limited's trading name, Oberon Capital, has been appointed as joint corporate broker for Pathos Communications plc, effective immediately.
items.content: Pathos Communications plc has appointed Oberon Capital, a trading name of Oberon Investments Limited, to serve as its joint corporate broker. Oberon Capital will work alongside the company's existing corporate broker, Cavendish Capital Markets Limited. The appointment is intended to broaden broker coverage and enhance investor engagement for Pathos Communications. This development represents a standard corporate broking mandate for the firm.

items.title: Goldman Sachs Group Inc. Increases Holding in ASOS
items.summary: Goldman Sachs Group Inc. disclosed that it crossed a 3.215040% voting rights threshold in ASOS plc as of November 23, 2026.
items.content: In a regulatory notification dated November 25, 2026, The Goldman Sachs Group Inc. reported that it crossed a 3.215040% holding in ASOS plc on November 23, 2026. This position represents 3,868,468 voting rights, an increase from the previously reported 2.878006%. The holding consists of direct voting rights, voting rights via open securities lending, and a small number of voting rights held through a cash-settled swap.

items.title: Titan Partners Initiates Coverage of Arqit Quantum with Buy Rating
items.summary: Titan Partners' senior analyst Scott Buck has initiated coverage on Arqit Quantum (ARQQ) with a "Buy" rating and a $22 price target.
items.content: Titan Partners' senior analyst Scott Buck initiated coverage on Arqit Quantum (ARQQ) with a "Buy" rating and a $22 price target. The analyst's bullish outlook highlights the company's recent contract to provide secure networking services to NATO as a key indicator of commercial traction. Arqit's technology, including its Encryption Intelligence and NetworkSecure products, is positioned to address growing demand for quantum-safe security solutions. The company reported fiscal 2026 revenue of approximately $1 million, and management expects revenue recognition from three new Encryption Intelligence contracts to begin by late 2026 or early 2027.

items.title: ASOS Appoints Nigel Pocklington as Independent Non-Executive Director
items.summary: ASOS has announced the appointment of Nigel Pocklington as an Independent Non-Executive Director and Chair of the Remuneration Committee, effective from the conclusion of the company's upcoming Annual General Meeting.
items.content: Nigel Pocklington will join the ASOS Board as an Independent Non-Executive Director and Chair of the Remuneration Committee following the conclusion of the company's forthcoming Annual General Meeting. Pocklington, currently the CEO of Good Energy Group Limited, brings extensive experience in digital, commercial, and marketing leadership roles. His appointment is intended to support the alignment of executive pay with the company's strategy for sustainable profitable growth and long-term shareholder value. Christine Cross will step down from the Board at the same time, as she will not seek re-election.

items.title: Director Share Purchase
items.summary: Non-Executive Director Carolyn Rand purchased 2,936 ordinary shares in PCI-PAL PLC at a price of 85.75p per share.
items.content: On 25 November 2026, PCI-PAL PLC announced that Non-Executive Director Carolyn Rand acquired 2,936 ordinary shares at 85.75p per share. This transaction increases her total interest in the company to 19,066 ordinary shares, representing approximately 0.03% of the company's total voting rights. The notification was made in accordance with the requirements of the Market Abuse Regulation.

items.title: Savannah Resources Issues Tenders for Barroso Lithium Project Earthworks and Mining
items.summary: Savannah Resources has initiated the tendering process for bulk earthworks and mining contracts at its Barroso Lithium Project in Portugal, with contractor selections expected in the first quarter of 2027.
items.content: Savannah Resources has distributed tender packages to national and international engineering and contract mining firms for the Barroso Lithium Project. The company is currently hosting site visits for contractor representatives to assist in proposal preparation and anticipates finalizing selections in Q1 2027. This development is part of a broader pre-construction update that also includes the securing of a powerline licence from the Portuguese regulator DGEG and the addition of five new team members. Additionally, the company is advancing offtake negotiations, having already signed term sheets and targeting a second offtake agreement before the end of 2026.

items.title: Director/PDMR Shareholding: Anders Hedlund Purchases 2,000,000 Shares
items.summary: IG Design Group plc announced that Founder and Non-Executive Director Anders Hedlund acquired 2,000,000 ordinary shares in an off-market transaction.
items.content: On 24 November 2026, Anders Hedlund, the Founder and a Non-Executive Director of IG Design Group plc, purchased 2,000,000 ordinary shares of the company at a price of 97p per share. The shares were acquired from Malios Limited, a Liechtenstein-based entity connected to the Hedlund family. Following this transaction, the Hedlund family's aggregate interest in the company remains unchanged at 22,918,994 ordinary shares, representing 25.1% of the company's issued share capital. The transaction was disclosed by the company on 25 November 2026.

items.title: Court Rules in Favor of Deutsche Bahn in Commission Dispute
items.summary: The Higher Administrative Court of Düsseldorf ruled that Deutsche Bahn is not required to pay specific commissions to third-party ticket platforms, impacting companies like Trainline.
items.content: The Higher Administrative Court of Düsseldorf has overturned a decision by the Federal Cartel Office regarding commission payments for ticket mediation and booking services. The court ruled that Deutsche Bahn is not obligated to pay additional commissions to third-party distribution platforms, such as Trainline and Omio, noting that the railway operator already provides such payments. This ruling concludes a long-standing dispute over Deutsche Bahn's market power and its contractual relationships with competing ticket sellers. The decision is expected to influence the competitive landscape for digital mobility services in the region.

items.title: Angling Direct PLC Announces Director and Employee Share Option Exercises
items.summary: Angling Direct PLC reported that directors and employees exercised a total of 2,939,999 share options on 24 November 2026.
items.content: Angling Direct PLC announced that options over 2,939,999 ordinary shares were exercised by directors, including Non-Executive Chairman Andy Torrance, CEO Steve Crowe, and CFO Sam Copeman, alongside other employees. The exercise resulted in 604,732 net ordinary shares being transferred from treasury. Following these transactions, the company's issued share capital remains 77,267,304 shares, with 15,372,698 shares held in treasury and total voting rights of 61,894,606. The exercises were conducted at prices ranging from £0.21 to £0.375 and were largely net-settled to cover costs and tax obligations.

items.title: Navigator Gas Publishes Independent Valuation Report for Corporate Domicile Change
items.summary: Navigator Holdings Ltd. has made available an independent accountants' report by Grant Thornton UK Advisory & Tax LLP, a requirement for its planned redomiciliation from the Marshall Islands to England and Wales.
items.content: Navigator Holdings Ltd. announced the availability of an independent valuation report prepared by Grant Thornton UK Advisory & Tax LLP. This report is a regulatory requirement under section 593(1) of the UK Companies Act 2006, necessitated by the company's planned change of corporate domicile from the Marshall Islands to England and Wales. The redomiciliation is being executed through a merger structure where the company will merge into a subsidiary of a new parent entity, Navigator Gas plc. Upon completion of the merger, which is expected before the end of 2026, shareholders will receive ordinary shares in the new parent company. The full report is available to shareholders on the company's investor relations website.

items.title: CB&I Secures Five-Year North Sea Contract Extension with Serica Energy
items.summary: CB&I's Asset Solutions business has been awarded a five-year contract by Serica Energy for well delivery and well operatorship services in the North Sea.
items.content: CB&I, through its Asset Solutions business, has secured a five-year contract extension with Serica Energy. The agreement covers the provision of well delivery and well operatorship services for Serica Energy's operations in the North Sea. This contract continues the business relationship between the two companies, with CB&I providing specialized technical and operational support for Serica's upstream assets.

items.title: Kuala Lumpur Kepong Bhd Recognizes Significant Impairment on Synthomer Investment
items.summary: Kuala Lumpur Kepong Bhd (KLK) reported a RM1.61 billion non-cash impairment on its investment in Synthomer plc for the financial year ended September 30, 2026.
items.content: Kuala Lumpur Kepong Bhd (KLK) disclosed a non-cash impairment charge of RM1.61 billion related to its equity investment in Synthomer plc for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026. This impairment was a primary factor in KLK reporting a net loss of RM118.4 million for the year, a reversal from the previous year's profit. Despite the impairment, KLK noted that its quarterly performance was supported by lower losses from its Synthomer investment compared to previous periods. The disclosure highlights the financial impact of Synthomer's valuation on its major shareholders.

items.title: COMPASS Pathways Announces Partnership with Emyria for PTSD Clinical Trial
items.summary: COMPASS Pathways has partnered with Emyria to conduct a clinical study evaluating the efficacy and safety of its proprietary COMP360 psilocybin therapy in adults with PTSD.
items.content: COMPASS Pathways has selected Emyria to facilitate a clinical trial investigating the use of its proprietary synthetic psilocybin treatment, COMP360, for patients with post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). The study will be conducted at Emyria's Empax Centre in Leederville, Western Australia, with patient recruitment targeted to begin in December 2026, pending necessary HREC approvals and site activation. Emyria will manage the HREC approval process and site readiness. The collaboration is part of COMPASS's broader strategy to explore the therapeutic potential of COMP360 across various mental health conditions.

items.title: Form 8.5 (EPT/RI) Disclosure Regarding Pharos Energy Plc
items.summary: Shore Capital Stockbrokers Ltd. filed a Form 8.5 (EPT/RI) disclosure regarding its dealings in Pharos Energy Plc securities in connection with the offer by Ratio Petroleum Energy LP.
items.content: Shore Capital Stockbrokers Ltd., acting as an exempt principal trader, submitted a Form 8.5 (EPT/RI) disclosure concerning its dealings in the relevant securities of Pharos Energy Plc. The disclosure is made in relation to the ongoing offer period for Pharos Energy Plc, with Ratio Petroleum Energy LP identified as the offeror. The document details the purchases and sales of ordinary shares by the exempt principal trader, as required under Rule 8 of the Takeover Code. This filing provides transparency regarding market activity by connected parties during the offer process.

items.title: Oxford Biomedica Appoints Nawal Ouzren as Independent Non-Executive Director
items.summary: Oxford Biomedica has announced the appointment of Nawal Ouzren to its Board of Directors, effective January 4, 2027.
items.content: Oxford Biomedica plc has appointed Nawal Ouzren as an Independent Non-Executive Director, with her term set to begin on January 4, 2027. Ouzren brings over 20 years of leadership experience in the global biopharmaceutical sector, including her previous role as Chief Executive Officer and Executive Director of Sensorion SA. During her tenure at Sensorion, she oversaw the development of a clinical-stage pipeline, including gene therapy programs. Her background also includes senior commercial and strategy positions at Shire and Baxter/Baxalta.

items.title: Focusrite Chair Ian Barkshire Purchases 21,000 Shares
items.summary: Focusrite plc announced that Chair Ian Barkshire purchased 21,000 ordinary shares on November 25, 2026, at a price of 240 pence per share.
items.content: Focusrite plc reported that its Chair, Ian Barkshire, acquired 21,000 ordinary shares of the company on November 25, 2026. The shares were purchased at a price of 240 pence each, resulting in a total transaction value of £50,400. Following this acquisition, Ian Barkshire holds a total of 108,280 ordinary shares, which represents approximately 0.18% of the company's issued share capital. The transaction was disclosed in accordance with the UK Market Abuse Regulation.

items.title: Galliford Try Awarded £210 Million M5 Junction 10 Improvements Contract
items.summary: Galliford Try has secured a £210 million contract from Gloucestershire County Council to deliver the M5 Junction 10 Improvements Scheme.
items.content: Galliford Try has been awarded a £210 million contract to deliver the M5 Junction 10 Improvements Scheme for Gloucestershire County Council. The project aims to upgrade the junction into an all-movements interchange, enabling traffic to join and leave the M5 in all directions. The broader £372 million scheme is supported by funding from the UK Government's Housing Infrastructure Fund, administered by Homes England. The project is expected to facilitate the construction of over 20,000 new homes, including more than 7,000 affordable units, and support the creation of approximately 12,000 skilled jobs. CEO Bill Hocking noted that the contract strengthens the company's infrastructure project pipeline and aligns with its Sustainable Growth Strategy.

items.title: BGF Investment Management Increases Stake in Microlise Group plc
items.summary: BGF Investment Management has crossed the 10% voting rights threshold in Microlise Group plc, increasing its total holding to 10.000%.
items.content: BGF Investment Management, acting via Pershing Nominees, has reported an increase in its shareholding in Microlise Group plc. The firm now holds 11,513,095 ordinary shares, representing 10.000% of the company's total voting rights. This position reflects an increase from the previous holding of 9.930%, marking a 0.070 percentage-point change. The notification confirms that no voting rights are held through financial instruments and that the stake is aggregated across BGF group entities.

items.title: Crown PropTech Acquisitions Shareholders Approve Business Combination with Mkango Rare Earths
items.summary: Shareholders of Crown PropTech Acquisitions (CPTK) have approved the proposed business combination with Mkango Rare Earths Limited, moving the company closer to a potential Nasdaq listing.
items.content: At an extraordinary general meeting held on November 25, 2026, shareholders of Crown PropTech Acquisitions (CPTK) voted to approve the proposed business combination with Mkango Rare Earths Limited (MKAR). Each proposal received over 99.9% of the votes cast, with approximately 92.75% of voting power represented. The transaction remains subject to customary closing conditions, including Nasdaq approval of the initial listing application and the satisfaction of minimum cash requirements. Upon successful completion, the combined entity intends to list its common shares and warrants on the Nasdaq under the symbols "MKAR" and "MKARW".

items.title: Mkango Magnetic Materials Limited Announces Successful Completion of £7 Million Fundraise
items.summary: Mkango Magnetic Materials Limited has successfully completed a fundraise, generating £7 million (approximately C$13.2 million) through the issuance of 25 million new common shares.
items.content: Mkango Magnetic Materials Limited announced the successful completion of a fundraise that generated £7 million, or approximately C$13.2 million. The company issued 25 million new common shares as part of the offering, which saw strong demand from investors. Following the conclusion of a previously announced Capital Access Window, normal trading of the company's existing common shares resumed on November 25, 2026. The newly issued shares are subject to standard resale hold restrictions in Canada for four months and one day.

items.title: ODDO BHF AIF Public Limited Company Increases Stake in First Tin PLC
items.summary: ODDO BHF AIF Public Limited Company has disclosed an increase in its voting rights in First Tin PLC to 4.09%.
items.content: On November 25, 2026, First Tin PLC received a TR-1 notification indicating that ODDO BHF AIF Public Limited Company increased its total voting rights in the company to 4.09%. This position consists of 2.24% direct ownership via 12,140,000 shares and 1.85% economic exposure through 10,011,754 cash-settled CFDs. The holding represents an increase from the previous level of 3.16%, which comprised 2.24% direct ownership and 0.92% in financial instruments. The threshold was crossed on November 24, 2026, and the issuer was formally notified the following day.

items.title: HSBC Holdings plc notifies change in major shareholding in SSP Group PLC
items.summary: HSBC Holdings plc has reported that its voting rights in SSP Group PLC have fallen below the 5% threshold following the application of the trading book exemption.
items.content: On November 25, 2026, HSBC Holdings plc filed a TR-1 notification regarding its interest in SSP Group PLC. The notification states that HSBC's holding fell below the 5% reporting threshold, with the firm now reporting an applicable remaining holding of 4.906%. This change is attributed to the application of the trading book exemption under DTR 5.1.3R(4). The filing confirms that no reportable direct or indirect voting rights are held as a result of this exemption.

items.title: ACG Metals Limited Announces Results of Extraordinary General Meeting
items.summary: Shareholders of ACG Metals Limited approved the resolution to issue shares for the acquisition of Blue Moon Norway AS at an Extraordinary General Meeting held on 25 November 2026.
items.content: At the Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) held on 25 November 2026, shareholders of ACG Metals Limited voted to approve the resolution authorizing the directors to allot and issue 8,853,632 Class A ordinary shares. These shares will serve as consideration for the company's acquisition of 100% of Blue Moon Norway AS, which holds a 94.52% interest in the construction-stage Nussir copper mine in Norway. The acquisition is valued at a provisional purchase price of US$220 million. Admission of the consideration shares to the FCA Official List and the commencement of trading on the London Stock Exchange are expected on 30 November 2026, at which point the acquisition is scheduled to complete.

items.title: Elite Material Unit Purchases Production Equipment
items.summary: A subsidiary of Elite Material Co., Ltd. has acquired new equipment to support its manufacturing operations.
items.content: Elite Material Co., Ltd. announced that one of its units has purchased equipment for production purposes. The acquisition is intended to support the company's ongoing manufacturing activities. No further financial details or specific production capacities related to this equipment purchase were disclosed in the report.

items.title: Skanska Awarded $275 Million Data Center Contract in Georgia
items.summary: Skanska has secured an additional contract worth approximately $275 million (SEK 2.8 billion) to construct a new data center for an existing client in Georgia, USA.
items.content: Skanska has received an additional award from an existing client to build a data center in Georgia, USA. The contract is valued at USD 275 million, which corresponds to approximately SEK 2.8 billion. This project represents a continuation of the company's work in the data center construction sector, leveraging its expertise in complex infrastructure and building projects. The announcement confirms the company's ongoing involvement with the client on this specific development.

items.title: OLX Group Reports Financial Results for First Half of Fiscal Year 2027
items.summary: Prosus-owned OLX Group announced its financial results for the first half of the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026, showing significant growth in revenue and adjusted EBITDA.
items.content: OLX Group, a global online classifieds platform owned by Prosus, reported its financial performance for the first half of the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026. The company achieved revenue of $584 million, representing a 23% increase (13% organic) compared to the $473 million reported in the same period of the previous fiscal year. Additionally, the group's adjusted EBITDA grew by 30% (21% organic) year-over-year. These results highlight the continued operational expansion of the Prosus-owned classifieds business.

items.title: UniCredit Demands Extraordinary General Meeting Following Takeover Approval
items.summary: Following the receipt of final regulatory approval for its takeover, UniCredit has requested an extraordinary general meeting to overhaul Commerzbank's supervisory board.
items.content: UniCredit has secured the final regulatory approval required for its takeover of Commerzbank, having reached a stake of nearly 50 percent. Following this milestone, the Italian bank has formally demanded an extraordinary general meeting to replace nine of the ten capital-side representatives on Commerzbank's supervisory board. UniCredit intends for its own CEO, Andrea Orcel, to assume the role of chairman of the supervisory board. Commerzbank's management board has stated it will carefully review the legal requirements for the requested meeting and will convene the assembly if all statutory conditions are met.

items.title: Midea Building Technologies Showcases AIDC Cooling and HVAC Solutions at Big 5 Global 2026
items.summary: Midea Building Technologies presented its latest portfolio of full-stack AIDC cooling and commercial HVAC solutions designed for extreme climates at the Big 5 Global 2026 event in Dubai.
items.content: Midea Building Technologies (MBT), a division of Midea Group, showcased its advanced cooling and commercial HVAC solutions at the Big 5 Global 2026 exhibition held at the Dubai World Trade Centre. The company highlighted its commitment to addressing the challenges of extreme climates and high-density computing environments, particularly in the Middle East. The presentation focused on full-stack AIDC (Artificial Intelligence Data Center) cooling technologies, reflecting the company's strategic focus on supporting modern data infrastructure. This participation underscores Midea's ongoing efforts to expand its intelligent building technology segment globally.

items.title: Deutsche Bank Research Adjusts Deutsche Telekom Price Target
items.summary: Deutsche Bank Research has lowered its price target for Deutsche Telekom from 40 to 35 euros while maintaining a 'Buy' rating.
items.content: In a sector outlook published on November 26, 2026, Deutsche Bank Research analyst Robert Grindle revised the price target for Deutsche Telekom shares from 40 euros to 35 euros. Despite the reduction, the firm maintained its 'Buy' rating on the stock. The report noted that valuations for European telecommunications companies had declined to more attractive levels during the second half of 2026, citing potential for higher returns and operational stability as key factors.

items.title: Regulatory Approval for UniCredit's Stake Increase in Commerzbank
items.summary: Regulatory authorities have approved UniCredit's acquisition of a larger stake in Commerzbank, a move that grants the Italian bank control over mBank.
items.content: Regulatory approval has been granted for UniCredit to increase its stake in Commerzbank, which effectively provides the bank with control over mBank, the Polish subsidiary of Commerzbank. This approval removes the final obstacle for the transaction, with UniCredit planning to finalize the settlement of shares offered in its public tender offer by December 7. Following this, UniCredit's stake in Commerzbank is expected to exceed 47%, granting it sufficient voting rights to appoint candidates to the supervisory board.

items.title: Essity Launches Electric Freight Operations with Einride in Sweden
items.summary: Essity has partnered with Einride to implement electric freight operations in Sweden, aiming to reduce annual CO₂e emissions by approximately 72 tonnes.
items.content: Essity has integrated into Einride's electric freight network to support its sustainability goals in Sweden. The operations, which commenced in May 2026, utilize Einride's Freight-Capacity-as-a-Service model and proprietary Saga AI platform to optimize transport efficiency. The initiative is expected to lower emissions by an estimated 72 tonnes of CO₂e annually, with routes operating near residential areas in Falkenberg to provide immediate air quality benefits. Site leadership at Essity's Falkenberg facility noted that the partnership enhances operational efficiency while reducing the company's environmental impact.
