items.title: FASING S.A. Q3 2026 Consolidated Quarterly Report
items.summary: FASING S.A. published its consolidated quarterly report for the third quarter of 2026.
items.content: On November 25, 2026, FASING S.A. released its consolidated quarterly report for the third quarter of 2026. The filing provides updated financial information for the company, including the book value per share. This disclosure fulfills the company's periodic reporting requirements as a publicly traded entity.

items.title: Sensys Gatso Unit Wins Canadian Traffic Camera Deal
items.summary: Sensys Gatso Group AB has secured a new contract in Canada for traffic enforcement technology, valued at up to SEK 87 million.
items.content: Sensys Gatso Group AB has announced a new contract win in Canada for the provision of traffic camera systems. The agreement is valued at up to SEK 87 million. This development marks a significant expansion for the company into the Canadian market, further extending its global footprint in automated traffic enforcement solutions.

items.title: TF1 Selects Ateme as Technology Partner for Streaming Service
items.summary: French media group TF1 has chosen Ateme to provide technology solutions for its streaming service.
items.content: TF1 has entered into a partnership with Ateme to leverage the company's video compression and delivery software for its streaming platform. This collaboration aims to enhance the efficiency and quality of TF1's digital video distribution. The agreement positions Ateme as a key technology provider for the broadcaster's streaming infrastructure. The partnership was reported on November 25, 2026.

items.title: Herkules S.A. Publishes Financial Data via ESPI
items.summary: Herkules S.A. released financial information through the ESPI system on November 26, 2026.
items.content: Herkules S.A. disclosed financial data via the ESPI (Electronic Information Transmission System) on November 26, 2026. The report includes key financial metrics such as cash flow figures and earnings per share from continuing operations. This disclosure follows the company's standard regulatory reporting obligations.

items.title: 3R Games S.A. Publishes Q3 2026 Quarterly Report
items.summary: 3R Games S.A. released its quarterly financial report for the third quarter of 2026 on November 25, 2026.
items.content: 3R Games S.A. has officially released its quarterly financial report for the third quarter of 2026. The report, designated as 3/2026 Q, provides updated financial information regarding the company's performance during this period. This disclosure serves as a standard periodic reporting requirement for the company.

items.title: Smoltek Receives SEK 1.1 Million Grant for Battery Technology Development
items.summary: Smoltek Nanotech Holding AB has been awarded a grant of 1,120,000 SEK from Vinnova to advance the development and industrial validation of its carbon nanofiber technology for battery applications.
items.content: Smoltek Nanotech Holding AB announced it has received a grant totaling 1,120,000 SEK from the Swedish innovation agency Vinnova. The funding is designated for two projects focused on the development and industrial validation of the company's proprietary carbon nanofiber (CNF) technology for use in the battery sector. These projects are being conducted in collaboration with RISE (Research Institutes of Sweden) and Chalmers University of Technology. The initiative aims to leverage external research expertise and infrastructure to accelerate the evaluation and development of Smoltek's CNF technology for next-generation battery applications.

items.title: Hunter Group Subsidiary Increases Stake in Jacktel
items.summary: A subsidiary of Hunter Group ASA is set to increase its ownership in Jacktel AS to 92.5% following the completion of its cash purchase offer.
items.content: Following the settlement of its recommended cash purchase offer for shares in Jacktel AS, a subsidiary of Hunter Group ASA is expected to reach a 92.5% ownership stake in the company. This development follows the formal completion of the purchase offer, as reported on November 26, 2026. The transaction represents a significant consolidation of control over Jacktel AS by the Hunter Group entity.

items.title: Flekkefjord Sparebank Announces Bond Loan Expansion and Buyback
items.summary: Flekkefjord Sparebank has initiated a corporate action involving the expansion of an existing bond loan and a concurrent buyback.
items.content: On November 25, 2026, Flekkefjord Sparebank announced a regulatory action concerning the expansion of a bond loan and a buyback program. This move reflects the bank's ongoing management of its debt and capital structure. As the issuer, the bank provided this information through official regulatory channels. The announcement details the bank's strategic approach to its outstanding debt obligations.

items.title: Lleida.net Surpasses 20,000 Active Customers
items.summary: Lleida.net announced that it has exceeded 20,000 active customers as of November 2026, marking the highest figure in the company's history.
items.content: Lleida.net reported that its active customer base surpassed 20,000 in November 2026, representing a significant increase from the 2,700 customers it served during the pandemic. The company, which provides certified electronic notification and digital signature services, noted that it added over 7,400 customers since June 2026. Management attributes part of this growth to the implementation of Organic Law 1/2025, which requires proof of an attempt at out-of-court dispute resolution before filing civil or commercial lawsuits, a process for which the company's certified email service is frequently utilized. The company defines an active customer as a unique tax identification number (CIF or NIF) that may hold multiple user accounts.

items.title: Banca Sella S.p.A. Issues New Bond
items.summary: Banca Sella S.p.A. has issued a new bond with a total volume of 400 million euros, maturing on January 26, 2031.
items.content: Banca Sella S.p.A. has completed the issuance of a new bond with a total volume of 400 million euros. The bond carries a coupon rate of 3.7500% and is scheduled to mature on January 26, 2031. Interest payments are made annually on January 26. The issuance was reported on November 26, 2026.

items.title: Minesto Resolves on Rights Issue of Approximately SEK 130 Million
items.summary: Minesto AB has announced a rights issue to raise approximately SEK 130 million to fund commercial project development and working capital.
items.content: Minesto AB's Board of Directors has resolved to conduct a rights issue of up to 433,519,353 new shares, aiming to raise approximately SEK 130 million before costs. The subscription price is set at SEK 0.30 per share, representing a discount of about 30 percent to the theoretical ex-rights price. Shareholders of record on December 3, 2026, will receive five subscription rights for each existing share, with three rights entitling the holder to subscribe for one new share. The subscription period is scheduled from December 7, 2026, to December 21, 2026. The company intends to use the net proceeds to advance commercial arrays in the Faroe Islands and Ireland, implement technology advancements, and support general working capital needs.

items.title: Adler Group S.A. Announces Results for Nine-Month Period Ending September 2026
items.summary: Adler Group S.A. reported its financial results for the first nine months of 2026, highlighting solid rental performance and the successful refinancing of all 2026 debt maturities.
items.content: Adler Group S.A. released its financial results for the nine-month period ending September 30, 2026. The company reported a 3.5% like-for-like rental growth in its Berlin-focused portfolio, with an operational vacancy rate of 1.1%. Net rental income for the period was €96 million, down from €101 million in the same period last year, primarily due to portfolio disposals. The company confirmed its full-year 2026 net rental income guidance of €124–129 million. Additionally, Adler Group reported an income from operating activities of minus €13 million, a significant improvement from the minus €238 million reported in the prior-year period, and noted that all indebtedness due in 2026 has been refinanced.

items.title: JPMorgan Lowers Price Target on Novocure Ltd. (NVCR)
items.summary: JPMorgan has adjusted its price target for Novocure Ltd. (NVCR), lowering it to $13.
items.content: On November 25, 2026, JPMorgan updated its outlook on Novocure Ltd. (NVCR), reducing the price target for the company's stock to $13. This adjustment reflects the firm's latest analysis of the company's valuation and market position. The update was reported as part of a broader series of analyst price target revisions.

items.title: FIPP Announces Availability of Preparatory Documents for Ordinary General Meeting
items.summary: FIPP has made the preparatory documents for its upcoming Ordinary General Meeting, scheduled for December 16, 2026, available to the public.
items.content: The company announced that it has made the preparatory documents for the Ordinary General Meeting (AGO) to be held on December 16, 2026, available to the public. This disclosure is in accordance with the requirements of Article R.22-10-23 of the French Commercial Code. Interested parties can access these documents on the company's official website under the 'regulated information' section in the 'general meetings' tab.

items.title: Valbiotis Launches Product Sales in China Under Laviela Brand
items.summary: Valbiotis has officially commenced the sale of its cardiometabolic health products in China through its Laviela brand, utilizing cross-border e-commerce channels.
items.content: Valbiotis has initiated sales of its products in China under the Laviela brand, marking a significant step in its Asian market expansion strategy. The products are marketed by Hangzhou Valbiotis Life Health Technology Co. Ltd., a joint venture 49%-owned by Valbiotis and 51%-owned by the Chinese group Aika. The launch utilizes cross-border e-commerce (CBEC) platforms, specifically Tmall Global, with plans to expand to Douyin in the near future. This development fulfills the agreement signed with Aika in November 2025 and follows the registration of three products in Hong Kong and Singapore. The company intends to continue expanding its range in Asia by identifying local market opportunities and developing products tailored to regional health needs.

items.title: Wolftank Group Reports 9-Month 2026 Financial Results and New Maintenance Contract
items.summary: Wolftank Group AG announced a 15.2% revenue increase for the first nine months of 2026 and confirmed its full-year guidance, alongside securing a new four-year maintenance contract worth up to EUR 22.3 million.
items.content: Wolftank Group AG reported a revenue of EUR 104.5 million for the first nine months of 2026, representing a 15.2% increase compared to the same period in 2025. The company achieved an EBITDA of EUR 6.8 million, resulting in an EBITDA margin of 6.5%, a significant improvement from the EUR -0.5 million EBITDA reported in the prior-year period. Despite a challenging economic environment characterized by high energy and transport costs, the company confirmed its full-year 2026 guidance of approximately EUR 135 million in revenue and an EBITDA margin of 6-7%. Additionally, the company announced it secured a four-year maintenance contract in the environmental services segment with an estimated maximum value of EUR 22.3 million, covering operations in the Italian regions of Campania, Lazio, Umbria, and Tuscany starting November 1, 2026.

items.title: Sonae Group's MC Deploys StrongPoint Order Picking Solution
items.summary: Sonae Group's retail division, MC, has implemented StrongPoint's order picking technology across its Continente and Wells store locations.
items.content: Sonae Group's MC has deployed StrongPoint's proprietary order picking solution to enhance e-commerce operations across its Continente and Wells retail banners. This implementation is part of the retailer's efforts to improve store efficiency and streamline the fulfillment process for online orders. StrongPoint continues to serve as a key technology partner for grocery retailers in the region, providing integrated hardware and software solutions. The deployment underscores the ongoing adoption of StrongPoint's retail technology suite in the European market.

items.title: Class Editori Presents MF GPT at Salone dei Pagamenti
items.summary: Class Editori is showcasing its generative AI tool, MF GPT, at the 11th edition of the Salone dei Pagamenti in Milan.
items.content: During the Salone dei Pagamenti event in Milan, Class Editori is presenting MF GPT, an autonomous generative artificial intelligence tool designed for economic and financial information. The system is built on forty years of financial data from the company's editorial teams, including MF-Milano Finanza and Class CNBC, and is designed to provide verified, source-cited responses, reports, and data analysis. The presentation includes a live demonstration of how the AI assists investors and businesses in navigating complex financial topics such as digital currencies and instant payments.

items.title: ZREMB-CHOJNICE S.A. Signs Term Sheet for Major Defense Industry Contract
items.summary: ZREMB-CHOJNICE S.A. has entered into a term sheet for the future supply of specialized containers to a major defense contractor in a NATO country, with an expected contract value exceeding 100 million PLN.
items.content: On November 25, 2026, ZREMB-CHOJNICE S.A. announced the signing of a term sheet regarding the future delivery of partially equipped containers to a major entity in the defense and armaments sector located in a NATO country. The parties intend for the final contract to result in remuneration for the company exceeding 100,000,000 PLN. This agreement outlines the preliminary conditions for the future supply arrangement. The company disclosed this development through an official regulatory filing.

items.title: Thor Medical Pauses Commercial Ramp-up of Norwegian Production Facility
items.summary: Thor Medical has announced a pause in the commercial ramp-up of its production facility in Norway.
items.content: Thor Medical has decided to pause the commercial ramp-up of its production facility located in Norway. This operational decision marks a shift in the company's immediate production strategy. The company, which specializes in the production of alpha-particle emitters for cancer therapy, had previously been working toward scaling its operations. The announcement reflects a change in the company's current development timeline for its production capabilities.

items.title: FluoGuide A/S Publishes Interim Report for Q3 2026
items.summary: FluoGuide A/S released its financial results for the period of January 1, 2026, to September 30, 2026, and highlighted progress in its clinical development programs.
items.content: FluoGuide A/S has published its interim report for the third quarter of 2026, covering the period from January 1 to September 30, 2026. Alongside the financial results, the company reported a key operational milestone: the enrollment of the first patient in the CT-006 clinical trial for high-grade glioma. This study is one of two trials intended to support the New Drug Application (NDA) for the company's lead product, FG001. CEO Morten Albrechtsen stated that the company's primary focus is to succeed in the high-grade glioma program, noting that the study design has been directionally aligned with the FDA.

items.title: Hopscotch Groupe Monthly Voting Rights and Shares Disclosure
items.summary: Hopscotch Groupe has released its monthly disclosure regarding the total number of voting rights and shares comprising its share capital as of the end of October 2026.
items.content: Hopscotch Groupe published its mandatory monthly declaration detailing the total number of shares and voting rights associated with its share capital. The disclosure provides the total number of voting rights attached to the total number of shares, adjusted for shares deprived of voting rights such as treasury shares. This filing is a routine regulatory requirement for listed companies in France.

items.title: Gabriel Holding A/S Announces Annual General Meeting
items.summary: Gabriel Holding A/S has issued a notice for its Annual General Meeting to be held on December 16, 2026.
items.content: The Annual General Meeting of Gabriel Holding A/S is scheduled for December 16, 2026, at the company's headquarters in Aalborg, Denmark. The agenda includes the approval of the 2025/26 annual report, an advisory vote on the remuneration report, and the approval of a dividend of DKK 7.00 per share. Shareholders are required to register at least three days prior to the meeting to attend.

items.title: Eniro Group AB Announces Nomination Committee for 2027 Annual General Meeting
items.summary: Eniro Group AB has provided information regarding the formation of its Nomination Committee in preparation for the 2027 Annual General Meeting.
items.content: Eniro Group AB has formally announced the composition and establishment of its Nomination Committee ahead of the company's 2027 Annual General Meeting. This is a standard corporate governance procedure where the committee is tasked with preparing proposals for the board of directors and auditor elections. The announcement follows the company's established governance practices for shareholder representation.

items.title: Gabriel Holding A/S Reports Financial Results and Operational Progress
items.summary: Gabriel Holding A/S announced revenue growth for its continuing operations and provided an update on the divestment of its FurnMaster business units.
items.content: Gabriel Holding A/S reported revenue of DKK 538.7 million for its continuing operations, a 4% increase compared to the previous year, with fourth-quarter revenue growing by 13% to DKK 142.4 million. The company continues to focus on its core business of high-quality furniture fabrics while progressing with the divestment of its FurnMaster business units. European activities have been sold, and the North American units are currently held for sale with an expected divestment in the near term. Management attributes the growth to a strengthened global market position and market share gains across Europe, North America, and Asia.

items.title: Medicalgorithmics S.A. Publishes Financial Results
items.summary: Medicalgorithmics S.A. released its latest financial report, detailing key figures including share capital and equity attributable to shareholders.
items.content: Medicalgorithmics S.A. published its financial results on November 26, 2026. The report discloses key financial metrics, including equity attributable to the parent company's shareholders, which reached 77,714,000 PLN compared to 64,621,000 PLN in the prior period. The company also reported a share capital of 1,045,000 PLN and a total of 10,453,389 shares. The book value per ordinary share was reported at 7.43 PLN.

items.title: Lytix Biopharma ASA: Mandatory notification of trade by close associate of primary insider
items.summary: Lytix Biopharma announced the settlement of a share loan involving Saturn Invest AS, a close associate of board member Brynjar Forbergskog, following the completion of the company's recent private placement and retail offering.
items.content: Lytix Biopharma ASA reported that a share loan agreement, established to facilitate the settlement of shares from its recent private placement and retail offering, has been concluded. Saturn Invest AS, a close associate of board member Brynjar Forbergskog, had previously lent 1,118,247 existing shares to DNB Carnegie to support delivery-versus-payment settlement. Following the settlement, these shares were redelivered to Saturn Invest AS. Including the 2,661,535 offer shares allocated to Saturn Invest AS in the private placement, the entity now holds a total of 9,369,336 shares in the company.

items.title: Echo Investment issues bonds under program arranged by IPOPEMA Securities
items.summary: Echo Investment S.A. completed a bond issuance under a program established in cooperation with IPOPEMA Securities S.A.
items.content: Echo Investment S.A. issued 10,000 series 9I/2026 bonds with a total nominal value of 100 million PLN. The issuance was conducted under a bond program established in collaboration with IPOPEMA Securities S.A., which serves as the arranger. The bonds are unsecured, carry a variable interest rate based on WIBOR 6M plus a margin, and have a maturity date of May 11, 2029.

items.title: Zelluna ASA Proposes New Board Leadership Ahead of Extraordinary General Meeting
items.summary: Zelluna ASA has called for an Extraordinary General Meeting on December 18, 2026, to elect Adrian Woolfson as the new Chair of the Board and Nerida Scott as a new board member.
items.content: The Board of Directors of Zelluna ASA has announced an Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) scheduled for December 18, 2026, to strengthen its leadership team. The Nomination Committee has proposed Adrian Woolfson, an experienced biopharma executive, to serve as the new Chair of the Board, while Nerida Scott is proposed as a new board member. Current Chair and co-founder Anders Tuv will remain on the Board. This leadership transition is intended to support the company's next phase of growth as it advances its allogeneic TCR-NK cell therapy platform from preclinical development into clinical trials. The company is prioritizing candidates with strong international networks and expertise in strategic partnerships and global pharmaceutical transactions.

items.title: Rejlers Signs Framework Agreement with European Spallation Source
items.summary: Rejlers has been awarded a framework agreement to provide services to the European Spallation Source (ESS) research facility in Lund, Sweden.
items.content: Rejlers has entered into a new framework agreement with the European Spallation Source (ESS), a major research facility located in Lund, Sweden. The agreement involves the provision of technical and engineering consultancy services to support the facility's operations. This contract represents a new partnership between the engineering consultancy firm and the research institution. No specific financial terms or duration details were disclosed in the initial reports.

items.title: Equita Group Acquires Xenon Private Equity
items.summary: Equita Group has acquired Xenon Private Equity for 70 million euros, doubling its assets under management to over 2.4 billion euros.
items.content: Equita Group has announced the acquisition of Xenon Private Equity in a deal valued at 70 million euros. This strategic move is expected to double the group's assets under management to more than 2.4 billion euros and triple its annual management fees. The transaction is projected to increase the group's recurring revenue component and contribute an average of over 7 million euros annually to Equita's net profit, with an accretive impact on earnings per share anticipated between 2027 and 2029.

items.title: ONWARD Medical to Present at the Piper Sandler 38th Annual Healthcare Conference
items.summary: ONWARD Medical N.V. announced that it will participate in the Piper Sandler 38th Annual Healthcare Conference, where CEO Dave Marver will provide an update on the company's spinal cord stimulation technology platforms.
items.content: ONWARD Medical N.V. announced its participation in the upcoming Piper Sandler 38th Annual Healthcare Conference. During the event, CEO Dave Marver is scheduled to provide a general update on the company's proprietary ARC Therapy spinal cord stimulation technology platforms on Wednesday, December 2, 2026. In addition to the presentation, which will be accessible via the company's investor relations website, the company will host in-person meetings. ONWARD Medical continues to advance its ARC-EX® System, which is commercially available in the US and Europe, and its investigational ARC-IM® implantable system.

items.title: AlzeCure Pharma to Present at ABGSC Investor Days on December 3
items.summary: AlzeCure Pharma announced its participation in the upcoming ABGSC Investor Days, where CEO Johan Sandin will provide a company presentation.
items.content: AlzeCure Pharma AB (publ) announced that it will participate in the ABGSC Investor Days event scheduled for December 3, 2026. During the event, CEO Johan Sandin is set to deliver a company presentation and address questions regarding the company's latest developments and future strategic plans. The presentation is scheduled for 10:30 CET at Hotel At Six in Stockholm and will be available to follow via a live stream on the ABGSC website.

items.title: SP Group Reports 2025/26 Financial Results and 2026/27 Outlook
items.summary: SP Group announced growth in revenue and profit for the 2025/26 financial year and provided financial guidance for the upcoming 2026/27 period.
items.content: SP Group reported growth in its continuing business operations for the 2025/26 financial year, with revenue increasing by 4% and operating profit (EBIT) growing by 17% to DKK 51.5 million. The company's EBITDA reached DKK 94.5 million, up from DKK 83.7 million in the previous year. Management expects this positive momentum to continue into the 2026/27 financial year, projecting revenue between DKK 550-585 million and an operating profit (EBIT) of DKK 52-59 million. The company attributed its performance to strengthened global market positioning and market share gains across its European, North American, and Asian markets. Additionally, the company noted that the divestment of its FurnMaster business is ongoing, with the Mexican furniture manufacturing unit currently classified as discontinued operations.

items.title: Equnico SE Reports Share Transaction by Closely Associated Person
items.summary: Equnico SE issued a regulatory disclosure regarding a transaction conducted by an entity closely associated with a person performing managerial duties.
items.content: On November 25, 2026, Equnico SE published report 76/2026, notifying the market of a transaction concluded by a person closely associated with a member of the company's management. The disclosure pertains to transactions executed by DKW Polska OÜ, a major shareholder associated with the company's CEO, Krzysztof Długosz. This filing is a standard regulatory requirement under the company's reporting obligations.

items.title: Terranor Group Appoints Frida Frykstrand as New CFO
items.summary: Terranor Group AB (publ) has announced the appointment of Frida Frykstrand as its new Chief Financial Officer.
items.content: Terranor Group has officially appointed Frida Frykstrand to the position of Chief Financial Officer. This executive change represents a key leadership update for the Nordic infrastructure and road maintenance company. The appointment was reported via Cision News on November 26, 2026.

items.title: Western Bulk Chartering AS Announces Extraordinary General Meeting
items.summary: Western Bulk Chartering AS has issued a notice for an Extraordinary General Meeting, as reported in regulated market disclosures.
items.content: Western Bulk Chartering AS has published a notice regarding an Extraordinary General Meeting. The event was disclosed as regulated information on November 25, 2026. This notice serves as the formal announcement for the upcoming meeting of shareholders.

items.title: UBM Development Reports Q3 2026 Financial Performance
items.summary: UBM Development AG reported a positive earnings trend for the first three quarters of 2026, marking its sixth consecutive quarter of positive results.
items.content: UBM Development AG announced its financial results for the first nine months of 2026, highlighting a significant earnings recovery with an EBT of EUR 8.2 million compared to a loss of EUR 3.9 million in the same period last year. The company achieved a consolidated net profit of EUR 6.9 million and increased its total output by 9.0% to EUR 238.0 million, despite a challenging market environment. UBM sold 312 apartments during this period and maintained a strong financial profile, with an equity ratio of 37%, exceeding its target range of 30% to 35%. Additionally, the company successfully issued a EUR 58 million green bond in October 2026 to further strengthen its capital structure.

items.title: Innate Pharma Releases 2027 Financial Calendar
items.summary: Innate Pharma S.A. has published its scheduled financial reporting dates and annual general meeting for the 2027 calendar year.
items.content: Innate Pharma S.A. has released its financial calendar for 2027, outlining key dates for the upcoming year. The company plans to publish its 2026 financial statements on March 31, 2027, followed by the release of its first-quarter 2027 revenue and cash position on May 12, 2027. The Annual General Meeting of Shareholders is scheduled for May 19, 2027. Additionally, the company expects to release its half-year financial statements on September 16, 2027, and its third-quarter 2027 revenue and cash position on November 3, 2027. These reports are scheduled to be released prior to the opening of trading on Euronext Paris and Nasdaq.

items.title: AFYREN Achieves Top Global Ranking in EthiFinance ESG Assessment
items.summary: AFYREN has been ranked first globally in the Chemicals category by EthiFinance, achieving an ESG score of 84/100 and maintaining its Platinum rating.
items.content: AFYREN announced that it received an ESG score of 84/100 from EthiFinance, representing a four-point increase from the previous year. With this score, the company maintained its Platinum rating and secured the top global position in the Chemicals category. The assessment, which aligns with CSRD requirements, recognized AFYREN's performance across environmental, social, and governance criteria. Caroline Petigny, the company's Chief Sustainability Officer, noted that this ranking highlights the company's progress in transforming an industry traditionally dependent on fossil resources. The company also holds notable positions in broader rankings, including 15th among French companies and 3rd among global firms in the Materials sector.

items.title: CI Games SE Announces Expiry of Registered Pledge on Shares Held by CEO
items.summary: CI Games SE received notification from its President of the Management Board, Marek Tymiński, regarding the expiration of a registered pledge on his company shares.
items.content: On November 25, 2026, CI Games SE announced that it received a formal notification from its President of the Management Board, Marek Tymiński, concerning the expiry of a registered pledge previously established by him over the shares he holds in the company. The notification was submitted in accordance with Article 19 of the Market Abuse Regulation (MAR). This disclosure provides transparency regarding the status of the CEO's shareholdings and the removal of the encumbrance.

items.title: Rafamet S.A. in Restructuring Convenes Extraordinary General Meeting
items.summary: The management board of Rafamet S.A. in restructuring has officially called an Extraordinary General Meeting to be held on December 21, 2026.
items.content: Following a request from its majority shareholder, Agencja Rozwoju Przemysłu S.A., the management board of Rafamet S.A. in restructuring has convened an Extraordinary General Meeting for December 21, 2026. The meeting is scheduled to take place at the company's headquarters in Kuźnia Raciborska. The agenda includes the adoption of resolutions regarding the establishment of remuneration rules for members of the Management Board and the Supervisory Board, as well as the approval of costs associated with the meeting. The company has provided the necessary documentation and draft resolutions to the public in accordance with regulatory requirements.

items.title: Sanok Rubber Company Announces Share Buyback Invitation
items.summary: Sanok Rubber Company S.A. has invited shareholders to submit offers for the sale of up to 1,141,400 company shares at a price of 20.00 PLN per share.
items.content: Sanok Rubber Company S.A. has launched a share buyback program for the purpose of cancellation, inviting shareholders to tender up to 1,141,400 ordinary bearer shares. This volume represents no more than 5% of the company's total share capital and voting rights. The company has set the purchase price at 20.00 PLN per share, a decision aligned with the authorization granted by the Extraordinary General Meeting on February 19, 2026. The execution of this program is being managed in cooperation with Trigon Dom Maklerski S.A., which was appointed to handle the acquisition process.

items.title: TCM Group A/S Reports Q3 2026 Interim Results and Revises Full-Year Guidance
items.summary: TCM Group announced its third-quarter 2026 financial results, reporting 14% revenue growth alongside a moderate reduction in full-year guidance due to margin pressures.
items.content: TCM Group reported a 14% increase in revenue for the third quarter of 2026, with 3% organic growth, and a 22% rise in adjusted EBITA to DKK 23.3 million. Despite these gains, the company moderately reduced its full-year guidance, citing lower-than-expected revenue and temporary gross margin pressure linked to the delayed impact of price increases implemented on July 1. Higher raw material, freight, and wage costs also weighed on margins during the period. Additionally, the company noted that order intake was lower than the previous year, partly because customers placed significant orders in Q2 ahead of the July price hikes. Management also provided updates on its retail strategy, including the sale of a Nettoline store in Kolding and the planned closure and merger of the Svane Hjørring showroom.

items.title: RTX A/S Reports Financial Results for the Quarter Ended September 30, 2026
items.summary: RTX A/S announced its financial performance for the quarter ending September 30, 2026, showing significant growth in both earnings and revenue compared to the same period last year.
items.content: RTX A/S reported earnings per share (EPS) of 3.30 DKK for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to 0.60 DKK in the same quarter of the previous year. Revenue for the quarter reached 211.6 million DKK, representing a 51.34% increase over the 139.8 million DKK reported in the prior-year period. For the full fiscal year, the company reported an EPS of 4.20 DKK and total revenue of 627.21 million DKK, an increase of 14.64% from the previous year's 547.11 million DKK. These results exceeded analyst expectations, which had projected an EPS of 4.16 DKK and revenue of 609.00 million DKK for the full year.

items.title: Equita Sim Maintains 'Buy' Rating on Italian Wine Brands Following Bond Issuance
items.summary: Equita Sim has reaffirmed its 'buy' recommendation and €24 price target for Italian Wine Brands after the company successfully completed a €70 million bond issuance maturing in 2032.
items.content: Equita Sim confirmed its 'buy' rating and €24 price target for Italian Wine Brands S.p.A. following the company's recent completion of a new bond issuance. The notes, which mature in 2032, were issued for a total amount of €70 million. This analyst action reflects the firm's ongoing assessment of the company's financial position following the successful capital market transaction.

items.title: Aramis Group Reports 2026 Annual Financial Results
items.summary: Aramis Group announced its fiscal year 2026 results, reporting revenue of €2,250 million and an adjusted EBITDA of €43.1 million, while providing guidance for fiscal year 2027.
items.content: Aramis Group released its annual results for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2026, reporting revenue of €2,250 million and B2C volumes of 114,074 units. The company achieved an adjusted EBITDA of €43.1 million, which fell within its revised annual target range, and a net income of -€3.1 million. Management highlighted the company's focus on its convergence strategy and noted that it is now free of acquisition earn-out commitments. For fiscal year 2027, the group targets B2C vehicle sales between 110,000 and 120,000 units and an adjusted EBITDA between €25 million and €50 million.

items.title: Apomone Verwaltung GmbH Pledges 1.9 Million MPH Health Care AG Shares
items.summary: Apomone Verwaltung GmbH, an entity closely associated with board member Patrick Brenske, has pledged 1,900,000 shares of MPH Health Care AG as part of a credit transaction.
items.content: Apomone Verwaltung GmbH, the anchor shareholder of MPH Health Care AG managed by board member Patrick Brenske, reported the pledge of 1,900,000 shares of the company. The transaction was disclosed on November 25, 2026, as part of a credit arrangement. This notification follows regulatory requirements for transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities and their closely associated parties.

items.title: Helios Solar AG Signs Memorandum of Understanding with Galaxy Venus Data Center
items.summary: Helios Solar AG has entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Galaxy Venus Data Center Sdn. Bhd. to explore a strategic partnership for renewable energy supply in Malaysia.
items.content: Helios Solar AG, through its subsidiary Helios Solar Park Sdn. Bhd., has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Galaxy Venus Data Center Sdn. Bhd. (GDC) to evaluate a potential strategic collaboration. The agreement aims to explore the feasibility of supplying renewable energy to GDC's planned data center project in Perak, Malaysia. The scope of the potential partnership includes assessing renewable energy generation, energy storage solutions, grid connection, and backup power supply. GDC has been identified as a potential off-taker for renewable energy from Helios's solar park project in Gua Musang, Kelantan, under the Malaysian Corporate Renewable Energy Supply Scheme (CRESS). Any final power purchase agreement remains subject to successful feasibility studies and the negotiation of technical and economic terms.

This development represents a continuation of the company's commercial activity in the medical technology sector. The NBS 6 system is used for diagnostic and therapeutic applications, including pre-surgical brain mapping. The order underscores the company's ongoing engagement with leading research and clinical institutions.

items.title: BrainsWay Announces Strategic Investment in Neurolief Ltd.
items.summary: BrainsWay Ltd. has entered into a $5 million convertible loan agreement with Neurolief Ltd., which includes an option to acquire the company.
items.content: BrainsWay Ltd. announced a strategic investment in Neurolief Ltd., a developer of wearable, non-invasive, multi-channel brain neuromodulation platforms designed for at-home use. The investment is structured as a $5 million convertible loan and grants BrainsWay an option to acquire the company. This initiative is intended to expand BrainsWay's total addressable market by incorporating at-home neuromodulation technology into its existing portfolio.

items.title: Oppenheimer Raises PolyPid Price Target to $12
items.summary: Oppenheimer adjusted its price target for PolyPid to $12 from $10 and maintained an 'Outperform' rating on November 25, 2026.
items.content: On November 25, 2026, Oppenheimer updated its outlook on PolyPid, increasing the price target to $12 from the previous $10. The firm maintained its 'Outperform' rating on the company's stock. This adjustment follows recent developments regarding the FDA approval of PolyPid's surgical-site infection treatment, BACFENSSI.

items.title: Roth Capital Partners Lowers PolyPid Price Target Amid Payment Uncertainty
items.summary: Roth Capital Partners analyst Boobalan Pachaiyappan lowered his price target for PolyPid to $7.50 from $8.50 while maintaining a 'Buy' rating, citing uncertainty regarding a potential $50 million milestone payment from partner Azurity Pharmaceuticals.
items.content: Following the FDA approval of PolyPid's antibiotic treatment BACFENSSI, Roth Capital Partners analyst Boobalan Pachaiyappan adjusted his price target for the company to $7.50 from $8.50 on November 25, 2026. While maintaining a 'Buy' rating, the analyst noted that the absence of an announced $50 million payment from commercial partner Azurity Pharmaceuticals has introduced uncertainty. The analyst also revised his commercial success probability estimates for the U.S. indication and potential abdominal surgery expansions. Azurity Pharmaceuticals is currently planning a U.S. launch for the treatment in the first quarter of 2027.

items.title: IQM Quantum Computers Receives Order for 54-Qubit Quantum Computer from South Korean Firm QAI
items.summary: IQM Quantum Computers has secured an order from South Korean quantum-AI company QAI Co., Ltd. to deliver an IQM Radiance R3 54-qubit quantum computer.
items.content: IQM Quantum Computers has announced a new order from QAI Co., Ltd., a South Korean quantum-AI data center and cloud infrastructure company, for the delivery of an IQM Radiance R3 54-qubit quantum computer. The agreement includes a complete on-premises quantum computing solution for QAI's data center, along with associated services. The total value of the order is between EUR 8 million and EUR 10 million, with revenue expected to be recognized in 2027. The system is scheduled for delivery and installation at QAI's Seoul-based data center by the end of 2027.

items.title: AI OKTO Announces Shareholder Election Results and Payment of Special Dividend
items.summary: AI OKTO Corp. announced the results of shareholder elections for its $3.50 per share special dividend, which was paid on November 25, 2026.
items.content: AI OKTO Corp. announced the results of shareholder elections regarding a special dividend of $3.50 per common share, which was originally declared by the Board of Directors on October 23, 2026. The dividend was paid on November 25, 2026, to shareholders of record as of November 2, 2026. Based on the election results, the company distributed approximately $3.1 million in cash and issued 2,663,133 shares of its common stock. The number of shares issued was determined using a 5-day volume-weighted average price of $4.5159 per share calculated through October 22, 2026.

items.title: Nanox Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Business Updates
items.summary: Nanox reported its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, alongside updates on its U.S. commercialization efforts, operational efficiency initiatives, and a leadership change.
items.content: Nanox reported Q3 2026 revenue of $4.4 million, a 29% increase from $3.4 million in Q3 2025, driven by the consolidation of its Nanox Health IT business. The revenue breakdown included $3.2 million from teleradiology services, $0.9 million from AI and software solutions, and $0.3 million from imaging systems and OEM services. The company reported a GAAP net loss of $12.3 million, compared to $13.7 million in the prior-year period, while the non-GAAP net loss was $10.6 million. Management highlighted ongoing U.S. commercialization efforts and a board-approved operational efficiency plan, which includes restructuring South Korea operations with full implementation expected by the end of Q1 2027. Additionally, the company announced the appointment of Einav Eliraz as its new Chief Financial Officer, effective December 1, 2026.

items.title: Beyond Oil Ltd. Expands Presence in the Netherlands Through FryFlow Partnership
items.summary: Beyond Oil Ltd. has entered the Dutch market through a new partnership called FryFlow, which includes an initial product order valued at approximately US$75,000.
items.content: Beyond Oil Ltd. announced the expansion of its operations into the Netherlands via FryFlow, a newly formed partnership involving Fandango Collection & Recycling Ltd., Guild Enterprises, and Elvi International. As part of this market entry, the company received an initial order for one container of its proprietary filter powder, valued at approximately US$75,000. FryFlow aims to distribute Beyond Oil's technology to various segments of the Dutch market, including restaurant chains, hotels, catering services, and food manufacturers, by leveraging the combined expertise of its three partners in distribution, the edible oil industry, and local market relations. The initiative builds on Fandango's existing experience in distributing Beyond Oil's technology in other markets since 2023.

items.title: Neurovia AI to Showcase AI-Powered Visual Data Infrastructure Technologies at GITEX GLOBAL 2026
items.summary: Neurovia AI, a subsidiary of Robo.ai Inc., announced its participation at GITEX GLOBAL 2026 to demonstrate its visual data optimization technology.
items.content: Neurovia AI, an Abu Dhabi-based technology company within the Robo.ai Inc. group, will participate in GITEX GLOBAL 2026, held at the Dubai Exhibition Centre from December 8 to 11, 2026. The company plans to showcase its proprietary NeuroStream technology, which is designed to reduce visual data storage requirements by up to 95% while maintaining quality. Throughout the event, Neurovia AI will engage with government and enterprise partners to discuss the role of intelligent visual data optimization in building scalable and sustainable digital infrastructure. The exhibition will feature live demonstrations and side-by-side comparisons of its technology to highlight its efficiency in sectors such as public safety and transportation.

items.title: Oreo Brand Launches Holiday Campaign Addressing 'Perfection Tax'
items.summary: Mondelez International's Oreo brand released new research highlighting the holiday pressure felt by mothers and launched a campaign to encourage a more relaxed holiday season.
items.content: The Oreo brand, a division of Mondelez International, released research indicating that 61% of mothers feel pressure to create a 'perfect' holiday season, with 41% attributing this pressure to social media. In response, the brand launched a campaign featuring Ciara to encourage mothers to prioritize fun over perfection. The initiative is framed as a way to alleviate the 'perfection tax' associated with holiday preparations. This marketing effort is part of the company's ongoing brand engagement strategy during the holiday season.

items.title: Marriott International Hosts 2026 Masters of the Craft Finals
items.summary: Marriott International concluded its 2026 Masters of the Craft U.S. and Canada finals at its Bethesda headquarters, featuring culinary, beverage, and pastry competitions.
items.content: Marriott International held the finals for its 2026 Masters of the Craft competition at the Marriott Bethesda Downtown at Marriott HQ. The event featured finalists selected from over 1,700 associates who competed in property-level and regional rounds across the United States and Canada. Participants were challenged to create dishes and drinks using a shared mystery ingredient, coconut, across culinary, beverage, and pastry categories. The competition serves as a platform for showcasing associate talent within the company's global portfolio.

items.title: CMS Proposes Rule Allowing Automatic Enrollment in Medicare Advantage Plans
items.summary: The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) has proposed a new rule that would allow insurance companies to automatically enroll newly Medicare-eligible individuals into Medicare Advantage plans.
items.content: The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) has introduced a proposed rule in the Federal Register that would permit insurance companies to implement a seamless automatic enrollment process for individuals transitioning from commercial or marketplace plans to Medicare Advantage. Elevance Health, which operates Anthem Blue Cross plans, is identified as one of the major insurers that would be affected by this regulatory change. The proposal aims to streamline coverage transitions for seniors, though it has drawn criticism from advocates concerned about the privatization of Medicare. The rule is currently open for public comment until January 19, 2027.

items.title: FedEx Cargo Plane Overruns Runway at Miami International Airport
items.summary: A FedEx cargo aircraft overshot the runway at Miami International Airport on November 25, 2026, resulting in a temporary ground stop issued by the FAA.
items.content: On the evening of November 25, 2026, a McDonnell Douglas MD-11 cargo plane operated by FedEx overshot the runway while landing at Miami International Airport. The incident prompted the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) to issue a ground stop for flights arriving at the airport, which was initially scheduled to last until 9:45 p.m. ET. Miami-Dade Fire Rescue reported no injuries in connection with the event. The cause of the runway overrun remains under investigation, with heavy rainfall noted in the area at the time of the incident.

items.title: Walmart Integrates Meta's Muse AI for Shopping
items.summary: Walmart has integrated Meta's Muse platform to enable AI-assisted shopping, allowing consumers to search for products and complete purchases through AI agents.
items.content: Walmart has officially integrated Meta's Muse platform into its shopping experience, marking a strategic move to leverage AI agents for product discovery and transaction execution. This integration allows customers to use AI to search for items, build shopping carts, and authorize purchases directly. The initiative is part of Walmart's broader strategy to maintain its presence across evolving consumer shopping channels and entry points. Management has indicated that this is an initial step, with plans to support additional agent-driven shopping experiences in the future. The move highlights the company's focus on adapting its advertising and retail business models to a landscape increasingly influenced by AI-driven consumer behavior.

items.title: Moody's Ratings Introduces New 'XG' Issuer Rating Category
items.summary: Moody's Ratings has launched a new rating category called the 'XG Issuer Rating' and assigned its first rating of this type to Coop Pank.
items.content: Moody's Ratings has introduced a new rating category known as the XG Issuer Rating. The agency assigned its inaugural XG Issuer Rating of Baa3.xg to AS Coop Pank. This development represents a new addition to the rating agency's analytical framework for assessing issuer creditworthiness.

items.title: Hilton Opens The Lan Kwai Fong, Tapestry Collection by Hilton in Hong Kong
items.summary: Hilton has expanded its footprint in Hong Kong with the opening of a new 41-room boutique hotel under its Tapestry Collection brand.
items.content: Hilton announced the grand opening of The Lan Kwai Fong, Tapestry Collection by Hilton, located in Hong Kong's Central district. The 41-room property, situated at 2 Arbuthnot Road, is the company's first Tapestry Collection hotel in the city. The hotel features individually styled rooms, a Sichuan restaurant, and a bar, and it participates in the Hilton Honors loyalty program. This opening marks a strategic addition to Hilton's portfolio of boutique-style properties in the region.

items.title: Cheche Group to Acquire 20% Stake in Long Way Fortune
items.summary: Cheche Group Inc. has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire a 20% equity interest in Long Way Fortune, a residential solar-plus-storage business, for $98 million.
items.content: Cheche Group Inc. announced a definitive share purchase agreement to acquire a 20% equity interest in Long Way Fortune, a residential solar-plus-storage company with operations in Australia and Singapore. The transaction is valued at $98 million and will be settled through the issuance of warrants for Cheche's Class A ordinary shares, with no cash consideration payable. The agreement includes an exclusive option for Cheche to acquire an additional 31% interest in the company within 18 months at the same valuation. The acquisition is intended to expand Cheche's revenue streams and establish a new growth engine in the home energy sector.

items.title: Cheche Group Announces Results of Extraordinary General Meeting
items.summary: Cheche Group Inc. shareholders approved the creation of a new class of ordinary shares, designated as Class C, carrying 300 votes per share.
items.content: Cheche Group Inc. held an extraordinary general meeting on November 25, 2026, where shareholders approved several key proposals. The primary resolution authorized the creation of a new class of ordinary shares, designated as Class C, with each share carrying 300 votes. Additionally, shareholders approved the amendment and restatement of the company's memorandum and articles of association to incorporate the rights and restrictions associated with the new Class C shares and to adjust the company's authorized share capital structure.

items.title: DSC Holdings Ltd. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release Date
items.summary: DSC Holdings Ltd. has scheduled the release of its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, for December 3, 2026.
items.content: DSC Holdings Ltd. announced that it will release its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, before the U.S. market opens on Thursday, December 3, 2026. In conjunction with the release, the company's management will host two separate live video webcasts to discuss the financial results and recent business developments. One session will be conducted in Chinese and the other in English, with both sessions covering the same prepared content. Participants are required to register online to join the webcasts.

items.title: Canaan Inc. Secures Two New Purchase Orders for Nordic District Heating Projects
items.summary: Canaan Inc. announced on November 25, 2026, that it secured two purchase orders from existing customers in the Nordic region for 430 Avalon A1566HA hydro-cooled mining units.
items.content: Canaan Inc. has secured two new purchase orders from existing Nordic customers for a total of 430 Avalon A1566HA hydro-cooled computing units. These units, which provide an aggregate computing capacity of approximately 215 PH/s, are designed to integrate high-density computing with district heating networks. The equipment is expected to support a combined heat-project capacity of nearly 12 MW, with the potential to serve approximately 8,000 homes. The company noted that the orders reflect continued customer confidence in its technology and support services. The announcement was filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission via Form 6-K.

items.title: DayOne Data Centers Reports Financial Contribution in GDS Holdings Q3 2026 Results
items.summary: GDS Holdings reported a gain of RMB 38.647 million from its equity interest in DayOne Data Centers for the third quarter of 2026.
items.content: In its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, GDS Holdings Limited disclosed a gain of RMB 38.647 million (approximately US$5.764 million) attributed to its minority equity interest in DayOne Data Centers Limited. This figure represents the share of results from the investee accounted for under the equity method. The reported gain marks a significant turnaround compared to the loss of RMB 461 million recorded in the same period of 2025. The disclosure provides insight into the financial performance of the Singapore-headquartered hyperscale data center platform as part of GDS Holdings' broader quarterly reporting.

items.title: Nexpu Reports Over 100,000 Registered Users on DPU Music Platform
items.summary: Nexpu Ltd. announced that its DPU music platform has surpassed 100,000 registered users as of November 24, 2026.
items.content: Nexpu Ltd. reported that its DPU music platform, which offers music creation, listening, and sharing features, reached a milestone of over 100,000 registered users as of November 24, 2026. The company stated that this figure is a cumulative count of registrations and does not necessarily reflect unique, active, or paying users. Nexpu indicated its intention to continue developing the platform, though it noted that the platform's ability to generate revenue and maintain user engagement remains uncertain and dependent on various factors including technical performance and market demand.

items.title: Antalpha to Report Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on December 8, 2026
items.summary: Antalpha Platform Holding Company has scheduled the release of its third-quarter 2026 financial results for December 8, 2026, before the U.S. market opens.
items.content: Antalpha Platform Holding Company announced that it will report its financial results for the third quarter of 2026 before the U.S. market opens on December 8, 2026. The company's management team will host a conference call at 8:00 A.M. U.S. Eastern Time on the same day to discuss the results. A live webcast and a replay of the call will be made available to investors.

items.title: iQIYI Receives Nasdaq Minimum Bid Price Deficiency Notice
items.summary: iQIYI, Inc. has been notified by Nasdaq that it is not in compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement for continued listing.
items.content: On November 25, 2026, iQIYI, Inc. received a written notice from the Nasdaq Stock Market indicating that the company's American Depositary Shares (ADSs) failed to meet the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement based on closing prices from October 14, 2026, to November 24, 2026. The company has been granted a 180-day period, ending May 24, 2027, to regain compliance. To satisfy the requirement, the closing bid price of the company's ADSs must reach at least $1.00 for ten consecutive business days. The notice is a standard procedural communication and does not result in immediate delisting or suspension of trading, nor does it impact the company's business operations or SEC reporting requirements.

items.title: OIO Group and W Group Sign Letter of Intent for Strategic Partnership
items.summary: OIO Group and W Group have entered into a nonbinding letter of intent to form a strategic partnership aimed at integrating luxury automotive operations with Web3 financial services.
items.content: OIO Group and W Group, a global fintech ecosystem, announced the signing of a nonbinding letter of intent to establish a strategic partnership. The proposed agreement seeks to connect OIO's luxury automotive business with W Group's Web3 financial infrastructure, focusing on areas such as tokenization, digital customer experiences, and global market access. The partnership involves indicative contributions of approximately US$150 million and is intended to support a five-year growth program. The collaboration aims to leverage OIO's automotive heritage and engineering capabilities alongside W Group's expertise in digital assets and financial technology.

items.title: Republic Power Group Limited Receives NASDAQ Notice Regarding Late Filing of Form 20-F
items.summary: Republic Power Group Limited announced it received a deficiency notice from NASDAQ for failing to timely file its annual report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026.
items.content: Republic Power Group Limited disclosed that it received a letter from the NASDAQ Stock Market on November 19, 2026, indicating non-compliance with NASDAQ Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) due to the delayed filing of its annual report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026. Under NASDAQ rules, the company has 60 calendar days, until January 19, 2027, to submit a compliance plan. If the plan is accepted, the company may be granted an extension of up to 180 days from the original filing deadline, or until May 17, 2027, to regain compliance. The company stated it intends to submit the required plan within the 60-day window, and noted that the notice has no immediate impact on the listing of its ordinary shares on the Nasdaq Capital Market.

items.title: FinVolution Group Reports Third Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results
items.summary: FinVolution Group announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, highlighting growth in its user base and transaction volumes.
items.content: FinVolution Group released its unaudited financial results for the third quarter of 2026 on November 25, 2026. The company reported that cumulative registered users reached 193.6 million as of September 30, 2026, representing a 5.0% increase year-over-year. In its overseas markets, the company saw significant growth, with cumulative registered users rising 44.0% to 67.7 million and the number of unique borrowers increasing by 123.3% compared to the same period in 2025. Net revenue for the third quarter was reported at RMB1,488.3 million, with overseas operations contributing RMB948.9 million. The company also reported a U.S. GAAP operating profit of RMB62.1 million for the quarter.

items.title: Michael J. Angelakis to Resign from American Express Board of Directors
items.summary: Michael J. Angelakis will step down from the American Express Company Board of Directors, effective December 2, 2026.
items.content: American Express Company announced that Michael J. Angelakis is resigning from its Board of Directors. The resignation is scheduled to become effective on December 2, 2026. This change represents a shift in the company's board composition.

items.title: Super Hi International Holding Ltd. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Super Hi International reported its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, highlighting revenue growth and operational performance.
items.content: Super Hi International Holding Ltd. announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter of 2026, reporting revenue of US$229.3 million, a 7.1% increase compared to the same period in 2025. The company's profit for the period reached US$9.2 million, marking a 155.6% increase from US$3.6 million in the third quarter of 2025. Income from operations was reported at US$9.9 million, with an operating margin of 4.3%. Additionally, the company expanded its network to 132 Haidilao restaurants as of September 30, 2026, and recorded approximately 8.4 million guest visits during the quarter.

items.title: LexinFintech Holdings Ltd. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release Date
items.summary: LexinFintech Holdings Ltd. will report its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, on December 3, 2026.
items.content: LexinFintech Holdings Ltd. announced that it will release its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, after the U.S. market closes on December 3, 2026. Following the release, the company's management will host an earnings conference call at 9:00 PM U.S. Eastern time on the same day, which corresponds to 10:00 AM Beijing/Hong Kong time on December 4, 2026. Investors and media can access the call via a live or archived webcast on the company's investor relations website.

items.title: Prenetics Leadership Completes Open Market Share Purchases
items.summary: Prenetics CEO Danny Yeung and other key executives acquired approximately $1.26 million of the company's Class A ordinary shares following the release of third-quarter 2026 financial results.
items.content: Prenetics Global Limited announced that CEO Danny Yeung, IM8 CFO and Prenetics CFO-designate Brian Rosin, and CFO Stephen Lo completed open market purchases of the company's Class A ordinary shares between November 20 and November 24, 2026. The executives acquired a total of 127,435 shares for an aggregate price of approximately $1.26 million, at an average price of about $9.92 per share. These purchases occurred within the company's open trading window following the November 18, 2026, release of third-quarter 2026 financial results, which showed a 228% year-over-year revenue increase to $64.1 million. The company noted that its leadership has invested approximately $5.0 million in company shares since November 2025 and has not sold any shares during that period.

items.title: Sagtec Global Receives Full Payment for Private Placement
items.summary: Sagtec Global Limited has received the full US$552,500 subscription payment from His Royal Highness Tengku Hassanal Ibrahim Alam Shah Ibni Al-Sultan Abdullah in connection with a previously announced private placement.
items.content: Sagtec Global Limited (Nasdaq: SAGT) announced on November 25, 2026, that it has received the full US$552,500 subscription payment from His Royal Highness Tengku Hassanal Ibrahim Alam Shah Ibni Al-Sultan Abdullah, the Crown Prince of Pahang, Malaysia. This payment relates to a previously announced private placement. The company stated that receiving these proceeds provides increased flexibility to fund customer implementations and expand the reach of its AI-assisted software solutions. The funds are also expected to support the cloud, database, and server infrastructure required to maintain and host the company's enterprise applications.

items.title: OMS Energy Technologies Reports Financial Results for First Half of Fiscal Year 2027
items.summary: OMS Energy Technologies Inc. announced its unaudited financial results for the six months ended September 30, 2026, highlighting gross margin expansion and strong cash generation.
items.content: OMS Energy Technologies Inc. reported total revenues of $66.7 million for the six months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $82.8 million in the prior year period, attributing the change primarily to the timing of call-off orders under its long-term Saudi Aramco supply agreement. Despite the revenue decline, the company expanded its gross margin to 31.4% from 28.2% and increased its net profit margin to 18.8%. The company generated $25.3 million in operating cash flow, ending the period with a debt-free cash position of $172.3 million. Additionally, OMS highlighted recent business wins, including a $7.1 million competitive tender award from Saudi Aramco and a $2.3 million order from Pertamina Hulu Rokan, alongside other smaller orders.

items.title: Yatsen Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Yatsen Holding Limited reported its unaudited financial results for the third quarter of 2026, showing an 11.4% decrease in total net revenues to RMB884.5 million.
items.content: Yatsen Holding Limited announced its financial results for the third quarter of 2026, reporting total net revenues of RMB884.5 million (US$131.9 million), an 11.4% decrease from the same period in the prior year. While total revenue declined, the company's Skincare Brands segment saw a 22.3% increase in net revenues to RMB600.1 million. The company reported a net loss of RMB129.0 million (US$19.2 million) for the quarter, compared to a net loss of RMB70.4 million in the prior year period. Gross margin remained relatively stable at 78.4%, compared to 78.2% in the third quarter of 2025. Total operating expenses for the quarter decreased by 9.1% to RMB785.1 million.

(RBC GAM Inc.) provided estimated annual reinvested capital gains distribution amounts for its suite of RBC ETFs and ETF Series of RBC Funds, based on data as of October 31, 2026. These figures are estimates and remain subject to change based on subscriptions, redemptions, or portfolio transactions occurring before the ex-dividend date. Unitholders of record as of December 30, 2026, will be eligible for the 2026 annual reinvested distributions.

items.title: RTX's Pratt & Whitney Awarded $2.53 Billion U.S. Navy Contract
items.summary: RTX Corporation's Pratt & Whitney segment secured a $2.53 billion contract from the U.S. Navy to provide support for F135 propulsion systems on F-35 Lightning II aircraft.
items.content: RTX Corporation's Pratt & Whitney unit has been awarded a $2.53 billion contract by the U.S. Navy to support F135 propulsion systems used in F-35 Lightning II aircraft. The non-competitively procured agreement encompasses a range of services, including maintenance, repair, engineering, training, and the provision of spare parts. Work under this contract is scheduled for completion in November 2027. This award represents a significant commitment to the sustainment of the F-35 propulsion fleet.

items.title: BNY and Microsoft Complete AI Agent Pilot for Treasury Trading
items.summary: BNY and Microsoft have successfully completed a pilot program using AI agents to negotiate U.S. Treasury bill trades within predefined limits.
items.content: The pilot utilized BNY's patent-pending Agentic Negotiation Protocol to facilitate secure, automated negotiations between AI agents. Microsoft Treasury provided specific trading instructions to its agent, which operated within authorized limits for counterparty, security, size, and settlement terms. The protocol recorded all messages and human decisions, and BNY intends to expand the technology to include repurchase agreements and other multi-party negotiations.

items.title: SpaceX Adjusts GPU Rental Rates and Faces Lease Non-Renewal
items.summary: Reports indicate that SpaceX has reduced rental fees for NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs and that Anthropic will not renew its lease for a cluster of H200 GPUs.
items.content: SpaceX has reportedly implemented price adjustments for its GPU rental services, including a reduction in rental fees for small-scale clusters of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs by up to 35%. Additionally, the AI company Anthropic has decided not to renew its lease for a cluster of approximately 50,000 H200 GPUs from SpaceX. SpaceX is currently seeking new tenants for this computing capacity, with deliveries expected in early 2027. Market data suggests that SpaceX's current pricing for these H200 units is approximately 23% below the prevailing market transaction price, reflecting the company's assessment of future rental trends.

items.title: BlackRock Canada Announces Estimated 2026 Annual Reinvested Capital Gains Distributions for iShares ETFs
items.summary: BlackRock Asset Management Canada Limited has released its estimated 2026 annual reinvested capital gains distributions for its iShares ETFs listed on the TSX and Cboe Canada.
items.content: BlackRock Canada announced the estimated 2026 annual reinvested capital gains distributions for its iShares ETFs. These figures are based on estimates as of October 30, 2026, and are subject to change before the final tax year-end distributions. The company expects to announce final distribution amounts on or about December 29, 2026, with a record date of December 30, 2026. These distributions are part of the firm's standard annual tax reporting process for its exchange-traded funds.

items.title: Jensen Huang's return, neocloud risk, and a holiday retail rally
items.summary: In this special edition of Sozzi Unleashed: At The Close, Brian Sozzi warns that investors can be right about a tech revolution and still lose a fortune, lays out three reasons Nvidia may deserve another look after Jensen Huang's return, and explains why the debt-fueled neoclouds like CoreWeave and Nebius still make him nervous. Former federal prosecutor Gil Soffer, head of corporate investigations at Katten, joins to discuss how Nvidia's board probe proceeds with Huang back in charge and whether he could be fired again. Brian also connects the dots on the AI build-out and inflation with a clip from Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee, and makes the case for a strong holiday season for retailers with comments from Walmart CFO John David Rainey and Gap CEO Richard Dickson.
